## 2026-11-11: One answer to "is there a newer version" on the Mac, and updating a Mac from the phone (the author: "我的 mac app 竟然在'各电脑上的'里边说有新版本，但是 app 自身检测不出来新版本，没法更新，其次我们应该允许从手机上更新 mac 里的版本吧？")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D187 | **Settled 2026-11-11 (the author: "第一性原理做决定"; built, verified with fakes; not yet on the author's Mac). The Mac app finds every version the home knows of, and a Mac updates from any client's 更新: the Ducter on that Mac asks its app, which downloads, checks and restarts at the safe point.** (1) **Root cause (the author's Settings › 更新与关于, 00:48 on 2026-11-11):** the top card said **现在还查不到新版本** while the same page's row for this Mac said **有新版本 0.0.13**. The app reads GitHub's API anonymously (D72); its 60 requests an hour are shared by everything behind the same address, and this address had used them (`/rate_limit`: 60 of 60, read-only). The 403 was taken for "no public releases" (NoFeed, the private-repo case), and since the failed read still counted as the day's check, the app wouldn't ask again for 24 h. The home on hel reads the same release from another address and falls back to the release page's redirect (D148 (1)), so it knew. Not the cause, checked: the feed's asset names (`Ducter-0.0.13-arm64.dmg` present), the version order (numeric; 0.0.11 without a release doesn't matter to `releases/latest`), caching (no ETag is sent). (2) **The fix: one answer.** A rate limit is never NoFeed: the app falls back to the release page's redirect for the version and to the tag's download address for the files (neither is the API); the home's devices frame is a hint: when it says a newer version is out for this Mac (matched by the worker's device id in `worker.json`, which no rename changes, else the computer's name), the app checks now (once per version every 15 min) and fetches that version even while GitHub can't say. Whatever names the version, the disk image must match the tag's `SHA256SUMS.txt` and carry this app's own Developer ID team (D72), so a wrong hint can at most fetch a genuine release that doesn't check out. Only an answer counts as a check: a failed read keeps "checked {t}" where it was and is tried again within the hour; its line is **这次没查成 / Couldn't check this time** with **GitHub 没应答，一小时内再试。**, never "didn't update". (3) **This Mac's row is the way to update it**, a worker row as well as a home row: the same 更新 as the top card (D167's single flow). (4) **`ducter update --check` asks the home the CLI follows** (D147) and lists every computer there, not only this one; a home that doesn't answer is said (**连不上 {name}，下面只有这台电脑。**). (5) **Updating a Mac from the phone.** Who: the author away from the MacBook, a consumer whose Mac sits at home, a fresh user who sees 有新版本 on a card. What they feel: before, a dot they can't act on ("open the app there"); after, one tap and the card tells each step, calm that nothing mid-way is cut. First time: the same 更新 button as on a server's card, one line under it saying what will happen. The flow: the phone's 更新 goes to the home as today; a worker (or a home) whose Ducter lives in Ducter.app and says `asksApp` in its hello asks its app through two files in the shared data folder (`updates/app-ask.json` this side, `updates/app.json` the app's state, rewritten on every change and every 15 s): **get v** (the app downloads and checks it; the card shows 在下载 {v}… n% · 在核对 {v}…), then the safe point (D148 (4): no merge or undo mid-way, a turn gets its grace; 等手头的事停好), then **restart** (the app's own Restart to update: **正在换上新版本，马上回来** on the Mac's screen, D160), which swaps the bundle and restarts that Mac's Ducter on the new helper; the restarted Ducter says how it went (`result.json`, judged by D167's rule: on the target 回来了; a swap that didn't take, seen as the reopened app's install failure, 没更新成 with why). Plain refusals, nothing started: **那台 Mac 上的 Ducter 没开着，或者 Mac 睡着了** (no fresh `app.json`; a quitting app removes it at once), and **…是用管理员身份装的，这次更新要在那台 Mac 上输一次密码** (no password prompt is raised on an unattended Mac). The card's line under 更新: **{Mac} 上的 Ducter 会下载、核对，等手头的事停好再重启。** A worker from before D187 (no `asksApp`) keeps the old line, open Ducter there. The night-time auto-update (D148 (10)) still skips Macs (todo). | U (the report and its screenshot), L (`/rate_limit` on the author's address; the app's `state.json` checked 00:38:26, nothing staged; `releases/latest` = v0.0.13 with its image) | `apps/desktop/internal/update/{feed,update,asks}.go` and tests, `apps/desktop/{main,lifecycle}.go`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/{devupdate,settings,settings_update,app}.go`, `apps/desktop/internal/i18n/{lifecycle,devupdate}.go`, `packages/core/src/{app-update,updates,devices,workers,core}.ts`, `packages/core/test/app-update.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/{update,worker,home,main,i18n}.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/index.ts`, `apps/web/src/{devcard,i18n}.ts*`, `design/system.md`, `design/scenarios.md`, `docs/{install,phone,troubleshooting}.md`, `design/todo.md` |

## 2026-11-11: Autofill: sign-ins, cards and your details for errands (the author: "像 muse 里那种的 credential 管理我们做了么？比如以后我请他帮我订酒店，订机票，买东西之类的都会有各种场景需求… 很多功能我希望在手机，ipad Android 上都能优雅做到"; decided from first principles while the author slept)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D191 | **Settled 2026-11-11 (the author: "第一性原理做决定", defaults taken; built and verified on fakes and a local Chrome for Testing). 自动填充 / Autofill keeps the owner's saved sign-ins, cards and details on the home, encrypted, and Ducter's browser fills them by reference: no model, Log line or client ever holds a secret after it is saved; every payment waits for a Go that names merchant, amount and card; a saved sign-in or a private detail waits for one OK the first time on each site.** (1) **Three stores, kept apart** (research/54 §11): the session stays in Ducter's browser profile (D151); secrets in Autofill; the owner's own password manager untouched (on a Mac tasks use the agent's own browser in the owner's Chrome, D130, where it fills as always). (2) **What is stored:** sign-ins (site, user name, password), cards (number, expiry, name, postcode), details in two kinds: readable (name, email, phone, seat, meal, passport country; the partner and tasks may read them) and fill-only (passport number and expiry, birthday, address, known traveler number, loyalty numbers). **The card's security code is never stored** (PCI DSS 3.3.1.2): it is typed on each Pay card and held in memory for that payment. (3) **At rest:** `<dataDir>/saved/<persona>.enc`, AES-256-GCM, 0600; the key in the Mac's login keychain (service `Ducter Autofill`, one account per data folder) or, elsewhere, a 0600 key file; the screen says which. Never synced to a client: a secret goes up once in `saved_put` and never comes back; edit replaces, nothing reveals (alt: reveal behind Face ID / Touch ID; rejected for v1: the owner's own password manager is where to look one up, and reveal widens what a stolen phone can do). (4) **By reference:** handles (`signin:github.com`, `card:visa-4242`, `me.passport_number`); the partner's one new tool `saved_list` (listed only once something is saved); a task in Ducter's browser gets `saved_list`, `browser_fill {ref, use, part}`, `browser_ask_to_pay`; a brief naming a saved handle runs on Ducter's own browser wherever it can start. The fill types by CDP, marks the field filled and draws it as dots; every browser tool's answer is scrubbed of saved values; card numbers and named codes never render and never reach a task (D152's detector gains them, with its Go port). (5) **Asking:** every payment: a 付款 / Pay card from `browser_ask_to_pay` naming the page's host (read by code), amount, what it buys, card and last four, **第一次在这里付** when new, a security-code field, **先不付 / 付 {amount}**, no default; after Go the card fills only for that task, on that site, within 15 minutes. A saved sign-in fills only on its own site (a look-alike gets nothing) and asks **可以 / OK** the first time; a private detail asks the first time on each site. Only https. Only Ducter's tools set these cards, never a task's words; the partner doesn't ask first itself (one card, not two). (6) **2FA, 3-D Secure, passkeys:** the owner's, live, in the D151 live view; codes never stored; codes from a connected mailbox not in v1. (7) **History:** 用在了哪儿 / Where it was used: filled, said Go to {amount}, said OK, said no, with site, task and when (300 kept, inside the encrypted file). (8) **Clients:** Settings › Autofill on the Mac app and the web client (phone, iPad, Android), the same keys; the Pay and OK cards on both. (9) **Not in v1:** 1Password/Bitwarden by reference, single-use cards (Stripe Link's agent wallet, Privacy.com, US/Canada), Face ID on Pay, mailbox codes, TOTP | U (the request), R54, R25, L (the fake checkout: a page that echoes keystrokes leaked the 3-digit code to a read before the code scrub; haiku eval 58/78 with a pasted card number reaching a brief before the detector gained card numbers) | `design/autofill.md`, `packages/core/src/saved/*`, `packages/core/src/browser/{tools,reader,index}.ts`, `packages/core/src/{core,ws,decisions}.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/{saved,index,internal,redact}.ts`, `packages/protocol/fixtures/redact.json`, `packages/runner/src/browser.ts`, `packages/partner/src/persona.ts`, `packages/partner/eval/*`, `apps/web/src/{autofill.tsx,i18n-autofill.ts,app.ts,views.tsx}`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/saved.go,views/autofill.go,i18n/autofill.go,redact}`, `design/{system,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/autofill.md` |

## 2026-11-11: Watch Ducter's browser work, and take turns in it (the author: "我们应该允许看到服务器上的浏览器的操作和样子，甚至允许用户自己操作… 很多功能我希望在手机，ipad Android 上都能优雅做到")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D190 | **Built 2026-11-11, for the author's review on real devices. Ducter's own browser can be watched while a task works in it, and the user and the task take turns in it: one live view for a sign-in, Try it and watching, on the phone, iPad, Android, foldables and the Mac.** (1) **看它上网 / Watch it browse:** a task holding Ducter's own browser (On hand marks it, `TaskCard.browsing {device}`) can be watched from the opened task (**看它上网 / Watch it browse**), from its computer's 上网 block (**{task} 正在用它 / {task} is using it** · **看看 / Watch**), and from its card on the wide On hand (D184). `live_open {decisionId: "watch", taskId}` shows the task's current tab and follows it to a new one. Watching changes nothing for the task: not blind, the page keeps its own size (the screencast only scales it for the viewer), nothing the user does goes in. A task with no page yet says **它还没打开网页。一打开，这里就能看到。** and shows the first one when it comes. Watching starts nothing (a browser that isn't running stays so). (2) **What it is doing, calmly:** each browser tool notes its step (`browser/notes.ts`), and the watcher's bottom line says it for six seconds, then goes quiet: **正在打开 {host}** · **正在看这一页** · **正在点「{label}」** · **正在往「{label}」里填** · **正在按 {key}** · **正在翻页** · **正在后退** · **换到了另一个标签页** · **正在截图** (en: Opening {host} · Reading the page · Clicking "{label}" · Typing in "{label}" …); a click or a typing lands as one soft ring on the page (none with reduced motion). A label is the element's own words (a field's label or placeholder, never its value), keys hidden (D152); never what was typed. Idle, the line says **Ducter 的浏览器 · 在 {device} 上**. Presence only: never logged. (3) **换我来 / My turn · 还给它 / Hand it back:** whose turn it is belongs to the browser (the profile), and only one window holds the user's. My turn: the page takes the viewer's size, every task on that browser is blind as during a sign-in (D151's rule, one message for both: it ends its turn and waits), and a band says it plainly: **现在你在用。它看不见这个页面，也不会动它。 / It's your turn. It can't see this page or touch it.** In the user's turn: taps, drags-as-scroll, keys, IME text (committed text only), back, forward, reload, and the address line (tap the host; http and https only, checked on the client and again on the home). Hand it back (or closing the view, or the socket going away: a task is never left waiting) restores the page's own size and tells the task, only when it needs to hear it: it tried while it was the user's turn, or the page moved ("…Your tab went from A to B while they had it. browser_read before your next step"); a finished task is never woken. Another window of the same user sees **你正在另一台设备上用它** and can take the turn itself. A sign-in (D151) and Try it (D154) are the user's turn from the start and keep their Done / Not now. Sites the user signed in to in their own turn (the site has more cookies than before) join 已登录的网站. (4) **The stream:** CDP screencast JPEG, one frame in flight until the client acks it, at most 8 a second (kept from D151). Chosen over periodic screenshots: frames come only when the page changes, so a still page costs nothing, and the ack paces a slow phone link to fewer frames, never a queue. The quality steps down (q70 → 55 → 45 at ¾ size → 35 at ½) when acks come back slower than 0.7 s on average, and back up after 20 quick ones; frames are sized to the page area the client measures (rotation, a fold, the turn's band), at most 2×; a still page that sends nothing gets one picture of itself half a second after the stream starts. Watching on a small screen, a double tap zooms 2.5× where it lands (frames sharpen to match) and pans; again, back. Out of sight (the app in the background, a hidden window) the client asks for no frames (`live_pause`); a new socket reopens the view that is on screen. (5) **Safety:** frames go only to the socket that opened the view, over its own authenticated WebSocket (paired devices of this home only; a CLI is refused); nothing of a view is written to disk or logged; input goes through the home, only in the user's turn and only from the window holding it; URLs shown are redacted (D152). | D200 | **Built 2026-11-11, for the author's review on real devices. When the iPhone/iPad or Android app is paired with a home that runs an older Ducter than the app, the app itself says so in one quiet native line, with 去更新 / Update it and 知道了 / Got it.** (1) **Who, what they feel, how it starts.** Who: anyone whose phone app updated itself (TestFlight, the Android self-update, D181) before their home did; the heavy developer with a VPS home first, the consumer user with a Mac home next. Before: an iPad that looks like a phone and promised features missing, with no reason given, so the app feels broken. After: one sentence names the cause and the one tap that fixes it, so the gap reads as a known, small thing (放心). First time: it simply appears at the bottom over the page after the page has loaded; nothing to set up or learn. (2) **Why native (D178 (5)):** the shell shows the home's own page, so an older home means an older page, which can't know what it lacks. Only the shell knows both versions. (3) **Where the version comes from:** `GET <home>/api/me` with the paired device token (the token the page already hands the app in `hello`; iOS keeps it in the Keychain as before, Android holds it in memory only), which now carries `version`. A home that answers 200 with no `version` is from before D200 and so older than any app that asks; the line then leaves the number out. Not `/health`: off-machine it says only `{ok}`, by design. (4) **The rule** (`HomeVersion`, the same in both apps and checked against the same cases): compare major.minor.patch numerically, ignoring a pre-release (an App Store build is digits only: 0.2.0-beta.1 ships as 0.2.0); shown only when the home's is lower; never for an app that isn't a real version (0.0.0, CI; a local Xcode build stays quiet unless launched with `-appVersion`). A home newer than the app is not this decision (TestFlight and D181 handle it). (5) **Words:** **{home} 上的 Ducter 还是 {v}，比这个 App 旧，有些新东西要等它更新。/ Ducter on {home} is still {v}, older than this app; some new things wait for it to update.** (without a version: **{home} 上的 Ducter 比这个 App 旧，有些新东西要等它更新。/ Ducter on {home} is older than this app; some new things wait for it to update.**) · **去更新 / Update it** · **知道了 / Got it**. {home} is the home's address, as the can't-reach screen names it. (6) **去更新** opens the page at `app#settings=devices` (Settings › Your devices, where the home's own card has 更新: a server updates itself, D148/D167; a Mac through D187). A hash route rather than a new bridge message, because the page has understood it since D150 (v0.0.4), so even an older page goes there; an even older page stays on the conversation, harmless. (7) **知道了** holds for that pair of versions on that home (the shell's own storage: UserDefaults / SharedPreferences); a new pair (the home updated but still behind, or the app updated again) shows it once more. The check runs after the page's `hello` and when the app comes back to the foreground; any failure is silent (can't reach is its own screen). (8) **Look:** the Android update card's form (Screens.kt `UpdateCard`, Pebble tokens) at the bottom, one phone-wide column on an iPad; on Android the app's own update card speaks first and this line waits behind it. | U (2026-11-11, decided from first principles) | system.md (Updating in place), android.md, ui.md, product-model.md (glossary), scenarios.md (H4), docs/phone.md, `apps/ios/Ducter/HomeVersion.swift` + `HomeOlder.swift`, `apps/android` `Core.kt` HomeVersion + MainActivity, `packages/core/src/web.ts` |

## 2026-11-11: A task's folder and branch in its own words, and the terminals you use (the author: a Chinese title gave `task`, `task-2`; 「在终端打开」 offered only macOS Terminal)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D201 | **Built 2026-11-11. A task's branch and folder keep its title's own words in their own script, and 打开 / Open offers every terminal installed, as it offers editors.** *Who:* the heavy developer who writes briefs in Chinese (the author) and lives in iTerm2, Ghostty, Warp or con, not Terminal. *Feel:* before, a column of `task`, `task-2`, `task-3` in Finder and the editor's recents, and a Terminal window they never use; after, `修复登录页的闪退` in every place the folder shows, and the task opens in their own terminal. *First time:* nothing to learn; the folder simply reads as what they wrote, and the menu lists what is on their Mac. (1) **The slug (one function, `nameSegment` in `packages/runner/src/places.ts`; `slugify` for a title, the folder's `segment` for a branch).** The folder exists so a person recognises it on their own disk, and the task's words in the language they were written are the most recognisable; APFS, ext4 and git all take Unicode. Letters, marks and digits of any script stay (`\p{L}\p{M}\p{N}`: marks too, or Devanagari and Thai lose their vowel signs); every run of anything else is one `-` (a folder segment also keeps `.` and `_`, as D198). NFC first (how macOS stores names); never starts with `-`, `.` or a mark, never ends with `-` or `.`; at most 40 characters for a title (80 for a branch someone named), cut between graphemes (never a split surrogate pair or accent) and within 200 UTF-8 bytes (a file name holds 255); only ASCII letters are lowercased (`Починить-вход` keeps its case: lowercasing another script changes how it reads); `task` only when nothing is left (an emoji-only or punctuation-only title). An ASCII title gives exactly the slug it gave before. **The branch `ducter/<slug>` is the same slug**: every slug of letters, digits and `-` is a valid ref (tested with `git check-ref-format` over CJK, kana, Hangul, Cyrillic, accented Latin, Devanagari, CJK Extension B, emoji). A taken folder is compared NFC too (APFS folds case and form by itself; ext4 doesn't), so two spellings of one title never get two folders that look alike. The branch and the folder reach git, `git push` and `gh pr create` only as their own arguments, never through a shell (tested with a Chinese branch pushed to a remote and handed to gh). Tasks from before keep their stored branch and path. (2) **Terminals, found like editors** (`apps/desktop/internal/local/editors.go`: in /Applications, ~/Applications, /Applications/Utilities or /System/Applications/Utilities, else by bundle id through Spotlight; the one Spotlight says was used last first, else the order below). Each, with how it opens a new window at the folder and how sure: **Terminal** `com.apple.Terminal`, `open -a Terminal <dir>`, VERIFIED (a shell started in a scratch folder named with a space and Chinese, on this Mac); **iTerm2** `com.googlecode.iterm2` (`iTerm.app`), `open -a <app> <dir>`, VERIFIED the same way; **Ghostty** `com.mitchellh.ghostty`, `open -a <app> <dir>` (its Info.plist claims `public.directory`), VERIFIED the same way; **Warp** `dev.warp.Warp-Stable`, its URI `warp://action/new_window?path=<dir>` (percent-encoded, slashes kept) through `open -a <app>`, DOCUMENTED (docs.warp.dev, URI scheme; not installed here, so not run); **Rex** by Superlogical, `com.superlogical.rex` (INFERRED from its Application Support and Preferences paths in a hands-on review; Rex for Mac is a tester beta, `Rex.app` or `Rex Beta.app`), and **con** (`co.nowledge.con`, `.beta`, `.dev`; `con.app`, `con Beta.app`, `con Dev.app`; VERIFIED from the con-terminal repo's `scripts/macos/common.sh` and the installed con Beta's Info.plist): **neither has a way to open a folder on macOS today** (con: no `CFBundleDocumentTypes`, and its `--working-directory` startup flag is parsed on Linux only; Rex: its docs give `rex new --cwd` for a session, nothing for the Mac app's window). So both are offered only while the installed app's Info.plist claims folders, through `open -a`: they appear by themselves the day they do, and until then the menu never has an item that opens the app somewhere else (放心: every item does what it says). macOS's Terminal is offered even when detection finds nothing. (3) **The menu**, calm, in two groups: **在 Finder 中显示 / Show in Finder** · — · **用 {editor} 打开 / Open in {editor}** for each editor · — · **在 {terminal} 里打开 / Open in {terminal}** for each terminal, Terminal itself **在终端里打开 / Open in Terminal**; every one installed, the one used last first in each group; a terminal's name is its .app's (iTerm2 by its product name). Alternative considered: one "Open in Terminal" item opening the default terminal (macOS has no default-terminal setting to read; picking one for the person is a guess). | U (2026-11-11, decided "按建议") | `packages/runner/src/places.ts`, `packages/runner/test/{slug,integrate}.test.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/local/editors.go` (+ test), `apps/desktop/internal/views/{openin,app}.go`, `apps/desktop/internal/i18n/openin.go`, `apps/desktop/main.go`, `design/{product-model,system,ui,todo}.md`, `docs/{getting-started,faq}.md` |

## 2026-11-11: Who does it, on every computer; its model and how hard it thinks (the author: a home on the server hel with Codex only, Claude Code on the Mac that works for it, and New task offered neither Claude Code nor a model nor an effort)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D202 | **Built 2026-11-11. 谁来做 / Who does it lists every AI agent on every computer, one row each; an agent on another computer than the folder's is offered there; under the chosen agent, its 模型 / Model and 思考深度 / Effort.** *Who:* the heavy multi-agent developer whose home is a server and whose Mac does tasks for it (the author); also anyone with two computers. *Feel:* before, Claude Code on their Mac silently missing from the list when the folder was on the server, and no way to say "Sonnet, think hard" without the partner; after, every agent they have is there, the one on the Mac says **在 Macbook Pro M3 上**, and the pill reads **Claude Code · Opus 5.5 · 高**. *First time:* nothing to learn: the defaults are already right (Ducter's suggestion, the model's own default effort), and the rows only show under the agent they opened. (1) **Every agent, one row each** (`fwCandidates` with `every`: no caps; the clients keep each agent's best row per computer): those that can at the chosen computer first, then each agent that can't there but can on another computer (core sends it `blocked: "elsewhere"` for a folder; for No folder it is simply another computer's), tagged **在 {computer} 上 / on {computer}**, then the ones that can't anywhere, greyed with why as before (an agent available elsewhere replaces its greyed row here). The top candidate and **推荐 / Suggested** stay D157's (never an agent on another computer by itself). (2) **Picking one on another computer** brings its computer along: No folder moves there (D157); a repo switches to **its copy on that computer** when the places list one, and keeps the branch when that copy has it (the row's helper line: **会换到 {computer} 上的 {folder} / Switches to {folder} on {computer}**); else the folder list opens on that computer's places only, headed **文件夹要在 {computer} 上 / The folder must be on {computer}**, with **不用文件夹** on that computer and, where this client can add one there (D197), **加一个文件夹…**; picking one there picks the agent. **Same repo = same origin**: `PlaceChoice.remote` and `folderInfo.remote` carry `git remote get-url origin` normalized to host/owner/repo (scheme, user, port, `.git` and case dropped), and two places match when both know an origin and they are equal; when **neither** knows one, the exact folder name matches; one known and one not never matches (a fork or a different repo of the same name must not be mistaken for it). ## 2026-11-11: One Ducter folder per computer, and projects from a Git address (the author: "路径不能假设 dev code src 这种吧，我觉得最好是 ducter 这种的 一个就好 类似 conductor")

| D204 | **Built 2026-11-11. Each computer has one visible Ducter folder, `~/ducter`, like Conductor's `~/conductor`: the projects Ducter cloned in `projects/<repo>`, new tasks' working copies in `worktrees/<repo>/<branch slug>`. Nothing guesses where people keep code; 从 Git 地址加… / Add from a Git address… clones onto any computer, from any client.** *Who:* every developer, and the author first: their code lives under folder names Ducter can't know (D203 guessed `~/dev`, `~/code`, …), and their phone had no way to put a repo on the Mac. *Feel:* before, a list of whatever sat under the folders Ducter guessed, and hidden worktrees in `~/.ducter`; after, one folder they can open in Finder that holds everything Ducter made, and a repo on any computer is one pasted address away. *First time:* the empty list says **还没有文件夹。/ No folders yet.** and offers the ways to get one (this Mac's own picker, 找一个文件夹…, 从 Git 地址加…, then 不用文件夹); nothing to set up. (1) **The folder** (`protocol/src/ducter-folder.ts` `ducterFolder`, one rule for the home, a worker, the runner and uninstall), in order: **`$DUCTER_FOLDER`** when set (`~/…` allowed), exactly that; else a Ducter with **a data folder of its own** (not the default `~/.ducter`: tests, the soak, a second Ducter on one computer) keeps it inside that data folder, `<dataDir>/ducter`, so it never touches the user's `~/ducter`; else the first of **`~/ducter`, `~/ducter-work`, `~/ducter-work-2` … `-9`** that carries Ducter's marker **`.ducter-folder`**, and when none does, the first that is missing or holds nothing but `projects/` and `worktrees/` (empty counts). **A `~/ducter` that holds anything else and no marker is someone else's** (a clone of the ducter repo, say) and is never touched: Ducter uses `~/ducter-work`, and keeps using the folder it marked even if `~/ducter` goes later. Resolving only reads; the folder and its marker (a two-line note saying what it is) are made on first use (a clone, a task's worktree). The real path is what the clients show (the field's **会放在 {path} / It goes in {path}**). A settings field for it: not now (todo); the env is enough until someone asks. (2) **No scanning anywhere.** D203's scan of `~/dev`, `~/code`, `~/src`, `~/Projects`, `~/projects`, `~/work`, `~/repos`, `~/git` is gone (`findRepos`, `REPO_ROOTS`), and so are `ducter up`'s first-run repo hints (`firstrun.json`: nothing read them but New task; `ducter up` now removes a stale one; the Mac app's `hints` package no longer reads it). A computer's projects are **the git repos directly in its `<Ducter folder>/projects`** (`projectRepos`, most recently touched first, at most 50, origin and default branch read from their files as D203 did); the worker op keeps its name `repos` and answers `{folder, repos}` (D203's bare list is still read). New task's folder list is exactly: the folders tasks used and the projects added (D186, D197: the Mac picker, 找一个文件夹…), then those projects; 找一个文件夹… stays (D203). (3) **从 Git 地址加… / Add from a Git address…**: a row under 找一个文件夹… for each computer that can do it (the home and each reachable worker; on the Mac this Mac too, since it is git, not a picker; **在 {computer} 上** under it when there are two), opening a field in place of the list: **从 Git 地址加到 {computer} / Add from a Git address on {computer}**, the address (placeholder **https://…、git@…:主人/仓库，或 主人/仓库 / https://…, git@…:owner/repo, or owner/repo**), **会放在 {path}，用 {computer} 自己的 git 登录克隆。/ It goes in {path}, cloned with {computer}'s own git sign-in.**, **返回 / Back** and **克隆 / Clone**; while it runs **在克隆…大的仓库要几分钟。/ Cloning… A big repository takes a few minutes.** with a spinner and the button **在克隆… / Cloning…**. Wire `{t:"project_clone", address, device?, clientId}` → `{t:"project_clone_result", ok, clientId, device?, place?, existed?, reason?, message?}`; a worker answers a new op **`clone {address}`**; the home waits up to 11 minutes. That computer clones into `<folder>/projects/<repo>`; **the same origin already there is simply that project** (`existed`, no second clone); a folder of that name holding another repo makes `<repo>-2`, `-3`. Done, the home adds it (`project_add`, D186) and the card picks it, and the agent that waited for a folder there (D202, D203). A resend with the same clientId (the phone's socket came back) waits for the same clone. **Safety** (`protocol/src/clone.ts`): only the address comes from a client, checked strictly before git sees it on the computer that clones (`parseGitAddress`, again on the worker): `https://host[:port]/path`, `ssh://[user@]host[:port]/path`, scp-like `user@host:path` (a user required, so it never reads as a local path), `host.tld/owner/repo` (made https) and GitHub's `owner/repo`; printable ASCII, no spaces or newlines, at most 300 characters, never starting with `-`, no `::` (`ext::`), no `..`, no credentials in the URL, no `file://`, `git://`, plain `http://` or local paths. git runs as `git clone -- <url> <target>` with no other argument, the user's own git settings and sign-in (git's environment as D102 gives it, plus gh's token for a gh credential helper), **`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`**, **`GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=https:ssh`** (redirects and submodules too) and `ssh -o BatchMode=yes` unless the user set their own `GIT_SSH_COMMAND`, so it fails instead of waiting on a prompt; **10 minutes** at most (`CLONE_TIMEOUT_MS`), then stopped; a failed or stopped clone leaves nothing behind. **Failure lines** (git's words sorted, `cloneReason`): **这不像 Git 地址。试试 https://…、git@…:主人/仓库 或 主人/仓库。/ That doesn't look like a Git address. Try https://…, git@…:owner/repo or owner/repo.** · **找不到这个仓库，或者 {computer} 没有它的权限。/ That repository wasn't found, or {computer} has no access to it.** (GitHub answers "not found" for a private repo it won't show) · **{computer} 没有这个仓库的权限：先在 {computer} 上登录 git，再试一次。/ {computer} has no access to it: sign in to git on {computer}, then try again.** · **{computer} 连不上那个地址。/ {computer} can't reach that address.** · **克隆超过 10 分钟，停下了。/ Cloning took over 10 minutes and was stopped.** · **{computer} 现在连不上。** (away) · **没能克隆：{git's line} / Couldn't clone it: {git's line}**. (4) **Worktrees move for new tasks only**: `worktreeFor` puts a new task's working copy in `<Ducter folder>/worktrees/<repo>/<branch slug>` (D198's naming and D201's slug unchanged; the folder is marked when the first is made). Tasks already running keep their stored path. Archive (`archiveWorktree`) removes a worktree under `<dataDir>/worktrees` (before D204) or under the `worktrees/` of a folder that carries the marker (so a task keeps archiving after `DUCTER_FOLDER` changes), never anything else. **`ducter uninstall --all`** removes `<Ducter folder>/worktrees` (counted, an unsaved one warned, their repos pruned) as well as the data folder, or the whole Ducter folder when nothing but Ducter's is in it, and **never `projects/`**: its listing keeps **Ducter 替你克隆的 {n} 个项目：{path}，是你的：卸载从不删它们 / The {n} projects Ducter cloned for you: {path}, yours: uninstall never removes them**; inside a data folder that goes (a data folder of its own), the projects are spared from the removal. (5) **An older worker says so, in the user's words**: a worker without the new ops answers `repos`, `browse`, `clone` and `folderInfo` with "unknown op"; the home now says **old** (`DucterFolderView.old` on `task_new_options.ducterFolders`, reason `old` on `folder_browse_result`, `project_add_result` and `project_clone_result`) instead of D203's English sentence, and both cards show one greyed row in place of its Find and clone rows: **{computer} 上的 Ducter 需要更新 / Ducter on {computer} needs an update** with **到「设备」里更新它，就能在那儿找文件夹、从 Git 地址加。/ Update it in Devices to find folders or add from a Git address there.**; a failed look or add there says **{computer} 上的 Ducter 需要更新，才能这样做。/ Ducter on {computer} needs an update for this.** (6) **The phone and the Mac card behave the same** in the situations reviewed (table in `design/new-task.md`): hel + the Mac, this Mac alone, a worker away, an older worker, a first run with no folders. Alternatives considered: keep scanning, with a setting for which folders (still a guess the user must correct, and it reads folders they didn't offer); the hidden `~/.ducter/worktrees` with a visible link folder (two names for one folder, as D198 found); cloning from the client (a phone has no git, and the credentials belong on the computer that holds the code). | U (2026-11-11, "按建议") | `packages/protocol/src/{ducter-folder,clone,repos,index}.ts`, `packages/runner/src/{places,integrate,worker-host}.ts`, `packages/core/src/{newtask,core,ws,projects,main}.ts`, `packages/cli/src/{firstrun,main,uninstall,i18n}.ts`, `packages/soak/src/run.ts`, `apps/web/src/{app,newtask,i18n-starts}.ts(x)`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/demo-clone.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol,store,hints,i18n}`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/{newtask,newtaskfind,newtaskclone,app}.go`, tests `packages/protocol/test/ducter-folder.test.ts`, `packages/runner/test/{worker-repos,integrate,slug,runner}.test.ts`, `packages/core/test/{found-repos,new-task}.test.ts`, `packages/cli/test/{uninstall,firstrun}.test.ts`, `apps/web/test/clone-folder.test.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/newtaskclone_test.go`, `design/{new-task,where,product-model,system,build-and-run,onboarding,todo,scenarios}.md`, `design/flows/A-setup-devices.md`, `docs/{getting-started,faq,devices}.md` |

## 2026-11-11: The persona connects itself, with one tap (Mem PR #9996, "existing-role connection"; the author: "bridge 是有开关的对吧？在 ducter 里")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D205 | **Built 2026-11-11, behind a capability check: with nmem 0.10.118 or later on the home, Settings › 伙伴 › 你的其他 AI connects the persona to the user's other AI agents in one tap, and that connection turns Bridge on without `DUCTER_BRIDGE=1`.** *Who:* the heavy multi-agent developer (the author first, D171's refusal); the consumer and fresh user never see it until Mem is in and connectable. *Feel:* before, a 403 and three commands only the author could run; after, one tap that says exactly what it does, and a plain line with the step in Mem when Mem says no. (1) **What changed in Mem** (DOCUMENTED, nowledge-co/mem#9996, tag v0.10.118-rc2, Cloud side deployed; not in a public nmem yet): an ordinary Mem login may represent an existing identity it holds, `nmem bridge connections connect --space-id <id> --agent-id <agent> [--context <name>]`, with `connections list --space-id <id> [--agent-id]` and `connections revoke <connection id>`, and four registered 403 codes for own-role prerequisites. Interfaces only in `research/private/37b` (closed source). (2) **Ducter finds the persona's context itself** (closes D170 (9)'s first criterion): `nmem --version` ≥ 0.10.118 (a pre-release counts) or `bridge connections --help` exits 0, cached per version; passive `bridge setup` (no context, no Space, never `--enable`) lists the user's places, and exactly one with `kind: "personal"` ("Only me", D171) is used by its exact id, none or two: nothing is offered (**no_space**). The identity is the persona's Mem identity (D141, `ducter`); the context is that name (`DUCTER_BRIDGE_CONTEXT` overrides it). (3) **On the user's tap only**, Ducter runs `nmem --json bridge connections connect --space-id <that id> --agent-id <identity> --context <ctx>`, checks the answer (`state: connected`, the same `agent_id`, `state: active`, the same Space), then passive `--agent-context <ctx> bridge setup` to confirm it acts as that identity, and keeps `<dataDir>/bridge-connection.json`. Unconfirmed: the row says so and Bridge stays off. Once per start, `connections list` drops a connection revoked elsewhere. (4) **Refusals, never a fallback:** `cloud_bridge_setup_role_authority_missing`, `_role_custody_birth_missing`, `_role_lifetime_inactive`, `_role_attachment_mismatch` (the four), plus `_role_control_denied`, `_connection_revoked`, `_binding_conflict`, each a plain zh/en line naming the step the user takes in Mem (ask the workspace owner; no new identity or key) and **再试一次 / Try again**; no other identity, place, key, `select-cloud` or `--enable` is tried. (5) **The words** (glossary): the row **{name} 跟你的其他 AI 连上 / Connect {name} with your other AI agents**; ready **用你在这台电脑上的 Nowledge Mem 登录，以「ducter」的身份收发，只在「Only me」里，只有你能看到。** with the literal `ducter · Only me · <id>` under it; **连上 / Connect** · **在连… / Connecting…** · connected **连上了：以「ducter」的身份，在「Only me」里。断开后它不再收，也不再发。** · **断开 / Disconnect**, which asks once (**断开后要再连上，可能得先在 Nowledge Mem 里处理。确定断开？** · **先不 / Not now**: Mem keys a CLI connection by login and identity, so a revoked one may not reconnect by itself, INFERRED) · an older Mem: only **要先在 {home} 上更新 Nowledge Mem，才能跟你的其他 AI 连上。** Never "Bridge", "Space", "mailbox", "contact". (6) **Two levels, both always findable** (the author's follow-up): the section shows whenever the home's Mem can connect the persona or needs updating to, not only after another agent wrote (amends D170 (6)'s J6 gate for Mem users; a user without Mem still never meets it). **断开 / Disconnect** is the whole thing: no checks, nothing sent, the tools gone. **谁能找到 {name} › 谁都不行** is the reach: no other agent reaches the partner, while what the user asks it to send on a card still goes and its answer comes back (checks run only while such a message waits for an answer, at most 7 days; every other message is logged muted; amends D170 (7)'s "no check at all"). Its note says so: **谁都不行：别的 AI 找不到 {name}；你让它发的消息照样能发，回复也会带回来。** (7) **No restart:** the partner's Bridge tools are listed only while it is on, `task_open`/`ask` show `forMessage` only then, and a change starts a fresh session at the next turn. `DUCTER_BRIDGE=1` + `DUCTER_BRIDGE_CONTEXT` still forces it on (tests, the fake, a context made by hand; the row shows it pinned, no 断开); `DUCTER_BRIDGE=0` forces it off. (8) **The live trial:** `bun run bridge:live -- --connected` is a dry, read-only preflight (version, the one personal place, the connection in Mem's list, passive setup); with `--real` it binds the peer's own `claude -p --session-id <id>` natively (`nmem bridge session --host claude-code --session-id <id> prepare`) instead of a second identity with a key, and runs S1, S2, S3 and an X1 round trip, raw output kept as before. (9) **Not decided here:** D170 (9)'s "on by default" still waits for that live run; until then nothing turns on without the user's tap | U (the request; the follow-up "bridge 是有开关的对吧？"), L (Mem #9996, research/37 §8, private/37b) | `packages/core/src/bridge-link.ts`, `packages/core/src/{core,ws,settings,mcp}.ts`, `packages/partner/src/{bridge,partner}.ts`, `packages/protocol`, `packages/partner/eval/{fake-bridge-nmem,bridge-live}.ts`, `apps/web/src/{views.tsx,app.ts,i18n.ts}`, `apps/web/demo-bridge.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{views/peers.go,protocol,store,i18n}`, tests, `design/bridge.md`, glossary, `design/todo.md` |
| D209 | **Built 2026-11-11, measured before and after; for the author's review on a real iPad against hel. The apps open on the last screen at once and catch up from the home in the background; a layout change never waits on a frame.** (the author, iPad app, home on hel: "第二栏的全屏点击之后好几秒才全屏", "app 每次一打开的时候数据加载都过几秒，闪烁一下没有数据的界面", and whether a pure web client is good enough engineering). (1) **Who, what they feel, how it starts.** Every user of the phone, iPad and Android apps, most of all the heavy developer whose home is a server abroad: before, each open was a loading screen, then an empty conversation and "Nothing on hand", then the data (a messaging app that forgets your chats every time feels broken, not slow); after, the conversation and On hand are the first frame, exactly as left, and what's new slides in a second later. Nothing to learn or set up. (2) **Full screen took 4.0–4.1 s, all of it a timeout:** D184's morph waited for a frame inside the view transition's update callback, and WebKit holds frames there until its 4 s timeout (headless Chromium, where D184 was checked, gives them). The callback now waits for a timer after Preact's microtask render: the new layout paints in 20–60 ms, the 320 ms morph is done in 0.35–0.41 s. (3) **Opening waited on five round trips in series** (the page, its code and styles revalidated, `/api/me`, the socket, hello → replay) with nothing of its own to show. Now: (a) **the last screen is kept on the device** (`glance.ts`: the channel's newest 400 events, On hand, the empty conversation's words, who the device is; localStorage, read synchronously; saved a moment after each change and when the page hides; ≤ 1.5 MB) and painted before the socket opens; hello carries **the cursor it holds**, so the home sends only what's newer (the reconnect replay); a replay as long as the home sends at once (5000) starts over fresh; a revoked device or a Log that started over forgets it; it is kept per device, so another pairing never reads it; until the home answers, the header keeps the line it showed rather than "connecting"; (b) **nothing waits on `/api/me`**: a paired device starts the socket and paints at once, who it is arrives alongside (a 401 still goes to pairing); (c) **code and styles are named by content** (`app.js?v=<hash>`, `immutable`), so a launch never revalidates them; (d) **the apps open the page from their cache** (iOS `returnCacheDataElseLoad`; Android `LOAD_CACHE_ELSE_NETWORK` for that load), only for a home whose page names its code by content; once caught up the page asks for the page again in the background and reloads when it names other code, under the stale-version rule (once per build, nothing lost); the page tells the app whether the home answered (`reach`), so a home it can't reach still brings up the can't-reach screen; (e) on iOS the web view stays laid out under the loading screen and is uncovered once its safe-area insets have arrived (a cached page painted before them and jumped); (f) messages are turned into HTML once, not on every frame. (4) **Measured** (research/57; a scratch home with 160 exchanges and 7 tasks, 200 ms RTT through a proxy): WebKit, the conversation visible at 1487–1722 ms on a warm open → 260–265 ms (the first frame), the empty screen 850–870 ms → none, caught up 1489–1725 → 1032–1039 ms; a first ever open unchanged (~2.3 s). iPad Pro 13" simulator, a relaunch: loading screen to 2.4 s, empty page to 3.5 s, then the data → the data at ~1.3 s after the launch animation, no empty page. (5) **Not a service worker, not a bundle inside the app:** WKWebView runs service workers only for App-Bound Domains fixed in the app (a home is any address); a bundled page would sit on another origin (storage, CSP, pairing all rebuilt) and help only the first open. (6) **Native vs web:** both faults were engineering inside the hybrid. It stays, held to a measured bar: the conversation in the first frame on open, a layout change painted within 100 ms, every interaction under 100 ms to its first visible response; next if a real device misses it: start the web view at app launch, split the bundle, virtualize a long transcript; native is reconsidered only if a measured interaction on a real device still misses the bar after those. | U (2026-11-11), R56 | `apps/web/src/{glance,app,main,markdown,native}.ts(x)`, `packages/core/src/web.ts`, `apps/ios/Ducter/{WebShell,DucterApp}.swift`, `apps/android` (`MainActivity.kt`, `Store.kt`), `apps/web/test/glance.test.ts`, `packages/core/test/web.test.ts`, `design/system.md`, `design/scenarios.md`, `design/todo.md`, `docs/phone.md`, research/57 |

## 2026-11-11: Pictures in the conversation and in a task (the author: "做最优雅实现吧"; "要优雅一些，极度顺滑方便用户浏览查看，体验拉满")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D206 | **Built 2026-11-11 (phase 1). Pictures go both ways: the user sends them to the partner, to an opened task and with a New task's words; a task shows the user what it made (a screenshot, a picture it generated, a file) and the partner relays it under its words; "画一张… / Draw…" is a task only an agent that makes pictures takes.** *Who:* all three; the consumer first (a messaging app that can't take a photo feels broken), the developer next (⌘V a screenshot into a task). *Feel:* before, a picture described in words and a path in Details; after, the picture itself, up before Send, opening big with a tap. *First time:* the picture button where every messaging app has it; paste and drop just work. (1) **Sending.** Composer, task composer and the New task card's What row: **加图片 / Add images** (the phone's own sheet: library, camera, files; the Mac's open panel), paste and drop (**松手就加上 / Drop to add**); up to 10 (**一次最多 10 张 / Up to 10 at a time**); pictures only for now (**现在只能发图片 / Only images can be sent for now**). The sending device scales to 2048 px, re-encodes (JPEG ~0.85; a screenshot stays PNG, a GIF stays moving; HEIC becomes JPEG), which drops EXIF and so the location, and makes the 720 px tile and a ~16 px preview. The upload starts when a picture is picked (a thin ring on its thumbnail), so Send is instant; a message waits for its pictures, and one that didn't go up keeps its words and picture with **没发出去 · 重试 / Didn't send · Retry**. (2) **Store and wire.** Content-addressed `<dataDir>/media/<sha256>.<ext>` plus a small `.json`; the home never decodes or re-encodes a picture (no pure, fast image library for Bun; `sharp` breaks `bun build --compile`; every sender has a canvas or Go's `image`): type and pixel size from the header, EXIF orientation honoured. `POST /api/media` behind the gate (25 MB, same origin); `GET /media/<id>?k=` before the gate, the key an HMAC of the id with the home's secret, immutable; `&dl=1` downloads. Frames carry ids (`send`, `task_send`, `task_new` `.media`), the Log carries `MediaRef`s (`user_msg`, `ai_msg`, `task_open`, `task_event`, `report`), never bytes. (3) **To the models.** OAR `images` (files on the home; a worker's session gets the bytes): the partner sees the user's pictures and up to 4 a task showed, named in its line by a 12-hex id; `task_open`/`task_send` `.media` hand them on (none named: the latest message's go with the brief). An agent that can't see pictures (DeepSeek Harness, OAR `capabilities.images` false; `HarnessInfo.images`) gets the words and a line; with pictures on the New task card it shows **看不了图片 / Can't see images**. The partner's image generation stays off. (4) **From tasks.** `report_to_main.show` (≤ 6 paths): only from the task's folder, its evidence folder or `$CODEX_HOME/generated_images` (research/56), links resolved; read where it runs, copied in, on the report as `media`; what can't be shown is a line back to the task. The reports that woke a turn put their media under the partner's first words (`ai_msg.media`), once. Browser briefs say `show` for screenshots. (5) **Drawing.** `needs.draw`: only an agent with `draws` (Codex, `image_generation` kept on for tasks only) takes it; the others are blocked with **画不了图 / Can't make pictures**; none anywhere and the open fails, and the partner says drawing needs Codex signed in on one of their computers. (6) **Showing** (`gridLayout`, the same in TS and Go): one at its own shape (21:9…1:3) within ~70% of the column and ~a third of the screen; 2 side by side; 3 as one tall and two stacked; 4 as 2×2; more as four with **+n**. Space kept from the ref's size; the blurred preview fades to the picture. Files: one line, icon, name, size, **打开 / Open**. The viewer grows out of the tile onto the theme's paper (a fade under reduced motion): pinch and double-tap zoom, swipe through the conversation's (or the task's) pictures, swipe down or Esc back into the tile; **保存 / Save** (the share sheet on a phone), **分享 / Share**, **拷贝 / Copy**, **来自 {task} / From {task}**. Mac: Space, ←/→, Esc, ⌘C, drag out to Finder. (7) **Shells.** iPhone: Info.plist names the camera, the library and adding to Photos. Android: a chooser (several at once, the camera first when allowed) and Save to Downloads. (8) **Later** (todo): files and PDFs from the user and a share sheet into Ducter (phase 2); video, reply to a message, link previews (phase 3). *Defaults the author may revisit:* 2048 px / JPEG 0.85; 25 MB; 10 per message, 6 per report; the viewer on the theme's paper, not black; the user's latest pictures go to a task the partner opens when it names none. | The author's brief (2026-11-11); research/56 | `design/media.md`, product-model glossary, `design/ui.md` (tokens), `design/quiet-conversation.md`, scenarios C7, `docs/pictures.md`, todo |

## 2026-11-11: The opened task's bugs from a hel run, and its words (the author: 「我们的很多文案怪怪的」)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D207 | **Built 2026-11-11. No task ever works in Ducter's own data folder; the opened task says the runner's lines in the user's words, keeps quiet when nothing is worth saying, and its actions and labels are words a fresh user reads at a glance.** *Who:* all three; the run was the author's (a hel home, Codex, 「排查电话只播放开场白的问题」). *Feel:* before, a task rewrote the partner's own `state.json`, a sent message stayed in the box, English plumbing and a wrong 在浏览器里操作 sat in the transcript, and 先停 / 放下 / 它收到了，接着做 read oddly; after, it works in a folder of its own and the page reads like a person wrote it. (1) **Ducter's data folder is never a place** (root cause: the partner passed its own working directory, `<dataDir>/partner`, as `place.folder`; nothing checked it, and the folder copy then kept and could undo Ducter's own files). `isDucterData(path, dataDir)` (`protocol/src/ducter-folder.ts`, symlinks resolved) is the data folder or anything in it, except the Ducter folder when it lives there (`<dataDir>/ducter`, a test's or a second Ducter's) and the old `<dataDir>/worktrees`. The runner's `planPlace` refuses such a folder, repo or worktree before the task exists, on every computer (`DucterDataError`); the partner's `task_open` refuses it first, with no ack, job line or task, in one line that points to `{"kind":"none"}`, so it opens again with no place and gets `<dataDir>/scratch/<taskId>` (the one way into the data folder, made by the runner); a path there in the user's words is never taken as the place. New task says **这是 Ducter 自己放数据的文件夹，任务不在这里做。换一个文件夹，或者选「不用文件夹」。/ That is where Ducter keeps its own data, so no task works there. Pick another folder, or No folder.** (`reason: ducter_data`). The folder copy (D142) is never kept for such a folder (`holds_ducter`), and Undo refuses to put its files back (a task opened before this). No persona or tool-description change: the refusal is the tool's answer, so no eval was run (D175). (2) **The composer empties on send** (Mac: Enter ran after the frame had stored its draft, so the next frame put the words back; the stored draft is emptied too). The web reads what is typed now, not the render's copy. A held message (it looks like a key) stays until it is sent. (3) **The runner's lines in words** (root cause: the transcript showed every system line's English text, "no report after one nudge; leaving the task idle (stall rule)" among them). `noteOf` (`transcript.ts`, its Go port, one fixture) maps a line to a key by its `raw` fields, the clients word `note.<say>`: the stall, a computer gone and back (`raw.name` now logged), waiting for one, a fresh session, a switch, an effort left out, the browser guard and fallback, and four failures under **出错 / Error** (the line as logged on hover only); everything else (session started, memory recalled, retries, archiving, a restart, a harness exit) says nothing. The blocked reason "Claude in Chrome isn't connected" is a key too (`browser:native_missing`). (4) **在浏览器里操作 only for a browser** (root cause: a stretch with any `browsed` step was browse, and `curl` is `browsed · request`): a request or a fetch is a command that reads a page; a stretch of shell commands with a curl is **跑了几条命令 / Ran commands**. (5) **Changes for a folder** were right for an ordinary folder; with (1) Ducter's own never get there. (6) **The words, old → new** (zh / en; reasons): header 先停 / Pause → **暂停 / Pause** (先停 asks "stop first, then what?"; 暂停 is everyone's word and the routines'); 放下 / Drop → **不做了 / Cancel task** (放下 reads as setting it aside for later, but it ends the task; Drop is jargon), so the state 放下了 / Dropped → **不做了 / Cancelled** and the toast 放下了「X」/ Dropped "X" → **「X」不做了 / Cancelled "X"**; the receipts 它收到了，接着做 / Got it; it's on it and 它正在做，已经告诉它了 / Told it while it works → **nothing** (proactive restraint: the live line already shows it at work), 等它忙完手上的就告诉它 / It'll get this once it finishes what it's doing → **它忙完手上的就看 / It'll read this once it's done with what it's doing** (what the user needs: when it will see it), 正在送过去… → **在发…** (Sending… kept); the composer 直接跟这件事说 / Talk to this task → **直接跟它说… / Message it directly…** (you talk to the one doing it, not to a 事); the brief 你交代的事 · {name} 交代的事 (and 你交代的 · {name} 交代的) → **你交给它的事 · {name} 交给它的事** (交代 is a boss instructing; partners hand work over, as D196 dropped 交代一件事; en kept); 说完了，等你回话 → **该你了** (Over to you kept); while a folder task works 等它做完，随时能改回去 / You can undo this once it's done → **它做完后，可以全部改回去 / You can undo all of it once it's done** (two clauses that fought); the stall line → **它停下了，没交回结果 / It stopped without reporting back**; the rest of the runner's lines in the glossary. Checked and kept: the meta line 在做 · 5:36 · Codex · … · 在 {computer} 上 · 换谁来做 › (its "partner" was the folder's name, `<dataDir>/partner`, gone with (1)), 出错, n 处出错, 运行 pwd 出错, 改动, 改回去 / 就这样. Runner-up for (1): move scratch out of the data folder into the Ducter folder, deferred (`todo.md`): the per-task scratch is Ducter-made and empty, and moving it touches every place-less task's recovery | U (the author's screenshots, 2026-11-11) | `packages/protocol/src/{ducter-folder,transcript,index}.ts`, `packages/protocol/fixtures/transcript*`, `packages/runner/src/{places,folder,runner}.ts`, `packages/partner/src/{partner,place}.ts`, `packages/core/src/newtask.ts`, `apps/web/src/{transcript.tsx,views.tsx,app.ts,where.ts,i18n.ts}`, `apps/desktop/internal/{views,i18n}`, tests, `design/{product-model,focus-window,system,ui,todo}.md`, `docs/privacy-and-safety.md` |

## 2026-11-12: Is Ducter's Nowledge Mem integration done the way Mem intends? (the author)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D229 | **Mem the way Mem says: recall reads the identity's own lane, the home's `nmem` goes in with pipx, a copy past the system's mark moves there in one tap, and every Mem switch says plainly what happens. Built 2026-11-12 with fakes in nmem 0.10.118's real shapes; not yet run on hel. (D228 is taken by the From-anywhere branch.)** Audit in research/69 (nmem 0.10.118 help and `--json` shapes, plugin 0.7.36 skills and hooks, mem.nowledge.co docs, hel read-only). (1) **Recall reads the identity's lane (M1, M2):** an AI Identity carries "a default space for memory reads and writes"; Mem's plugin reads it for an `NMEM_AGENT_ID` (`agents show` → `defaultSpaceId`, then `--space-id`). The persona's identity keeps its lane (`MemIdentity.lane`, from `agents show`, camelCase as 0.10.118 answers), read again on each start. With no Space the user chose, the partner's search runs twice in parallel: where saves land (no Space: Only me in a team workspace) and `--space-id <lane>`, merged by id and Mem's score; one failing still gives the other's hits. A Space the user chose stays the only one. Writes are unchanged: `--agent-id`, Mem decides where it lands. Measured on the author's workspace: the two reads shared no hit. (2) **Install pipx first (M3):** pipx → uv → pipx from the system's own package manager when that needs no password (Homebrew; apt or dnf as root or with `sudo -n`, never a password prompt) → pip into the user's site only when that Python isn't marked externally managed (asked once with a short Python probe). (3) **The move (M4):** a pip copy in the user's site under a marked Python (hel) is moved to pipx: get pipx if needed, the old copy out (`pip uninstall`, past the mark: it is the copy that was put there so), `pipx install --force nmem-cli` in; if that fails, the old copy goes back. The sign-in (`~/.nowledge-mem/config.json`) is never touched. It is the update when the copy is too old for Bridge, and a quiet offer under any working state otherwise. Without any pipx route, the old in-place update stays the fallback. A copy under an unmarked Python stays. (4) **Mem's own "newer version" (M9):** `status.update.update_available` offers a quiet **更新 / Update** from the copy's own source. (5) **Tasks (M6):** a task also gets `NMEM_CLI_PATH` when Ducter has one (the plugin's own rule); the lane is left to the plugin. (6) **nmem's environment (M7, M8):** the three places that spawned nmem with Ducter's whole environment use D102's allowlist; installers get the basics plus their own `PIP_/PIPX_/UV_/HOMEBREW_`; the identity bundle is read with `--source-app ducter`. (7) **Copy (the author's North star for every Mem switch):** one calm line per state with its next action; no pipx, PEP 668 or key on the main line, the how behind **细节 / Details** or **怎么装 / How**; progress in place (**正在换… / Moving…**); a failure says it plainly, whether the old copy still works (**原来那份还在，照常能用，登录也还在。**) and offers **再试一次 / Try again**; success is a short warm line in the done colour (**{home} 上换好了。登录还在，什么都没丢。 / Moved on {home}. Still signed in, nothing lost.**); turning memory off says what stops and what stays (**…已经记下的都还在 Nowledge Mem 里，一条没删；再打开，马上接着用。**). Web (phone and wide) and the Mac app the same; zh and en together. Kept on purpose: tasks never save memories themselves (D168 (5)) although the plugin's startup text invites it; no thread search in partner recall yet (todo). | U (the author's question and the North-star brief), L, research/69 | `packages/core/src/{mem-cli,bridge-link,mem-identity,persona,main}.ts`, `packages/partner/src/memory.ts`, `packages/runner/src/runner.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/{index,internal}.ts`, `apps/web/src/{views.tsx,app.ts,i18n.ts}`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/demo-bridge.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/protocol.go,i18n/i18n.go,views/peers.go}`, tests (`core/test/{bridge-link,mem-identity,persona}.test.ts`, `partner/test/memory.test.ts`, `runner/test/memory.test.ts`, Go `bridge_test.go`), `design/{bridge,memory,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/faq.md` |

| D210 | **Built 2026-11-11 (web: phone and wide; Mac), for the author's review. The opened task reads as a conversation with the agent, turn by turn, the way a coding agent's chat does: what was said to it, then its answer in order, its words and every step as one compact line between them, an edit with its diff and a failure with its error in place, and one line over the composer that says where it stands.** *Who:* the heavy developer first (they read a task the way they read Claude Code or Codex: which commands ran, which files changed, what failed), and the fresh user, who reads the agent's words, sees a red line only for a real failure and never needs to open anything. *Feel:* before, loose paragraphs and one gist line per stretch ("在浏览器里操作 · 15 步 › 运行 pwd 出错") that hid the commands and edits and said failures that were already fixed; after, a page that reads like the agent's own run, calm, dense where it is work and roomy where it is words, and that says at the bottom what it is doing now. *First time:* nothing to learn; the brief is the first thing in it, and every line that holds more has a chevron. (1) **Turns.** A turn opens with what someone said to the agent: the brief (你交给它的事 / {name} 交给它的事, the quiet sunken card, three lines until 展开, D207), your words (your bubble), or what the partner passed on ({name} 对它说, the same card); everything after it until the next is the agent's answer. Shared model: `turnsOf(blocksOf(…))` (`packages/protocol/src/transcript.ts`, its Go port, `fixtures/transcript.json` now holds turns). (2) **Every step is its own line** (as coding-agent chats do it): its drawn mark, its sentence (D152's: the agent's own words, else a verb and a summary), **the command beside the agent's words in mono and muted ink** (`Run the glance cache tests  bun test apps/web/test/glance.test.ts`; the words keep their room, the command is cut first), an edit's **+n −n** in the done and failed inks, ×n for a repeat, a chevron only when it opens. **Only consecutive looks fold** (reads, searches, probes, a request that reads a page): **看了 3 个文件，搜了 2 次 / Read 3 files, 2 searches**, open on a tap; a lone look is its own line. Consecutive steps sit tight; words and steps 12 apart; turns 24 apart. (3) **An edit's diff, inline, from the edit itself**: the edit tool's input (Claude Code's Edit / MultiEdit / Write, Codex's apply_patch and fileChange, any old/new strings or patch) as lines, put in on the done tint, taken out on the failed tint, two lines of context, "@@ path" when it touched several files, at most 60 lines then **还有 n 行 / n more lines** (`editdiff.ts`, `editdiff.go`); no git, so it works for a folder, a server or another computer. The task's 改动 / Changes (D74, D128) stay under the transcript as the whole run's result. (4) **A failure in place**: the row in the failed ink with **出错 / Error**, and under it the line of its output that names the error (`✗ glance > paints On hand…`, `error TS2339 …`, else its last line; `failLine`); its output on a tap. A probe that finds nothing stays neutral (D152). (5) **Output** opens under a step: `$ command`, then the first 12 lines, **还有 n 行 / n more lines** for the rest (the model keeps 40). (6) **The foot over the composer** says where it stands: while it works, a spinner, **在做 / Working**, the clock (D152's one clock moves here while it works; the meta line says **用了 {duration}** once finished) and its latest step in words, with **暂停 / Pause** at the end; when it's over to you, **该你了 · 它停在这儿了。回它一句，它就接着做。** (D152, D207); silent otherwise (the outcome is at the head). Pause leaves the head (the Mac's header, the phone's row) for the foot; 不做了 / Cancel task stays. (7) **Esc twice pauses** a task at work (in its composer too): the first Esc turns the foot into **再按一次 Esc 就暂停 / Press Esc again to pause** with **接着做 / Keep going** and **暂停 / Pause**, for 3 s; otherwise Esc still goes up a level. **⌘↩ sends** everywhere (a keyboard on an iPad included), Enter as before. (8) **Queued**: your words sent while it is busy read **排队中 · 它忙完手上的就看 / Queued · It'll read this once it's done with what it's doing**, lighter, until it answers; then nothing (D207's restraint). (9) **Scrolling**: a task that works or waits on you opens at its latest, a finished one at its head (the outcome); while it works a reader at the end follows the newest; one who scrolled up stays, with **回到最新 / Jump to latest**, a round raised button (no pill, D73). (10) **Long tasks**: blocks are built once per change of the task's events (web: a cache per task; Mac: per frame, measured 7 ms a frame with 423 events in the test renderer), each turn redrawn only when its own blocks change (web), settled turns `content-visibility: auto`; the latest turns up to 240 lines are drawn and older ones wait behind **显示更早的 n 步 / Show n earlier steps** (the last turn always whole). D209's glance cache is unchanged (it keeps events; the page builds from them). (11) **Pictures (D206) stay**, small in a turn (about 15 rem / 240 pt wide, a tap opens the viewer); the outcome's as before. (12) **English step words start on a capital** now that each is a line ("Opened appstoreconnect.apple.com in Chrome", "Pressed ⌘T in Chrome"; the open and fetch words gained their verbs). *Taken from coding-agent chats:* one line per step with only looks folded, turns from what was said to it, queued messages at the end, bounded output with "+N", chevrons only where something opens, the hover row, follow-the-end with a small threshold, bounding data at the source. *Not taken:* its look (symbols, colours, sizes, cards, the sheet), tense-shifting verbs, polling, red for every non-zero exit. *Defaults the author may revisit:* the 240-line window; Esc twice (vs. once) because Esc also goes up a level; the command shown beside the agent's own words; the outcome's picture size. Runner-up for (2): keep D152's gist and open it by default, rejected because a gist line is still a summary that can be wrong and the author asked for a coding agent's page | U (2026-11-11) | `packages/protocol/src/{transcript,editdiff}.ts`, `packages/protocol/fixtures/transcript*`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/{transcript,editdiff,taskturns,tasksteps,task,app,media}.go`, `apps/desktop/internal/i18n/{turns,i18n}.go`, `apps/web/src/{transcript.tsx,views.tsx,wide.ts,app.ts,i18n.ts}`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/demo-transcript.ts`, tests, `design/{focus-window,ui,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/tasks.md` |

## 2026-11-11: Phone calls, after the first real test (the author's test from Japan: "马上" was held to the morning, a call that reached Google Voice was called "refused")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D208 | **Settled 2026-11-11 (built; the author's first real calls, defaults taken overnight). "Now" means now when the owner asks; the callee's hours are a courtesy the owner may pass, never a hard limit's; outcomes say what really happened.** *Who:* the author testing calls to their own Google Voice number while the person it stood for was at an expo in Japan; then any owner who says "现在打". *Before:* told "明天 8:00" twice after saying 马上, then that "the calling service forced it to tomorrow" (false: it was Ducter's rule), and "没打出去，服务商拒绝了" for a call that connected. *After:* the card says why it waits in the callee's clock and offers 现在就打; the outcome line says it got through and Google Voice's screening answered, and how to fix that. (1) **The owner's 免打扰 holds only calls nobody just asked for:** a call the owner asks for in the conversation (the partner's turn holds their message, or their reply on a card), or a Go they are tapping, may start now in their quiet hours; a time Ducter picks later (a task's call, a Go that waits) still respects them (`nextAllowed` `present`). (2) **The callee's 9:00–20:00 is a courtesy:** when it alone moves a call the owner just asked for, the card says why in their clock (**对方那边现在 20:03，我排到了对方的 9:00。 / It's 20:03 where they are, so I set it for 9:00 their time.**), Go reads **到点再打 / Call then**, and **现在就打 / Call now** sits beside the reason (frame `call_now`; `decision_resolved.now`). Such a draft carries no `scheduledAt`: Ducter holds the hour, so Call now can dial at once. (3) **8:00–21:00 where they are is never crossed**, even on Call now (the TCPA's calling hours, 47 CFR 64.1200(c)(1), are for solicitations, which Ducter never makes; Ducter keeps them for every call as its own floor). Past 21:00 the card says **太晚了 / too late to call** and offers no Call now. (4) **The owner's own number has no callee hours:** the partner passes `own` when the owner says the number is theirs, and their saved phone in Your details (D191) counts too. (5) **Zones:** a +1 number is read by its area code (a table of ~400 NANP codes, two zones where a code spans a line; unknown and toll-free codes fall back to the four continental zones); the partner passes `calleeZone` only when it knows where the person is now. The partner's tool answer says the time is Ducter's own rule and never the provider's; the persona says so in one clause. (6) **Outcomes from `tuwa_call_result`'s words, not its status alone:** a machine that answered (voicemail, call screening, "the subscriber you have called is not available") is a new ended state, **转到了自动语音 / Got an automated message**; nobody picking up is **没人接 / No answer**; a dialed call that failed is **没打通 / Didn't connect** with the provider's words (reason `call_failed`; "Tuwa 没说原因 / Tuwa gave no reason" when it gave none); **没打出去 / Didn't go through** stays for calls never placed, and "refused" only for a real refusal, with its words. A cancel at the provider (not the owner's) is a failure with "cancelled at the provider". (7) **Google Voice's call screening** (it announces "call from …" to its owner and says "not available" unless they press 1) is recognised from the words and said with the fix: **接起来按 1，或者在 Google Voice 设置里关掉「过滤来电」 / answer and press 1, or turn off Screen calls in Google Voice settings** (`hint: screening`). (8) **A confirm that errors may have placed the call:** Ducter reads the call's status by the draft's id before anything else; placed or held → it goes on (never a second yes); still waiting for its yes → the existing re-approval (same summary only); unreadable → failed as **lost**, "不确定打出去没有，先去 Tuwa 里看一眼再重打 / Not sure it went out: check Tuwa before trying again". (9) **The card and the phone card, polished:** the plan gains **不能做 / Won't do** (the owner's own don'ts); Tuwa's approval text folds under **Tuwa 的原话（英文） / Tuwa's own wording**, as label/value lines with labels in the owner's words and values as Tuwa wrote them; no status dots or pulses on any call surface (D69); On hand's ended rows open in place only when there is more to read; Settings › 账号's card: today in words (**今天还没打 / No calls today**), the cap's help (**到了就不再打；Tuwa 那边也按这个封顶。**), and **Ducter 在 Tuwa 上替你关了 / Ducter turned these off on Tuwa** with one ✓ line each (**Tuwa 不采集你的声音样本**, **不向 Tuwa 好友同步你的近况**) instead of "声音采样已暂停 · 好友同步已关". *Alt considered:* let the owner's words ("now") skip every hour rule. Rejected: a stranger called at 23:00 by an AI is the one outcome no "now" should buy; 8:00–21:00 is the line. *Verified:* unit tests with a fake Tuwa (`phone.test.ts`), the partner eval (`call-ended-screening-zh` added). *Inferred:* Tuwa's real outcome words (only the author's one call, as summarised to us), whether Tuwa itself refuses a call past 20:00 in the callee's zone, and Google Voice's menu name | U (the author's test call, 2026-11-11) | `packages/core/src/{phone,phone-provider,nanp,core,ws}.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/{phone,index}.ts`, `packages/partner/src/{partner,persona}.ts`, `apps/web/src/{phone.tsx,i18n-phone.ts,app.ts}`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol,views,i18n}/phone*.go`, `design/phone.md`, `design/product-model.md`, `docs/calls.md` |

## 2026-11-12: No emoji, and a quality pass over every screen (the author, on 0.0.23: "新建 focus window 的界面居然有 emoji?? 这也太低质量了吧？…不会还有别的这种低水准的设计吧？")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D211 | **Built 2026-11-12, for the author's review. Nothing a person reads is ever an emoji or a symbol the phone can't draw as text: marks are drawn glyphs, keys and states are words or symbols seen drawn as text on iOS, and a guard in every test run keeps it so. The same pass looked at every screen on the iOS Simulator and fixed what was clearly below the bar.** *Who:* all three; the author saw it on their own device in the New task sheet. *Felt:* a template's emoji in a product that is otherwise drawn by hand reads as cheap and careless; afterwards the sheet is words, drawn marks and clay only. (1) **Root cause, verified on the iOS 26.3 Simulator** (Mobile Safari, the app's own stylesheet, a probe page of every symbol the clients use; `.shots/quality-audit/ios-glyph-probe-*.png`): the New task foot's **⌘↩ 开始 · ⇧⌘↩ 开始并接着新建**. No text font in the stack (Bricolage Grotesque, PingFang SC, the system's) has U+21A9 ↩, so WebKit on iOS takes it from the emoji font: a colour tile among the words on a device (the Simulator, which has no emoji font in WebKit, draws the same fallback as a ? box, as it does 😀 and ✅; `newtask-keys-iphone-zh-before.png`). The line shows wherever a fine pointer exists (an iPad with a keyboard or trackpad; the Mac), so a touch-only iPhone never shows it. U+FE0E does not fix it: with it, every probed symbol (↩ ✓ ↗) became the missing-glyph box, even in JetBrains Mono, so text presentation is not something the app can ask for. The same probe found ⌄ (the find card's **怎么知道的 ⌄**) and ⓘ missing too; ✓ ✗ × → ← ↔ ↗ ⇧ ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⏎ ⋯ − ≤ ≥ ≈ ▾ ① ② draw as text. (2) **Keys:** the foot says **⌘⏎ 开始 · ⇧⌘⏎ 开始并接着新建 / ⌘⏎ Start · ⇧⌘⏎ and start another** (U+23CE, drawn as text on iOS and on the Mac), still only where a hardware keyboard is plausible (not `(pointer: coarse)` without `(any-pointer: fine)`). (3) **Marks:** a mark is a drawn glyph (views.tsx, components.go), never a font's symbol: the started line's ✓ is the drawn check; a text button that opens something in place ends in a drawn chevron that turns down while open (`Btn chev`: 怎么知道的, a call's summary and transcript, a connection's reads list, which had no chevron at all); a routine's last run is words (**上次周二做完了 / Last Tue: done**, **上次周二没成**). (4) **The guard** (`scripts/check-glyphs.ts`, run by `bun test` as `scripts/glyphs.test.ts`): it reads the web client, the Mac app, the iOS and Android shells, the site, the user docs and the core's words (comments, tests and fixtures excepted) and fails on any emoji (Extended_Pictographic, Emoji_Presentation, regional indicators), any variation selector, and any symbol from the arrow, maths, technical, enclosed, shape, miscellaneous-symbol or dingbat blocks that is not on the list seen drawn as text in (1). A symbol joins the list only after the same check on iOS. (5) **The pass** (iPhone 17 Pro and iPad Pro 11 Simulators, light and dark, zh and en, against the demo homes; the Mac's New task shots; `.shots/quality-audit/`, named by screen, before and after): the table below; what is a design call is a recommendation, not a change. Not covered this pass: the picture viewer, an empty first conversation, the Android emulator (no Android code changed; its strings are under the guard) | U (the report), L (the cause, the rule, the fixes) | `scripts/check-glyphs.ts`, `scripts/glyphs.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/{i18n-starts,i18n,controls,newtask,views,finds,phone,accounts,autofill,format}.ts(x)`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/desktop/internal/{i18n/starts.go,i18n/i18n.go,views/newtask.go}`, `apps/site/src/pages/index.astro`, `design/ui.md`, `design/product-model.md`, `design/new-task.md`, `docs/faq.md` |

**The pass, screen by screen** (fixed: built in this change on every client it applies to; recommended: the author's call).

| Screen | Finding | Fix / recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| New task, keyboard foot (iPad with a keyboard, Mac web) | ↩ from the emoji font: a tile in **⌘↩ 开始** | Fixed: **⌘⏎** (2); the guard (4) |
| New task, who pill and list | **推荐 / Suggested** on a yellow capsule: a tag pill (D73) | Fixed, web and Mac: the word in the highlight's ink, no fill |
| New task, after ⇧⌘⏎ | **✓ 开始了：「X」** with a font check | Fixed: the drawn check |
| New task, who pill; opened task meta; On hand card headings | The agent's clay coin at 16–22 points beside text reads like an emoji, the likeliest "emoji" on an iPhone, where the key line never shows | Recommended: the coin only where it stands as an object (28 points and up: the who list, the device tray, Settings); in a pill or a meta line, the agent's name alone (a change to D183's sizes) |
| Opened task, phone (every state) | The meta line wraps and its second line starts with **·** before the coin | Fixed: no dot before the coin; the coin starts the group |
| Opened task, phone | **不做了 / Cancel task** stands alone under the header, a stranded item | Recommended: in the foot beside **暂停 / Pause** (D210 moved Pause there) |
| Opened task (D210), zh | The agent's own step titles are English inside zh chrome ("Run the glance cache tests") | Recommended: the step's verb in the reader's language before the agent's words (运行 · …), as the read and edit rows already do |
| On hand and the task's decision card, zh | **fix-ci 落后 main 12 / 个提交，有 2** : `word-break: keep-all` with `text-wrap: balance` turned a sentence into short ragged lines | Fixed: a question wraps as a sentence (keep-all stays for short titles) |
| Settings › Notifications | A stray **0** under the quiet hours (`(a \|\| list.length) && …` rendered the count) | Fixed |
| Settings › Notifications, on a phone | **发通知到这台 Mac 和你连上的手机** read on the phone | Fixed on the web client: **通知你连上的手机和电脑 / on the phones and computers you connected**; the Mac keeps **这台 Mac** |
| Settings › Autofill | Add rows: a typed **+** on a peach disc (a mark on a tile, D73) | Fixed: a drawn ＋ in the row's ink |
| Conversation, the find card | **怎么知道的 ⌄**: ⌄ is a missing glyph on iOS | Fixed: the drawn chevron (3) |
| Conversation, the find card's sources | **220 小时前** | Fixed: days from a day and a half on (**9 天前**), the Mac's rule |
| Conversation, offline | **连不上 Ducter，正在重试** said twice: the header line and a yellow strip | Fixed: once, in the header under the sleeping face (already a live status) |
| Phone call card | **Tuwa 的原话（英文） ›** and **‹** as font toggles | Fixed: the drawn chevron |
| Settings › Partner, dark | Codex's charcoal coin nearly disappears on the dark ground | Recommended: a dark-theme coin with a lighter key light (tools/art/coins.py) |
| Settings › Your devices | An accent dot after a name when an update exists (D161's one static dot; a D69 tell, and it says nothing to a screen reader) | Recommended: the words **有更新 / Update** in the row's word instead |
| New task, branch pill | The branch in mono beside the folder in the sans | Recommended: keep (a code token in mono, D78); noted only |
| Text buttons | **换谁来做 ›**, **用地址和钥匙加一个 ›** use a font ›; **看细节** has the drawn chevron | Recommended: one drawn chevron for every "opens more" text button |
| The site's task mock-up | **⌄ crates/storage/…** | Fixed: ▾ |
| Demo homes | `apps/web/demo.ts` reads the machine's own `oo`, so Settings › Accounts showed the author's real accounts in shots | Recommended: a stub `oo` as `demo-phone.ts` does (those shots were deleted) |
