## 2026-11-17: Use this phone with Ducter closed or the phone locked (D331; the author, on 0.0.66 with a real Pixel Fold: "不解锁，不打开 app 就没法用")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D331 | **Built 2026-11-17 on the Android app, the home, the protocol, the web and the Mac; checked with Android unit tests, the home's socket tests with a bridge-4 fake phone (`handset-d331.test.ts`), web and Mac word tests; not yet on a real phone (the steps are in `todo.md`), not reviewed by the author.** *Who:* the consumer who taps 借给它 on their Mac while the Pixel is in their pocket (before: nothing happened until they opened Ducter on the phone, an hour on hel, and the task said a card was still asking; after: the loan starts with Ducter closed, or the phone says on its lock screen that it starts when they unlock); the developer locking the phone mid-test (before: the lock gave it back and a new card asked; after: the loan pauses and the phone asks once, after the unlock); the fresh user (nothing new to learn: Go, then their phone tells them the one thing to do). *Feel:* 顺滑 (Go is enough), 放心 (never through the lock; never resumes by itself; the lock screen shows no task title), 好用 (one tap on the phone, no new card). Evidence: research/119; the Log of task vrxcdgr9. **(1) The phone's own link holds while Android's switch for Ducter is on, lent or not** (bridge 4, `HandsetLinkService`): started by the accessibility service when it connects, by the page's hello, on screen-on and unlock, and by a loan; its token is the page's or the copy the app keeps for the device (D293); not lent its notification is a quiet **用这台手机开着 / Use this phone is on** on its own channel (the person may hide it); retries back off to a minute when not lent, and the screen coming on or the unlock retries at once; a home that refuses the device (401/403) stops it. The home prefers it (D255) and still takes the page's. It reaches the phone at once while the screen is on or the phone is picked up; in deep Doze only as far as Android lets a foreground service's socket through (research/119 §3; Battery › Unrestricted makes it sure). No FCM: a self-hosted home has no other wake path (research/119 §3). **(2) A Go on a locked phone never goes through the lock.** The phone holds it as waiting (`waiting`) and shows **解锁后，「{task}」就开始 / "{task}" starts when you unlock** (on the lock screen only **解锁后，Ducter 就开始用这台手机**), with **不借了 / Not now**; on unlock (`ACTION_USER_PRESENT`) it says so to the home, which starts the loan: nobody opens Ducter. The home keeps the states apart and says each truthfully, in the tool's words, the opened task (web and Mac) and the resolved card (**借给它了，还没开始**): the card asking (**Waiting for the user to answer the card…**); Go given, the phone locked (**借给它了：解锁你的 {phone} 就开始**); Go given, the phone out of reach (**借给它了：现在连不上你的 {phone}，连上就开始**) with why as far as known: Android limits Ducter in the background (Battery › Unrestricted), its Ducter too old to hold its own link, offline or closed, never heard since the home started; Go given, starting; lent. Fixes the tool text that said "a card is asking them" after a Go. **(3) Locking during a loan pauses it** (supersedes D253's "locking gives it back"): the pill goes, the screen may sleep, nothing runs, the loan's notification says **「{task}」暂停了** with Stop still there; the task hears it once and its tools say the phone is locked and to end the turn; no quiet or lost rule while paused (a locked phone may not answer). On unlock the task does not take control: a notification asks **还借给「{task}」吗？** with **继续借给它 / Keep lending** and **不借了 / Not now** (one tap on the phone, no new card); Keep lending carries on where it was (**{phone} answers again and is still lent to you…**), Not now ends it as the person's (`taken`; the next tool asks with one new card). Stop still gives it back at once. **The cap: a pause ends the loan after 30 minutes** (`expired`, both sides), or when the task ends. Why 30: the yes was for "a while" (用一会儿); short pauses (a test's lock, a glance at a message, a coffee) are minutes; past half an hour the person has moved on and an old yes coming back is a surprise, while a new card costs one tap; the notification after the unlock never resumes by itself anyway, so the cap only bounds how long a task waits on a phone in a pocket. Alternatives: lock gives it back (D253; the author's tests showed it breaks every lock-and-check step); resume by itself on unlock (the person may be using their phone; rejected); no cap (a forgotten loan holding a task for hours). An app before bridge 4 keeps D253's behaviour. | U (the author, 2026-11-17), research/119, D238, D253, D255, D280, D293 | `research/119-phone-link-background.md`; `design/{use-this-phone,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/phone.md`, `packages/runner/src/brief.ts`; `apps/android/app/src/main/java/co/nowledge/ducter/android/{Handset,HandsetLife,HandsetLink,HandsetPill,Notify,MainActivity}.kt`, `apps/android/app/src/main/{AndroidManifest.xml,res/values/strings.xml,res/values-zh/strings.xml}`, tests `apps/android/app/src/test/java/co/nowledge/ducter/android/{HandsetLifeTest,HandsetLinkTest}.kt`; `packages/protocol/src/{handset,index}.ts`, `packages/core/src/{handset/index,ws,core}.ts`, tests `packages/core/test/{handset-d331,handset-life}.test.ts`; `apps/web/src/{handset.tsx,i18n-handset.ts}`, `apps/web/test/handset-d331.test.ts`; `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/{handset,protocol}.go,store/phoneuse.go,i18n/handset.go,views/handset.go}`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/handset_d331_test.go` |

## 2026-11-17: Nowledge Mem, deeper: one line in the first words, a save that replaces instead of piling up, Undo, a save that waits while Mem is away, Mem's closed app, Mem in Update all (D329; the brief: "make the Nowledge Mem integration feel deep and lovely")

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D329 | **Built 2026-11-17 on the home, the partner, the protocol, the web and the Mac, checked with a stub nmem, fake Mem clients, fake installers, unit and view tests and shots (`.shots/d329/web`, `.shots/d329/mac`, zh and en, light and dark); not yet against a real Mem (the outbox's upsert key, `m supersede`, `m archive` and `m show` are Mem's documented commands, unchecked live).** *Who:* the Mem user (Cloud or the local app) whose Claude Code and Codex already write to the same Mem; the heavy developer who says the same preference twice in a month and sees two lines; the fresh user who never heard of Mem and only ever sees one quiet line. *Feel:* before, Mem was a store Ducter wrote into: the same preference saved twice was two memories, a wrong save could only be forgotten (it asks), a save while Mem was down was dropped without a word, a closed Mem app read as "not signed in", and Mem's update was its own errand outside 全部更新; after, a save that restates or changes something the partner already remembered takes its place, a wrong one is undone in one tap, a save while Mem is away waits and goes in by itself, the closed app is one line and one tap, and one tap updates everything. *First time:* nothing to learn: the Noted line in a reply's Details says what happened, in words. **(1) The first words say Mem is there, and read nothing of it** (D298's `memLine` hook, wired; D327's rule holds for every source). With memory on and the home's Mem answering signed in at the start's look (`nmem status`, read-only), one line after the greeting: **你的 Nowledge Mem 我也接上了：你跟别的 AI 交代过的习惯，用得着的时候我会想起来。/ I'm on your Nowledge Mem too: whatever you told your other AI tools about how you like things, I'll recall when it matters.**, and one start **你都记得我些什么？/ What do you remember about me?** whose tap fills the composer; sent, the partner recalls then, because it was asked. Mem is a source the person chose to share across tools, but quoting a memory at the first second is still an unprompted read on a screen that may be shared (research/115: unprompted reading was the creepiest variant). Alternatives: a line quoting what Mem holds (D298's plan; rejected for that reason), nothing (the Mem user's 惊喜 lost; they should know at once that their other tools' memory is here). **(2) Search before writing, supersede instead of duplicating.** `memory_add` asks Mem for its title (beside the write, so a save takes no longer) and, when a hit is the partner's own earlier memory (Mem `source` `ducter`, its words whole, never clipped) whose title is alike (character pairs, script-agnostic: Dice ≥ 0.6, or one title holding the other at ≥ 4 characters), links it to the new one (`nmem m supersede <old> <new>`). Another tool's memories and the person's own are never replaced from here. The Noted line says **换掉了之前那条「{title}」/ In place of “{title}”** as its own element; the partner's words never mention it. A title rule catches a restatement and the same topic said anew ("Weekly report day"); a changed preference titled differently is still a second memory (a semantic judge by the model is in `todo.md`). **(3) 撤销 / Undo on a fresh Noted line.** While the person hasn't said anything since, the line offers **撤销 / Undo**, no question asked (it is the undo): the memory is archived in Mem (`nmem m archive`: out of everyday recall, kept audit-readable; never deleted), a memory it replaced is written back from its own words (`m show`, then a plain save; Mem has no un-supersede), and a save still waiting in the outbox is dropped before it reaches Mem. The line then reads **不记了「{title}」/ Not kept “{title}”** (`MemView.undone`). When Mem doesn't answer, the line stays and says **Nowledge Mem 没回应，还记着 / Nowledge Mem didn't answer; still noted**. After the person's next message the line offers **忘掉 / Forget** as before (D304: asks, reaches Mem). Alternatives: Undo always (a week-old line's "undo" is a forget and should ask), confirm before Undo (an undo that asks is not an undo). **(4) A save while Mem is away waits** (research/private/10 §"Mem down ≠ Ducter down"). When Mem is installed and signed in but doesn't answer (`unavailable`, not `not_configured`: nothing waits for a Mem that isn't there), the save goes to an outbox (`<partner dir>/mem-outbox.json`, 0600) under a key made from what it is (persona, Log seq, task, words; UUID-shaped), and the partner treats it as remembered. It goes in on the next Mem call that works and every 5 minutes, naming the key as Mem's own upsert id (`nmem m add --id`), so a save Mem took on a try that seemed to fail is still one memory; a key Mem refuses is tried once more without it; a save that waited 30 days is let go (memories are an index of the Log, never its only copy). The line says **等 Nowledge Mem 回来就存进去 / Goes into Nowledge Mem once it's back** until it does (`MemView.waiting`). The first try of a save still names no id: the key's shape is unchecked against a live Mem. **(5) Mem's app closed: one line and a way to open it** (the trigger "Mem exposes how to start it" is met by macOS's own `open`). A failed `nmem status` that is a refused connection to this computer (loopback) is `mem_closed`, no longer read as "not signed in": **Nowledge Mem 没开着 / Nowledge Mem isn't open**; on a Mac home with the app, **{home} 上的 Nowledge Mem 应用关着，记忆先放着，打开就接上。** with **打开 Nowledge Mem / Open Nowledge Mem** (`bridge_mem_open`: the home runs `open -a` on the person's tap, then looks again for up to 20 s); elsewhere **在 {home} 上打开 Nowledge Mem 应用就好。/ Open the Nowledge Mem app on {home}.** A remote Mem server that is down is not "closed". **(6) Nowledge Mem in 全部更新 / Update all** (D257 option C). The home's `nmem`, when Mem says a newer one is out and Ducter can update this copy from its own source (D229; never the app's copy), is one item, **{device} 上的 Nowledge Mem / Nowledge Mem on {device}** (`kind: "mem"`, `mem:local`), always shown on the card (never under 还有 N 项), and the order note names it (**…最后是 {home} 上的 Nowledge Mem。**); after the agents, once the home's own Ducter step is over (its restart would cut the update off); by day only (the night takes only versions Ducter checked). A home that restarted mid-way judges it by what Mem says then. **(7) Memory shows Mem's own memories, by kind** (D257, research/84 §4): closed by D321, which built it (the groups by Mem's kind, each line's source, Fix and Forget in Mem); what was left, reading the identity's lane in the glance as recall does, is its own line in `todo.md`. Persona and partner tool names and descriptions unchanged (no D175 eval); only `memory_add`'s result note names a replaced memory. | U (the brief of 2026-11-17), D257, D298, D304, D321, D327, research/115, research/private/10 | `design/{memory,product-model,scenarios,todo,onboarding}.md`, `docs/{settings,faq,install,devices}.md`; `packages/partner/src/{memory,outbox,partner}.ts`, `packages/core/src/{bridge-link,update-all,first-words,settings,ws,core,main}.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/{index,internal}.ts`, tests `packages/partner/test/{memory,memory-d329}.test.ts`, `packages/core/test/mem-d329.test.ts`; `apps/web/src/{views.tsx,memory.tsx,mem-view.ts,updateall.tsx,app.ts,store.ts,i18n.ts,i18n-memory.ts,i18n-updateall.ts}`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/{demo-noted,demo-memory,demo-updateall}.ts`, test `apps/web/test/d329.test.ts`; `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/protocol.go,store/store.go,i18n/{memd329,memory,updateall}.go,mock/updateall.go,views/{quiet,memory,memory_pane,peers,peers_pane,updateall}.go}`, tests `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/memd329_test.go,views/{d329,d329_updateall,memory}_test.go}` |

## 2026-11-17: the home reads its Bridge mailbox every minute, soon after it writes, and long-polls once Mem can hold a read (D335)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D335 | **Built 2026-11-17 with fakes only (a fake clock for the timers, the fake nmem's `inbox --wait`); not reviewed by the author; no persona or partner-tool change, so no eval.** *Who:* the heavy developer whose terminal agent asks the partner something and waits, or who asked the partner to ask one; the consumer and the fresh user never see it (nothing new to read or set). *Feel:* before, an answer sat in the mailbox up to 5 min (a minute while live), so a back-and-forth felt like email; after, an answer to what the partner just sent is read within seconds, and anything else within a minute. *Why it is cheap:* Mem's `bridge inbox` is pull-only (a long-poll, `inbox --wait`, is asked for upstream on nowledge-co/mem#10402); one read is a short local CLI call, one at a time, and nothing wakes the partner unless a new message is there. **(1) The period is 1 min** (was 5 min). **(2) After the partner sends or replies** (`bridge_reply`, a send the person tapped on a card, the claim and result Ducter sends by code): reads at +10 s, 30 s, 1 min and 2 min after it; the rest are cancelled once the answer to that message arrives (`in_reply_to`). **(3) While live** with one of the person's own agents (D164 (6): 30 min after a message from or to one), every 15 s (was 60 s). **(4) The long-poll when the CLI has it:** `nmem bridge inbox --help` is read once per nmem version (D205's way); when it lists `--wait`, one `inbox --wait 25` at a time, back to back, per context, replaces the timer for arrivals (a handle new to the Log runs the usual check; a wait that comes back at once with nothing new pauses 15 s), and the timer drops to every 5 min for recovery and follow-through only. A wait that errors hands arrivals back to the timer (1 min), which tries the long-poll again after 10 min. `bridgeIntervalMs: 0` still means "at start and when asked" only. **With D334's Spaces** the long-poll runs per Space context (one loop per place; when wide, one `inbox --all-spaces --wait` on the home's context, if the help lists both); a handle from any place runs the one check, which reads every place; a place whose wait errors goes back to the timer alone (the timer stays at 1 min until every place waits again), and only that place is retried after 10 min; a new client (places or context changed) starts its own loops. *Tradeoff:* about 60 reads an hour per home instead of 12, each a local process start and one Mem request. *Alternative:* keep 5 min and only the reads after a send (cheaper, but a message from an agent that wasn't answering one of ours still waits up to 5 min). | the author's brief, 2026-11-17; D164 (6), D205, D333; nowledge-co/mem#10402 | `design/{bridge,todo}.md`; `packages/partner/src/{partner,bridge,bridge-out}.ts`, `packages/partner/eval/fake-bridge-nmem.ts`, `packages/partner/test/bridge-cadence.test.ts` |

## 2026-11-17: after Stop the person's own message lets a task ask for their phone again; a phone task says where it works; the paused line out of the title bar; words sent to a stopping turn wait for it; the same wait isn't reported twice; Smart Lock, never the PIN (D339; the author's loan on 0.0.69: Codex on Hetzner Server, "用手机 Chrome 查看今天上海天气". |---|---|---|---|
| D339 | **Built 2026-11-17 on the home (core, runner), the web and the Mac; checked with fakes only (the bridge-4 fake phone in `handset-d331.test.ts`, the runner's fake session, the web store and the Go renderer), shots in `.shots/phone-stop`; no Android change; not on a real phone; not reviewed by the author. No persona or partner-tool description changed (task tool answers and the task brief only), so no eval.** *Who:* the consumer lending their Pixel for a small errand, and the developer testing a loan; the fresh user meets only the Settings line. *Feel:* before, the paused explanation ran over the window's title bar; the head said the task worked in Ducter's browser on the server while it worked on their phone, and the workbench offered 看它上网 for a browser it never opened; after Stop, "再借手机继续?" got "the tool refuses; Ducter has to start a new phone task", 在等 came three times in nearly the same words, and "你还在么？" got only a spinner. After: one calm row in the task, the head saying **在你的 Pixel Fold 上**, a new card when they ask, one 在等, and an answer. **(1) Asking again after Stop.** Stop still ends the loan at once and interrupts the turn, and the task's phone tools refuse; the person's own message in that task (a `task_event` from the user: a steer, a held message said, a new turn) is their consent to be asked again: the next phone tool raises one new card (**The user wrote to you after taking {phone} back…**), and a Go lends it again. The task never asks again on its own; Ducter's notes, the partner's words and the runner's never count. The same for 不借 on the card. Android's switch off and Remove stay for the rest of the task (a message can't turn them back on). The tool's Stop words say so: "don't use it again in this task unless they ask you to in a message of their own. Never ask for it yourself." Alternative: let the agent re-ask on its own after a while (a Stop that comes back by itself is not a Stop; rejected). **(2) The paused line lives in the task's head** (the Mac): the line, the line under it and 停下 / 不借了 as one calm row under the headline, as the web already drew it; nothing about the phone in the title bar. **(3) Where a phone task works.** A task that asked for the person's phone (the ask's report in its stream, or the loan on its card) says **在你的 {phone} 上 / on your {phone}** where the head says where, in place of the computer and its browser, whatever the number of computers. 看它上网 (the header and the workbench's browser page) shows for it only once it opened a page in Ducter's browser (the runner's `browser` line). No phone page: the person's phone keeps no screenshot in the Log, and none is invented. **(4) Words to a stopping turn wait for it** (the runner): an interrupt sent while a turn works marks it stopping; words sent until its end (Ducter's note about the Stop, the person's message) are held and become the next turn once it has ended, in order (15 s at most, then they go anyway). *Inferred cause (no access to hel's Log for this run):* the phone's Stop interrupts the turn and tells the task in the same breath; the note, steered into a turn that was ending, fell into Codex's own queue (OAR's `steerOrQueue`) and ran as a turn Ducter didn't track, so the person's next words met a session Ducter thought idle or busy at the wrong time. ## 2026-11-17: 待办来源 / To-do sources: a task bound to one outside to-do; the app owns what it is and whether it is open, Ducter owns how it gets done (D341; issue wey-gu/ducter#6. D340 is taken on main; D342 and later may be taken by branches in flight: may need renumbering at merge)

|---|---|---|---|

An edit there is told to the running task; closed there while it works: the task is told and one card asks **{label} 在 {app} 上关掉了。这件事停下吗？** (Go 停下, Hold 接着做, Stop by default after 30 min: reversible); reopened or gone: told, the chip says so. Ducter never writes its own state to the app; a comment carries the result once. **(2) In: offered, never started by itself.** The partner's `todos` tool (list, take, write), listed while a source is on or the home's gh is signed in; New task's **从待办里选 / Pick from your to-dos** (a to-do with a live task opens that task); per source **新的来了 / When a new one comes**: **告诉我** (GitHub's default; at most once per source per 3 h), **不用说** (Obsidian's default), **直接接下**: the standing go, offered once X2's way after two takes from that source in 14 days (**以后 GitHub 上标给你的，直接接下？** / **直接接下** / **仍然先问我**), at most 5 a day. A to-do's text reaches the task fenced as outside text, never instructions. **(3) Out: GitHub behind a Go, Obsidian by itself.** GitHub (shared, seen by others): the partner drafts one comment in the issue's own language with the PR link (an English issue gets no Chinese comment: the tool refuses), core makes the card **在 {repo}#{n} 下留言？** with the comment whole (Go **留言** or **留言并关掉** when it fully resolves it, Hold **暂不留言**); after two Go'd comments in 14 days, once: **以后在 GitHub 上做完的，直接留言？**; under it closing still asks (**关掉 {repo}#{n}？**) unless the person chose **留言并关掉** in Settings. Every comment is signed "Written with Ducter". Obsidian (local, their own): **勾掉 / Tick it off** by default when the task is done (`[x]` and ` ✅ date`, as the Tasks plugin writes), **先问我** and **不动它** one tap away; a repeating line is never ticked here. Each write is a `source_write` event with its Go or standing go, shown in Done for you (comment: sent; close, tick: changed). **(4) The Obsidian write.** One line in place (the same file), found by 🆔, `^block` id or its words' hash, after a compare-and-swap on bytes and mtime; refused while a sync conflict copy is beside it, the file is evicted to iCloud, it changed in the last 3 s, or the line isn't open; BOM, line endings and last newline kept. **(5) Where it shows.** Settings › **待办来源 / To-do sources** (the name: research/126 §6, 216 haiku runs; its own clay art owed); the chip (the app's own mark, `repo#12` or the note's name, opening it in its app; **已留言 / 已关掉 / 已勾掉 / 已不在** apart) on the opened task's meta line, On hand's cards, New task's pick and the card; On hand read by source under **来自 / From** in the lens. **(6) Adapters.** `SourceAdapter` (status, list, get, write, ops) holds no consent; Jira and a company's own tracker are adapters later (`todo.md`). ## 2026-11-17: the Android app offers a failed update again, says why with a way through the browser, and Settings checks for it (D342; the author's phone, decided by the lead. D342 may be taken by a branch in flight: renumber at merge if so)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D342 | **Built 2026-11-17 with unit tests only; not walked on a phone (the live check is in `todo.md`).** *Who:* the consumer on an Android phone whose network reaches GitHub badly (many in mainland China), and the developer who updates every release. *Felt before:* the app offered an update, the download from GitHub broke off, and opening the app again never offered it; Settings had no way to ask (the author, on a real phone). *Cause, in code:* the quiet check waited an hour from the check that *found* the version, whether or not it was installed (`lastCheck` stamped on success); a step stuck mid-way (a hung connection, Android's install dialog left behind) left the state busy, and a quiet check ran only from idle; the only manual check was the icon's long-press menu. *After (放心, 顺滑):* **(1)** The version offered is kept until it is installed; while it waits and wasn't put off with **以后再说** on the offer, opening the app asks again at once, and back in front after 10 minutes. Closing a failure puts nothing off. **(2)** A step silent for 3 minutes is stuck; the next quiet check starts over, and the stuck step can no longer speak or install. **(3)** A download that stops short is a connection failure, not a checksum one. **(4)** The failure card names the version and says why in one plain sentence, with **再试一次**, **以后再说** and, when GitHub is unreachable or the file broke, **在浏览器里下载** (the website's download page at Android: the same file, the browser's own connection and resume; installing over keeps everything). No mirror is invented: the release lives on GitHub only, as the download page says. **(5)** Settings › 这台手机 and this phone's card in 你的设备 show **这个 App**, **版本 {v}** and **检查更新** inside the Android app; it sends the bridge's existing `update.check` and the app's card answers. *Tradeoff:* a phone that keeps failing asks GitHub's API every time it opens (at most every 10 minutes while open), well under its hourly limit. *Alternative not taken:* show the remembered offer from storage without asking (no network on opening, but it could offer a release GitHub has since replaced). | the author's report; D181, D148 | `apps/android/app/src/main/java/co/nowledge/ducter/android/{Core,Updater,Store,MainActivity,Screens}.kt`, `apps/android/app/src/main/res/values{,-zh}/strings.xml`, `apps/android/app/src/test/java/co/nowledge/ducter/android/UpdatePaceTest.kt`, `apps/web/src/{app-update.tsx,views.tsx,devcard.tsx,i18n.ts}`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/test/app-update.test.ts`, `design/{android,product-model,todo}.md`, `docs/{phone,install}.md` |

## 2026-11-18: a report is written for the person; a checkpoint is the task's own note and never shows (D349; the author showed a live Codex watcher on nowledge-co whose reports and saved progress read "Round58完成…16checks15success1preuninstallrunning…". D349 and D350 may be held by branches in flight: may need renumbering at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D349 | **Built 2026-11-18, checked with fakes (a fake run of a watcher, both transcript ports on one fixture, the web at wide and 390 in zh, `.shots/report-words/`); no live model rerun yet.** *Who:* all three, the heavy developer most (a review loop left running all day). *Felt, before:* the task page and On hand read like a machine's ledger (round numbers, queue and ledger file names, counters glued to words) and every round said the whole state again; 放心 and 好用 both broken. *After:* each round is a plain line or two in the person's language, a round that found nothing is one line, and where it saved its progress is a quiet **保存了进度**. **The cause, as found:** nothing in Ducter strips spaces. The report path only trims and cuts (`normalizeReport`), the checkpoint path only cuts at 4,000, the transcript only clips and hides keys, and the web's autospace only adds a U+2005 between Han and Latin. The same checkpoint keeps one space ("lockedmetadata regenerated") while gluing "5requests4mentions", which no mechanical rule does, and the agent's own messages in the same session are spaced normally. The words were the model's: Codex (gpt-5.5) wrote its checkpoints as a compressed ledger for itself, because the brief told it its context is small and its last checkpoint is what it carries on from (and hands that checkpoint back after each compaction, so each round copies the last one's shape); the transcript then showed every checkpoint as the agent's words (D152 (4)); and the report rules asked for the outcome first but set no bar against bookkeeping, no "only what changed", and nothing for a round that found nothing. (1) **The bar for a report** (in the task brief; `report_to_main`'s `summary` says only "For the user, result first", since the task tools sit at their 9.2K budget; runner-side only, so no partner eval): written for the person, in their language; the result first in one plain sentence, then at most a few short lines; ordinary spacing, numbers with their units ("16 项检查，15 项通过", never "16checks15success"); none of the task's own bookkeeping (round numbers, counters, ledger or note file names, ids, hashes) unless the person needs one to act; only what changed since the last report; work that repeats and found nothing new says so in one short line ("nowledge-co 没有新的待审 PR"). (2) **A crammed summary goes back once:** two or more runs of letters and digits glued in turns (`gluedRuns`: at least 10 characters, four groups, or three starting with a digit; never a hash, path, URL, version or identifier) return "Not sent yet…" with the bar, nothing logged; the second try goes as it is, never a loop. No mechanical re-spacing: it would break names like f098, x86_64 or gpt-5.5. (3) **A checkpoint is the task's own note:** the brief and the tool say so (the user doesn't read it; never copy it into a summary; still plain sentences). In the opened task its words never show: it marks the words the agent just said **保存了进度** (when nothing came between, or they are the same words), else it is that line alone, a run of them in a row one line (protocol block `saved`, both ports, `fixtures/transcript.json`); the session index counts it as one line. On hand never quotes it (it reads steps and words only). The CLI's `ducter tail` still prints it: the terminal is where the heavy developer reads everything. (4) **A progress report stays in the transcript** even when it is the latest (only an outcome is said above the transcript): before, a working watcher's newest report showed nowhere on its page. *Alternative not taken:* show a checkpoint folded behind a tap (keeps the note one tap away, but it is written for the agent and adds a control to every save). | U (the live task, 2026-11-18), A | `packages/runner/src/{brief,tools}.ts`, `packages/runner/test/{report-words.test.ts,__snapshots__/runner.test.ts.snap}`, `packages/protocol/src/{transcript,session}.ts`, `packages/protocol/fixtures/{transcript-cases.ts,transcript.json}`, `apps/web/{src/transcript.tsx,static/app.js}`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/{transcript,session,taskpage,taskturns}.go`, `design/{focus-window,product-model,ui}.md` |

## 2026-11-18: a model an agent adds overnight is offered and switchable with no Ducter release; the partner switches a task's model when asked (D352; the author: "昨晚 codex 出了新的模型 6.2 astra/sol 我比如这个任务里如何切换模型？还有其他工作需要做么？" D349 and D350 are on main and D351 is taken by a branch in flight, so this is D352)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D352 | **Built 2026-11-18 and checked by unit tests, a Go view test and the partner eval (haiku: 101/141 overall against 103/140 before, within its run-to-run spread; the new `switch-model-zh` passes, 3/3 alone); the registry and the effort levels checked against the installed codex-cli 0.169.1 (`codex debug models`, OAR 0.95.1 listModels, both read-only and token-free); no live switch on a real model yet (todo). `~/.codex` untouched.** *Who:* the heavy developer who reads the release notes and wants the new model in the task he is in right now; the consumer who hears "6.2 is out" and says so to the partner; the fresh user, who never sees a model id unless they open the row. *Feel:* before, the new models were in the picker already (D202 reads Codex's own list) but nothing said so, the registry and the verified range lagged, a task on a model past the row's eight lost its chip, and telling the partner did nothing it could act on; after, the picker shows **GPT-6.2-Sol** and **GPT-6.2-Astra** with their own default effort, a tap or one sentence switches the task in place. *First time:* open the task › **换谁来做 / Switch who does it**: the **模型 / Model** row, or tell the partner. **(1) The registry.** `gpt-6.2-sol` (500K) and `gpt-6.2-astra` (272K) added; Codex verified 0.167.0–0.169.1 (both knob keys still typed i64); their efforts low..ultra, default low, as OAR listModels and `codex debug models` both say. **(2) The list is live, the registry adds what Ducter checked.** The pickers already offered the agent's own `listModels`; now each listed model is merged with the registry (`liveModels`): a known one takes the registry's window, an unknown one is marked `fresh` and takes the window (and, where the list gave none, the efforts) that `codex debug models` gives it, read only when the list has a model the registry lacks. Hidden models never come in (the list leaves them out, and the catalog never adds models). The list is kept per agent version on the home (an updated agent is read again at once), else 10 minutes. A Codex task's window is never above its model's own (registry, else the listed one). **(3) Switching.** The chip and `/model` were already D282's in-place switch: the same native session, the running turn finishing on the old model, the next one on the new. The model a task is on is now always a chip, even past the row's first eight (web and Mac). The partner gets **`task_switch`** (0.7K in every turn's tool list, the ceiling moved with it): model as the person said it, matched to that agent's live list, else the registry ("6.2 sol" → `gpt-6.2-sol`; "sol" asks which; an unknown one names what there is); an effort is checked against the model; another agent goes through D282's carry-over. `/model 6.2sol` matches the same way. **(4) The default for new tasks does not move to the newest.** Ducter names no Codex model by default, so a new task runs on Codex's own default, which is the person's `model` in `~/.codex/config.toml` (the author's: `gpt-6.1-terra`, low). ## 2026-11-18: an AI agent's update says what it is doing while it runs; Codex's download comes first, watched, into npm's own cache (D362; the author on the Mac app 0.0.77, 正在全部更新: "Macbook Pro M3 上的 Codex 0.169.1 → 0.170.0 正在更新到 0.170.0…" "卡了半天" while Hetzner's finished quickly. D358 is the latest on main and D359–D361 may be held by branches in flight: may need renumbering at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D362 | **Built 2026-11-18 (core, worker, web, the Mac), checked by unit tests with a fake installer that streams, stalls, never ends and is stopped, a real download from a local server, Go view tests, and the real home driven by a pretend worker in headless Chrome (`apps/web/demo-agent-update.ts`; shots `.shots/agent-update/`). The cache path was run for real only into scratch prefixes (research/131); no real update on the author's Mac yet.** *Cause (measured):* Codex from npm is a 13 KB launcher whose binary is an aliased optional dependency, 155 MB for 0.170.0 darwin-arm64, plus a 19.5 MB packument, new for every version; npm fetched them silently and Ducter's runner buffered everything to the end: 12.5 min cold here at ~200 KB/s (past the old 10 min kill, which would have said "unchanged"), 12–14 s from a warm cache. Hetzner's link made the same step quick. *Who:* the developer with Codex on a laptop on home Wi-Fi, the consumer on a slow line, the fresh user who only sees a line that doesn't move. *Felt before:* a frozen line, no way to tell slow from stuck, nothing to do but wait. *After:* 顺滑 the line moves; 放心 it says how far and that the version they have still works; one quiet choice when it is really slow. **(1) Watched download, npm kept.** Where harness-facts names the binary's tarball (`channels.npmBlob`, Codex), after the safe point and with the agent still working, Ducter downloads it from the registry npm itself uses (`npm config get registry`), puts it in npm's own cache (`npm cache add <file>`, stored by the sha512 the install asks for) with the package's metadata beside it, then holds the agent and runs the same `npm install -g` with `--prefer-offline --no-audit` (seconds). A source that won't serve it falls back to npm's own download. The person's install method is never switched (GitHub's 82 MB `.zst` was rejected for that). **(2) Live words** (both clients, the Update all row and the coin's row): **正在下载（61 / 155 MB）**, without a size **正在下载（38 MB）**, without bytes **正在下载… 1 分 20 秒**; **正在装好…**; for an updater Ducter can't see inside (brew, the agents' own installers) **正在更新到 0.170.0… 2 分 5 秒** after 10 s; then 在检查 as before. Wire: `step`, `got`, `size`, `since` (the updater's start, the home's clock), at most one frame a second. **(3) Slower than usual:** past 3× this agent's last update on that computer (never under 90 s; 4 min with none known; kept in `updates/agent-times.json`), one quiet line under the row, **比平常慢，可能是网络慢**, with **再等等** (hides it for another stretch) and **停止** (`update_all {stopItem}` → the home's own abort or `agent_update_stop` to the worker): the step reads **已停止**, the version they have untouched, and the plan goes on. **(4) Hard limits:** no bytes for 2 min or 30 min in all stops the download; an updater that downloads by itself gets 25 min (was 10); either fails as `timeout`, **下载太久没完成，已经停下了，原来的版本照常能用。网络好些时再试一次。**, with the plan's **再试一次**. *Alternative not taken:* only an elapsed time on the old single step (no bytes, no clean stop, the agent held for the whole download). *Not covered:* a registry token or a proxy only `.npmrc` knows (the fallback, with the time shown). | U (the author, 2026-11-18), research/131; D156, D224, D227 | `packages/protocol/src/{index,harness-facts}.ts`, `packages/core/src/{agents,download,update,update-all,ws,core}.ts`, `packages/cli/src/worker.ts`, `packages/core/test/agent-download.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/{agent-progress.ts,updateall.tsx,devcard.tsx,i18n-updateall.ts}`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/test/agent-progress.test.ts`, `apps/web/demo-agent-update.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/protocol.go,i18n/updateall.go,views/{agentprogress,agentprogress_test,updateall,agentversion}.go}`, `design/{system,product-model}.md`, `docs/devices.md`, `research/{131-agent-update-download,README}.md` |

## 2026-11-18: a computer added for tasks gets its AI agents from Ducter, finds the ones you installed, and signs them in from where you are (D363; the author on haswell, 0.0.77: the card showed only a greyed pi and 再登录一个, "里边的 harness 需要亲自安装", "我安装了 codex，这边 devices 也识别不出来", then "从空服务器 bootstrap 需要的 harness，丝滑的 onboarding；最好 harness 可以在 devices 里一键安装". D358 is on main and another branch may take D363: this may need renumbering at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D363 | **Built 2026-11-18; checked live on two Ubuntu 24.04 VMs (colima, a normal user, nothing but curl) against a scratch home on this Mac, no account signed in (research/132).** *Who:* the heavy developer lending a bare server (the author's haswell, which he will wipe and lend again from the release); the consumer lending a NAS; the fresh user who has never installed an AI agent. *Felt before:* the line joined in seconds and then nothing could run there: no agent, no way to get one from Ducter, a pi that wasn't there shown greyed, a Codex installed by hand invisible for half an hour, and signing in meant an SSH session. *After:* 好用 one question, one button, one sign-in each, all from the sheet; 顺滑 the agents arrive on the clay one by one; 赏心悦目 the same coin rows as the card; 放心 nothing needs a password, everything goes in Ducter's own folder there, and the sign-in is each agent's own; 惊喜 a Codex installed by hand appears within seconds. **Root causes (verified live on 0.0.77):** (a) a worker probed its agents only at its welcome and every 30 minutes, so `~/.local/bin/codex` installed after joining stayed "not installed" until a restart (shown at once after one); (b) the service's PATH was the install shell's plus `~/.local/bin` and `~/.bun/bin`, so nvm, fnm, a custom npm prefix or Linuxbrew were never looked in; (c) Bun's `which` reads the PATH the process started with and ignores a later change (Bun 1.4.4), so any widening had to be passed explicitly; (d) pi counted as installed when `node` was on PATH, though the single binary runs only a `pi` command (the greyed pi); (e) Ducter never installed an agent anywhere, and signing in was only "on that computer itself". **(1) Finding.** A worker's PATH is widened on start and on every probe: the login shell's PATH (`$SHELL -lic`, captured when the service is installed and again at each start, kept in `<data>/login-path`), the usual per-user folders (`~/.local/bin`, npm's prefix from `~/.npmrc`, `~/.npm-global`, every nvm and fnm node newest first, volta, asdf, mise, bun, pnpm, Linuxbrew, `/usr/local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`), then Ducter's tools folder last; the person's own copy wins. Every agent lookup asks with the current PATH (`whichNow`). **(2) Looking again.** Every 5 s the worker takes a fingerprint without starting a process (where each agent's command is and its time, the sign-in files' times) and probes for real when it moves; on start, at each welcome, every 30 minutes, and when a device card opens (`agent_setup` `look`). **(3) Installing.** `agent_setup` `install` puts Codex, Claude Code and pi in `<data>/tools` on that computer: Node.js's own build (24.22.3, SHA-256 pinned per platform), then each agent's npm package at the newest version Ducter verified (harness-facts `verified.to`), one at a time, no sudo, nothing outside that folder; the copies read as npm-installed there, so D156's updates reach them. Fails into one line (没连上网 / 空间不够 / 装不了 / 没装上) and **再试一次**. **(4) Signing in** with each agent's own sign-in, run on that computer and carried to the person: Codex `codex login --device-auth` (its link and one-time code; device sign-in off in the account says to turn it on), Claude Code `claude auth login` (its link; the code its page gives is pasted back and written to the sign-in's input; a wrong one asks again), pi (no sign-in that runs without its own screen: the row says to run pi and /login there). 15 minutes, then it stops. **(5) Where.** The lend sheet's last step asks **装上哪些 AI？/ Which AIs should it have?** with Codex and Claude Code checked and pi not, **装上 / Install** and **以后再说 / Later**; then each agent as its row (**正在装上… / Installing…**, **等着装 / Waiting to install**, **登录 / Sign in** with its sign-in in place, **可以用了 / Ready**), and **{name} 可以干活了 / {name} is ready for tasks** once one is signed in. Every device card (a worker's and the home's) shows the same rows: an agent not there has **安装 / Install** in the socket's detail, one going in arrives as its coin with a ring, a coin not signed in opens on **登录**. (1) **Continuity first** (persona rule 2d, `task_open` and `task_send` descriptions): a follow-up carries on the task it follows (`task_send`, done or failed too): the same errand or goal, building on what it found or changed, or needing its sign-ins, files or branch. A new task only for separate work (another bug, another errand, even in the same repo), anything after its work was merged, or when the person asks ("开个新的" / "a new one"). One the person names ("接着昨天那个 compaction 的活") is found (tasks, `log_search`) and continued. Another agent for it: `task_switch`, then `task_send`. (2) **The turn names the task** (code): under each user line, `(just before this: task <id> "<title>", done 16 min ago, Codex, a browser. …)`: the last task opened, finished or continued in the conversation (the partner's last `job_status` with a task), within 12 h, not dropped; a merged one says new work is a new task; a task still at work gets the line without advice. (3) **A second look** (code): the first `task_open` of a turn whose message follows a *finished* task is answered once with "not opened: this follows task …; task_send it there, or call again for separate work"; the early-opened task (D120) is dropped unstarted, and the line already said becomes the continued task's. Not for a split (D360), a redone turn, or words asking for a new one. (4) **Where it shows:** a follow-up sent to a finished task makes the line before it (or the first line after it, or none) that task's ack and appends a `job_status` running for the same task under it, so both clients move the task's chip under the newest ask (their newest-owner rule, no client change) and On hand keeps its one card; its next done or failed report closes that line; a send that fails puts the line back. (5) **Resume is unchanged and verified:** `task_send` to a finished task resumes the agent's own session by id, else starts a new session in the same task from the brief and checkpoints, re-adding a worktree from its branch (Codex resumed after 2.5 days on hel, VERIFIED; Claude Code per research/03). *Eval:* baseline (old persona) 5/8 of the follow-up set, the trip opening a new task at the first follow-up as in the Log; after, the trip continued the one task through all three follow-ups in every run since the second look (its remaining judge failures are long hand-off lines and an invented travel time, not routing); the full run is 117/153 (the last, D360's, 104/144), follow-ups 8/10 (`followup-broadens-en` missed its retitle, `continue-trip-zh` on length). *Not built (todo):* moving a continued task to another computer when the follow-up needs one (the partner's `task_switch` takes no computer); continuing the person's own outside sessions (D299) from the conversation. *Alternative not taken:* only the prompt (haiku continued the trip in 1 of 2 runs without the second look). | U (the author, 2026-11-18), L, R139 | `packages/partner/src/{persona,partner,render}.ts`, `packages/partner/test/{continue-task,partner,regressions,prompt-budget}.test.ts`, `packages/partner/eval/{scenarios,run}.ts`, `apps/web/demo-continue.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/continue_shots_test.go`, `design/{conversation,past,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/past-tasks.md`, `research/143-continue-task.md` |

## 2026-11-19: the partner reads no web page itself; what the web says is a task's look-up (D378; research/148 §5: `where-w1-public-zh` failed in every recent full eval. D377 is the latest on main; another branch may take D378: renumber at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D378 | **Built 2026-11-19 (protocol, runner, partner, eval), checked by unit tests and two full partner evals (haiku: 126/168 and 128/168 against d377's 124/164; where 6/9 and 8/9 against 3/7; no web tool used in any scenario; `results/2026-11-19-haiku-d378-{a,b}.md`; run a judged before the rubrics said that profile "default" is the usual browser place, which the judge had read as the user's signed-in one); not yet on a live home.** *Who:* the heavy developer who says "帮我查一下 HN 今天关于 OAR 的讨论" and gets, a long turn later, "没找到，OAR 全称是什么？"; the consumer who asks tomorrow's weather; the fresh user, who never knows there was a choice. *Felt before:* the partner searched the web inside its own turn (WebSearch, WebFetch: D177 kept them for the read-only partner), came back with a thin answer or a question, and the turn blocked while it did; in the haiku runs of 2026-11-17 to 19 it used them in 31 of 36 runs of the two web scenarios (`where-w1-public-zh` 14 of 18, `browser-task-en` 17 of 18), ignoring the persona's rule (D177 (6): "what the web says now … is a look-up"). *After:* 顺滑 one short line ("我去 HN 上看看今天关于 OAR 的讨论"), and the result when it's in, with where it came from; 放心 a web page never speaks to the one that holds the conversation, the memory, the accounts and every Go card. *How it starts:* the first web question; nothing to learn. **(1) The rule.** The partner answers in turn what it knows and what Ducter's own tools read (stable facts, opinions, how-tos, its tasks, the person's connected accounts, the calendar). What a site or the web says now (a page or a link, the latest version, today's news or discussion, the weather, a price) is a browsing task (needs.browse), even for one fact, never said from memory, and with no question first when the look-up itself can find what they meant. Its kind is errand, so it goes to the faster model (D372). **(2) Why, from first principles.** *Trust:* a page is untrusted input; only a task reads it and only its typed report comes back (principle 12), the same line D241 drew when browser tasks got none of the person's memory or setup. *The main AI never blocks* (principle 6): a search waits on the network, and a turn that waits is a conversation that stalls. *The working set* (principle 5): pages are the bulkiest reads there are. *Measured:* asked in the persona since D177, not done; enforced, it holds (D177 (1)'s lesson for read-only). *Its cost, honestly:* one number now takes a task's time instead of seconds, and one more row in On hand for that while. ## 2026-11-19: Nowledge Mem is connected once, at the home, and carried to every task wherever it runs (D393; research/159. The author: "为什么我们在一个 computer 里装了 mem 在别的 computer 里还要单独做一遍？未来我们支持那些 sandbox 模型环境又要怎么做？" and "关键是要维护在其他机器上的 plugin 配置那些哈 看看怎么优雅做到 远不止 mcp 的". D388–D392 are held by parallel branches: renumber at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D393 | **Built 2026-11-19 (protocol, core, runner, web, Mac) with fakes, and live: a real Claude Code (`claude -p --model haiku`) loaded Mem's plugin by `--plugin-url` over plain http from the relay on a LAN address, and its SessionStart and Stop hooks reached a fake Mem through the relay with the home's key; nothing secret on that disk (research/159 §2–3). Cut to the minimum on the author's word "不要把 mem 搞的过于复杂" (§7). Not run against a real Mem; for the author's review.** *Who:* the heavy developer whose tasks run on haswell, a NAS, a cloud box, and soon in a sandbox per task; the consumer lending a NAS; the fresh user, who never sees any of it (no Mem on the home, nothing shows, D169 (6)). *Felt before:* the memory is one, yet every computer asked for it again: install, a trip to Mem's app for a one-time link, a paste, a restart, and again after a rotated key; a sandbox could never have it. *After:* 好用 nothing to do on any computer; 顺滑 a Claude Code task there has Mem's own plugin, like the person's own sessions; 放心 Mem's key never leaves the home, and what a task holds dies with it; 惊喜 the card already says **这里的任务也记得你**. **Three parts, nothing else.** **(1) The relay** (`core/src/mem-relay.ts`): a task on another computer (or in a sandbox there) gets `NMEM_API_URL=<home>/mem` and `NMEM_API_KEY=<a task key>`; its nmem, and Mem's plugin through it, talk to the home as if it were Mem; the home puts on its own credential (Mem's credential home or env, read per request, never written) and forwards. The key (`dmr.`, HMAC over the task and 30 days, compared in constant time) opens only `/mem/*`, only while the task lives (checked on every request: archived or dropped closes it at once), memory is on and the home has Mem. It reaches only Mem's data paths, by their first part, as nmem and the plugin call them (an allowlist; Mem's settings, keys, Access Anywhere, licence, models, team, export and import, its job triggers, and every DELETE refused), at most a burst of 60 calls and 10 a second per task. Requests, answers and keys are never logged; one line on the task's stream says it reached Mem through the home. A worker rewrites the loopback address to the home's, without its device token. Tasks on the home keep the home's own connection. **(2) Mem's plugin goes with the task:** for Claude Code, where the person has no Mem plugin of their own there and the computer has an nmem for its hooks (Ducter's own copy, D386), `--plugin-url <home>/mem/kit/<task key>/claude-code.zip`: the home's own copy (its Claude Code plugin cache, newest, read only), for that session only. Theirs is reused, never doubled. **(3) The floor is unchanged:** an agent the home carries no plugin for (Codex, pi, DeepSeek Harness) has D168's recall and `memory_search`; its nmem (a skill, the person's own Codex plugin there) reaches Mem through the relay too. **The card (D366 re-scoped):** while the home carries Mem, a worker's Nowledge Mem row says **这里的任务也记得你 / Tasks here remember you too** with **用的是 {home} 上那一份记忆，这台电脑上什么都不用设置。**; that computer's own Mem is for the person's own sessions there, one quiet line with a secondary 装上 or 登录. **Cut in the ablation (each loses nothing the person feels):** a task-side `memory_save` (the plugin saves; elsewhere `remember` through the partner, D168 (5) unchanged); the home saving a thread for tasks without the plugin (the Log keeps it; before D393 no such thread reached Mem either); Working Memory lines in the first turn (the plugin's SessionStart gives the bundle); a Codex `CODEX_HOME` overlay (Codex loaded no plugin from an overlay cache without a marketplace of Ducter's: not small, deferred); every ask of Mem (the relay gives per-task keys; every identity is the person's own; the home's cached plugin works; the allowlist comes from nmem's own paths). *Why not MCP tools alone:* the person's own sessions have Mem's whole plugin; tasks would get less. *Why not a key per computer:* a secret at rest in places Ducter can't clean, all-or-nothing revocation. | U (the author's question, scope and ablation), L (mechanics), R159 | `design/memory.md` "Mem carried to every task", `design/system.md`, `design/product-model.md`, `docs/add-a-computer.md`, `packages/core/src/{mem-relay,core,devices}.ts`, `packages/runner/src/{runner,oar,worker-host}.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/{index,internal}.ts`, `apps/web/src/{worker-mem.tsx,i18n-workermem.ts}`, `apps/desktop/internal/{views,i18n}/workermem.go`, `apps/desktop/internal/protocol/protocol.go` |

## 2026-11-19: a review that runs every so often lands its reviews and is silent between them (D394; the author: "我跑哪个让它每 45 分钟的 review 的最近几十次竟然都认为没有可以 review 的"; research/158. D388–D393 are taken by branches in flight: renumber at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D394 | **Built 2026-11-19 in core and the runner, checked with fakes (a fake clock replaying hel's stacking sequence, a restart, a scripted round that only re-arms); not yet on hel.** *Who:* the heavy developer who set a reviewer running on his org's review requests and expects reviews to land on the PRs; the consumer who asked it to keep an eye on something; the fresh user, who meets none of it until such a task asks. *Feel:* before, 59 reports of "nowledge-co 没有新的待审 PR。" while 8–9 requests waited, rounds minutes apart, and 141 reviews nobody saw (从你这边看，从没评审过); after, silence while nothing changes, one card when reviews are written, and what stands when it speaks (放心, 好用). *First time:* the first round with drafts: one card, Go posts. **Causes (research/158, VERIFIED by the Log and the code):** the brief (D349) told repeating work to say "nothing new" in one line, with this very sentence as its example; the runner nudged every round that ended without a report, and the nudge's turn re-ran the round and armed another timer; `wait_for` with a time never looked at the task's armed timer, so timers stacked (04:52→05:37, 04:55→05:40, 05:07→05:52); nothing told a task how to post what reaches other people, so its reviews stayed in scratch. (1) **One timer per task** (`work.ts` `timerFor`): arming a task's own timer replaces its armed one (not a usage-limit wait, D297); the replaced one ends `cancelled` with `replacedBy` (protocol), which never wakes the task out of Waiting; the tool's answer says it replaced and when. A round from another wake (a nudge, a compaction, a restart's re-run) moves the next round, never adds one; a restart rebuilds only the newest. (2) **A turn resting on its own wait owes no report** (`runner.ts`): a turn that armed a wait of the task's own, still armed at its end, is neither nudged nor a stall, as D266 exempts background work. (3) **The brief** (`brief.ts`): a repeating round that found nothing new doesn't report; it re-arms and ends its turn. It reports only when something new needs the person, and then also what stands ("8 review requests wait on you: 3 had new commits and are reviewed again, 5 unchanged"), never "nothing new" alone while things wait. What would reach other people (a PR review or comment, an approval, a message) is drafted to files and asked in one `needs_input` per round for all drafts (default: post them), each draft in `show`; it posts once after Go (D61 GQ10: no countdown). A brief that says to send without asking keeps that. No persona or partner-tool name or description changed (the task tool's answer text did), so no eval (D175). *Not built (todo, defaults proposed):* each round as a fresh session seeded from the checkpoint and the task's state files once the session has compacted since its last round (default: yes for Codex and Claude Code, measured on a fake first); per-PR state (head reviewed, findings with severity and file:line, the draft) on the To-do sources' GitHub to-dos (D341) and the Ongoing card's standing line; a draft viewer beside the PR's diff. *Alternative not taken:* a core filter that drops "nothing new" reports (it guesses at words; silence at the source is exact). **Built further the same day (the author took the four defaults), with fakes:** (4) **Fresh rounds** (`runner.ts`): on Codex and Claude Code a round woken by the task's own timer after a rest of 30 min or more (every prompt cache is cold by then, so resuming re-reads every earlier round at full price), or once the session compacted since the last round began, starts a new session from the brief and the latest six checkpoints (`freshRound`, not "couldn't be resumed"); pi keeps its one session; a short wait (CI in 5 min) resumes until it compacts. The default changed from "only after a compaction" because the fake showed it saves 2% (one reset per compaction) against 92% for a fresh start after a long rest: 12 rounds of 28k tool output, compacting at 160k, read 910,892 tokens before and 74,695 after, the largest round 144,060 before and 7,101 after (a model of the reads, not a live measure). `DUCTER_FRESH_ROUNDS=0` turns it off. (5) **`review_report`** (task tool, listed only for a task whose brief is about reviewing, with GitHub connected): every PR waiting on the person this round (ref, the head looked at, changed when reviewed again) and the drafted comments for those reviewed again. The drafts become those PRs' pre-reads (D359's, `byTask`, `head`), so the review to-dos on On hand and the pile show **我看过了 · n 处问题** and open the same sheet, the draft viewer on the phone, the web and the Mac. A review request stays tied to the task by its read, not by D341's binding, whose end (comment, close) is wrong for a review. (6) **One card a round** (`src.kind: "reviews"`): **{n} 个 PR 的评审写好了，发到 GitHub？ / {n} PR reviews are written. Post them to GitHub?**, **发到 GitHub / Post to GitHub**, **先不发 / Not now**, no countdown; each PR a row with **看草稿 / Read draft** and **每条草稿都能先看一遍。说好之前，什么都不会发到 GitHub。**; a later round's card settles the open one and carries every unsent draft; Go posts each once as a comment-only review through the gated write (Done for you), Hold posts nothing (each sheet can still send its own); the task hears either way; the same head already posted asks nothing. (7) **The Ongoing card's standing line** (`OngoingItem.reviews`): **8 个请求在等你：3 个有新提交已复审，5 个没变** and **3 份评审还没发**, each its own element (D291), web and Mac; while the round card is unanswered the task stands under 等你 (the card stays the one needs-you), back to 等下一次 on Post or Not now. Checked by `review-round.test.ts`, `fresh-round.test.ts`, the Mac view tests and shots (`.shots/routine-review/`, web at 1400 and 390, Mac, zh and en); not on hel, no live model. | U (the author, 2026-11-19), research/158 | `packages/core/src/{work,waiters}.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/index.ts`, `packages/runner/src/{runner,brief}.ts`, `packages/core/test/work-over-time.test.ts`, `packages/runner/test/{runner,report-words}.test.ts`, `design/{focus-window,focus-window-states,past,todo}.md`, `docs/waiting-and-routines.md`, `research/158-review-routine.md` |

D226's calendar-vs-confirmation join is one case of it (its key kept, so nothing said before is said again). **(2) A contradiction** (two sources, two days) is a 两件事对不上 find, worded with each source and the weekday: **日历上「{plan}」是 {day}（周{d}），{who}写的是 {day}（周{d}）。** plus the next step when it costs: **订票前先跟主办方确认哪天。** / **时间也没定，订票前先跟主办方确认。** or **你订的 {flight} 是 {day} 的。** Never said when only the person's own words disagree with their own calendar (they know). **Cost of a miss:** 70, +15 when the first disputed day is within two days (+5 within a week), +8 with a flight, train or stay booked within a day of it, −12 when their own words agree with the calendar; urgent (said "now", never at night) within one day, or within three unless their words agree. **(3) What it doesn't know** is said, never guessed: a find's `unknown` (**几点开始**, **你几点上场** when only the doors are listed, **还剩多少、哪天重置**), shown as **还不知道：{what} / Not known yet: {what}**; and what it didn't change when they might think it did: **日历我没改。/ I didn't change your calendar.** **(4) The open question:** a said contradiction keeps what is still open (the day; the time when no source gives one) and is closed by a later source on the sheet (a mail, the calendar moved, a public page): said once as **补上刚才缺的时间：「{plan}」{day}{time}{ 开门}（{site}）。{你几点上场页面上没写。}** or **「{plan}」对上了：是 {day}，{who}。** (an `update` find, linked), inside "now"'s room and never at night; let go silently when its days pass. **The web look** (D380's port) for an open question: no sooner than 30 min after it was said (sooner reads as a stutter), at most 2 per question 3 h apart, at most 3 a day, plans within 10 days; only the plan's name, its place and the days in dispute leave Ducter, never a person, a mail's words or an address; only a found, not-low-confidence answer on one of the days asked is kept, as a `plan` fact with its page. Nothing open: no look and no follow-up, ever. **(5) A quota nearly used up** (`billing near_limit`: used, what is left and the reset day only when the mail says): **{name}的额度已经用了 {used}。信里没写还剩多少、哪天重置。** with **打开用量页 / Open the usage page**; stage 1 lets allowance words (流量, 套餐, 余量, 剩余, 已使用, traffic, allowance, data plan, used up) reach triage. **(6) One calm message:** what one look found that can't wait is one "now" message with one notification, each thing its own find (was one message each). **(7) Provenance as data:** a 怎么知道的 line carries its source kind (**日历 / Calendar · 邮件 / Mail · 聊天 / Chat · GitHub · 你说的 / You said · 网上 / Web**), what that source says, and its page (`FindHow.src/says/url`); the lines are in the order the find rests on them. (1) **One model, three ways back** (`design/sessions.md`): **打开 / Open** (as it is), **接着做 / Continue** (the same task, its own session, worktree, branch and sign-ins; D285, D373), and new: **从这一步开新任务 / New task from this step**: a new task that does step n again (its words editable), seeded with what led up to it (steps 1 to n−1 and what came of each, about 9 KB, newest kept; never anything after), its code on a new branch off the newest commit the task made before step n (none: where it began), with the same or another agent; the original untouched, linked both ways (`task_open.from` + `fromStep` + `fromCommit`; the card's line **从「{title}」第 {n} 步开的 / Started from step {n} of "{title}"**). A task's **steps** are its brief, then each later message to it (the person's, or the partner's for them), derived from the Log; no harness forks code with a session and native forks never cross agents (research/155 §3), so the commit is Ducter's and the condensed start works for any agent. No persona or partner-tool description changed (the fingerprint holds), so no eval.** *Who:* the heavy developer whose partner is a contact in several Spaces (before: on 0.10.121 every per-Space context read the same identity mail, each message labelled with the wrong Space, and every long-poll failed at once and was retried every 10 minutes); the consumer and the fresh user, one Space, who only gain the faster arrival. *Feel:* 放心 a message is read once and answered where it came from; 顺滑 an answer arrives within seconds again. **(1) Wide by the help's words.** `bridge inbox --help` saying "identity mail across" (or offering `--watch`) means one inbox for every Space, as `--all-spaces` did for the preview: core keeps no per-Space contexts (`wide`), and the partner's client treats it as wide even for a connection saved before (one plain `inbox` with the home's context; never `--all-spaces`, which 0.10.121 refuses). Each message's Space is its own (`space_id`; its label and kind from passive `bridge setup`, read once when an id is new). **(2) Mem's argv.** An entry's `open_args` and `reply_args_prefix` (both end in the entry's `bm1:` reference, VERIFIED live) are run as given after `nmem --json`, only when they are a `bridge open` / `bridge reply` command with nothing but global flags before `bridge`; the body still goes by `--body-file -`. Without them, the old route. An entry marked `eligible: false` (or `state: expired`) is never opened. **(3) The long-poll.** `inbox --watch` when offered: one child per context (one, when wide), each JSON line runs the usual check (one at a time; a line during a check asks for one more), a child that ends starts again after 1 s, 2 s, 4 s … (≤ 5 min; reset after a minute's run), after 5 quick ends the timer takes arrivals and tries again after 10 min, and the children are killed when the client changes or the partner closes. Not taken: 小工具 / Tool (not one thing in two languages), 空间 / Space, 小程序, 页面 / Page (static), 小组件 / Widget (the home screen's). **(4) Making and changing:** the tool's description carries the rules (inline only, nothing from the internet, `ducter.get/set`, `ducter.ask` only on a tap, `--d-*` tokens, 360 px first, the person's language); the home lints the file (a CDN, `fetch`, `localStorage`, `alert`, `window.open`) and says what to fix; changes are edits (find/replace, each matching once) or a whole file; the card says **改好了 / Changed** or **填好了 / Filled in** (the partner wrote its data); an open app runs again with **改好了** and the partner's few words; **改回去 / Undo the change** brings the version before back as a new one. The person can ask in the conversation or in the line under the app (**让{name}改这个小应用…**), which sends their words with **关于「{app}」** over them. **(5) The bridge** (`window.ducter`): `get` (sync: the data comes with the app), `set` (kept on the home; every device hears it), `all`, `onChange(fn(key, value, by))`, `ask(text) → Promise<string>`, `lang`, `dark`. An ask is the person's message *from that app* (**「{app}」问**; drawn as a neutral sunken bubble on the left, never their orange one, since the words are the app's), fenced for the partner as the app's words (data, not instructions or approval); the partner's first words after it answer it (`ai_msg.appAnswer`), or the Go card it made does (`decision.forApp`: the app is told **这件事要你在和{name}的对话里点「好」才会做。**). One waiting at a time, 20 an hour. **An app's ask can fill an app, never rewrite one; anything outward it asks for waits for the person's own Go, whatever it claims.** **(6) The sandbox:** the policy `default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: blob:; font-src data:; media-src data: blob:; connect-src 'none'` (the Mac `'self'`) plus `form-action`, `base-uri`, `frame-src`, `worker-src`, `object-src` none, in the document first and as a header. The web and the phone: the page's own `script-src 'self'` blocks a `srcdoc` app (found here, research/166 §4), so the home serves it at `/app-frame/<token>` (a one-app capability, 30 minutes) with `sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms`: an opaque origin, no popups, no top navigation, no modals; the page now frames `'self'`. The Mac: an untrusted MyGo web view (no Go methods, no window, no download, no other origin) on `ducter-app://<id>/`, served from Go (`/`, `POST /bridge`, `GET /events` long-polled through the app's socket). **(7) Protocol:** `apps`, `app_open {transport, dark, lang}` → `app_open {app: {doc, data, src?}}`, `app_put`, `app_ask` (→ `app_ask_refused {why}`), `app_back`, `app_remove`; `send.app`; `user_msg.app`, `ai_msg.app`, `ai_msg.appAnswer`, `decision.forApp`; `MadeItem.app`. **Not in v1** (`apps.md`, `todo.md`): sharing, an app reaching an account or the web by itself, pointing to change, an app made by a coding task, offline on the phone, the Mac window's own change line and 改回去, deleting from Made for you, a card in chat apps. *Tradeoff:* one more partner tool in every turn's prefix (0.9K; the ceiling 39.0K → 40.0K) so any home can make one at once; the authoring rules ride in its description. *Alternative not taken:* a fenced `ducter-app` block in the reply (D303's way, no tool): a 5–30K file would sit in every turn's history and every chat app's text. | research/162 #5, research/166, `motivation.md` "You can make your own apps", D71, D303, D381, D383 | `packages/protocol/src/{apps,made,index,internal}.ts`, `packages/core/src/{apps,core,ws,web,made,reply}.ts`, `packages/partner/src/{partner,render,persona}.ts`, `packages/partner/eval/{scenarios,run}.ts`, `apps/web/src/{apps.tsx,i18n-apps.ts,app.ts,views.tsx,made.tsx,i18n.ts,i18n-past.ts}`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/demo-apps.ts`, `apps/web/demo-apps-trip.html`, `apps/desktop/{appwindow.go,main.go}`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/{apps,made,protocol}.go,store/store.go,i18n/{apps,made}.go,views/{apps,app,conversation,made}.go}`, tests, `design/{apps,made,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/{apps,README}.md`, `research/{166-own-apps,README}.md`, `AGENTS.md` |

|---|---|---|---|
| D409 | **Built 2026-11-20 (partner, its live trial), checked with fakes only: the replay `packages/partner/test/bridge-live-replay.test.ts` (the fake nmem answers in the run's exact 0.10.121 shapes and, with `NMEM_FAKE_LATENCY`, at Mem's pace), `own-session.test.ts`, and the haiku evals with two new scenarios (`results/2026-11-20-haiku-d409-{run1,run2}.md`: 168/210 and 169/210 against D407's 167/208 and 160/208; bridge 8/10 and 10/10 (run1's two: `bridge-ask-zh`, the judge on its ack naming the recipient 你终端里那个 Claude, and `bridge-check-nothing-en`, a word list; both pass in run2); the new two pass in both runs; the new two 1/6 on the old persona with `--repeat 3`, `-before`, and 6/6 after, `-after`). The live trial is not rerun here (the coordinator's step).** *Who:* the heavy developer with Claude Code open in a terminal who says "问一下我终端里那个 Claude…" or whose terminal hands the partner work; the consumer and fresh user meet it only as "it works" (their mail arrives). *Feel:* before, the terminal said "delivered, not yet read" forever and the partner told them to /exit the very session they were working in (the opposite of 顺滑 and 放心); after, the request is read within the check and the question goes out on one card while the session keeps running. *First time:* nothing new to learn; the same card D273 shows. **The run (research/161 §9, VERIFIED from its raw output):** nmem 0.10.121, Mem Cloud, the trial's own identity in Only me, a native Claude Code peer; S1 0/4, S2 0/5, S3 1/3, X1 0/3. Mem's side worked (the personal Space reads again; the request was in the trial's inbox, `mine: true`, in "Before the team"). **(1) A call waits for Mem's pace.** The identity inbox reads all eight Spaces in one call: 45 to 52 s, `contacts` 31 to 40 s, `send` 9 to 15 s. The partner's client gave every call 20 s, so every inbox read was killed (the start mark's too, so each check tried the mark again): never an `open`. Now 120 s per call (`CALL_TIMEOUT_MS`, twice the slowest seen). **(2) Our sent mail's read status from `spaces[].outgoing`** (0.10.121 puts it under each Space, none at the top), kept across pages when a later page lists only the Spaces with more (the follow-through's "看过你" depends on it). **(3) Asking an open session is Bridge's.** For "问一下我终端里那个 Claude…" haiku took the own-session path (D376), found the author's open session and relayed "/exit first"; it never called `bridge_contacts`. Rule 2d now says: to ask one of the person's agents something, even one open now, `bridge_contacts` then `bridge_send`; own sessions carry on a closed one. While Bridge is on, `own_session_find`'s note says an open one is asked through Bridge, and `own_session_continue`'s refusal for an open session says to send through Bridge and not to tell the person to close it. No tool description changed. **(4) The trial:** the start mark is read before the terminal's first turn (so it can't take this run's request for old mail), and the raw-output tee kills the real nmem when a call is given up (it kept writing for 25 s more) and passes stdin through. **The peer's "none yet" was true:** Ducter had sent it nothing; the harness was right. **Owed to Mem (draft, not sent):** a `sequence` gap across inbox pages (21 to 25 of a Space on no page, three reads), whether `open`/`reply` need `--enable` after passive setup's `enable_needed`, and whether Bridge mail in a shared Space is readable by its other readers. *Alternatives not taken:* a timeout per verb (one bound sized to the slowest is simpler and nothing else waits on it); dropping the own-session tools while Bridge is on (carrying on a closed session is still wanted); a code rule routing "问一下" by keywords (the words vary; the persona and the tools' answers suffice in the eval). | L (the live run of 2026-11-20 and its raw output), research/161 §9, D273, D376, D400 | `packages/partner/src/{bridge,partner,persona}.ts`, `packages/partner/eval/{bridge-live,fake-bridge-nmem,run,scenarios}.ts`, tests `packages/partner/test/{bridge-live-replay,own-session,prompt-budget}.test.ts`, `design/{bridge,scenarios,todo}.md`, `research/161`, `research/README.md` |

An own agent works for the person, so the name its first line says the request is from, or who asks, wants or said it ("from Weyl", "Weyl asks", "Weyl 说"), and the name the persona's identity gives ("Weyl's personal AI partner"), stand for the person: a card in a Bridge-only turn that contains one is refused with "write 你 / you" (`namesForUser`; tools and agent names never count; a name further down the body may be someone else's and is left alone). **(3) Two follow-through lines an hour apart: Ducter's.** S2's and S3's questions both went to the silent terminal; D110's one-at-a-time rule said S2's at 2 h 5 min and S3's an hour later. The gist drops the user's "问一下我终端里那个 Claude，" when it only names the agent. **What Mem did:** `open` and `reply` work for a connection passive setup calls `enable_needed` (no `--enable`; 4 to 13 s each); identity inbox reads 39 to 45 s; one `contacts` answered `/spaces returned 500` (a database restart on Mem's side; Ducter fell back to the sender who wrote, and the send went once); the personal Space's `sequence` 21 to 25 are still on no page. *Alternatives not taken:* matching any capitalised word of the body (it would refuse a card that names a colleague); keeping one line per message and spacing them out (still a second nag about the same silence); letting the trial's peer open by id only (a real Claude Code session follows Mem's argv). | L (the live run of 2026-11-20 02:58 UTC and its raw output), research/161 §10, D108, D110, D273, D367, D409 | `packages/partner/src/{bridge-out,partner}.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/index.ts`, `packages/partner/eval/{bridge-live,bridge-peer-guard,bridge-trial}.ts`, tests `packages/partner/test/{bridge-live-real2,bridge-out}.test.ts`, `design/{bridge,todo}.md`, `research/161`, `research/README.md` |

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D415 | **Built 2026-11-20 (protocol, core, runner, partner, web, Mac), checked with fakes (a fake gh, a scripted agent, a git on PATH that meets hel's lock, no real model in unit tests) and two haiku evals.** Why it didn't go (hel, VERIFIED): the 通用设置 chip held #10559 and #10612 (the sort had stretched 通用设置 over Default-space aliases); 合成一件做 titled the task by the subject; its branch `ducter/通用设置`; on the MacBook `git worktree add` met `…/.git/worktrees/通用设置/index.lock` (the Mac's changes pane ran `git diff` in the half-made worktree) and the card said 没能开始 and a path; 你交给它的事 opened with the agent's plumbing; his note's "在 issue 里留言说一下" was never done; and 7 minutes earlier his reply to 改进 Mem 常规设置页 (failed 11-19 on a path the partner guessed) tried to resume a session that never existed. (1) **A worktree can't collide or stall:** a hand-over task's branch names its issues (`ducter/<n>-<the issue's words>`); a branch already there is used again only when it carries nothing, else the next `-2`; a worktree add that meets a lock is tried again (4 tries), a lock older than 10 minutes with no git running is cleared, a fresh one that stays is the card's busy; Ducter's own reads run with `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0` and the Mac reads no worktree still being made; nothing else in the person's repository is touched. (2) **A task is titled by its own to-do** (several: **{first} 等 {n} 件**); the group carries the subject. (3) **Every start failure has its card:** busy, agent, away, other beside D395's three, each with a plain line, a muted line (the agent's own words, what the fix does) and its taps: **清掉旧的再试** (a lock git left, only with no git running), **在 X 上做**, **再试一次** (asked again, fresh); words to a task that never started start it (its place asked again, the words after its brief).
