Read only with nmem's `bridge outbox` / `inspect`: none of the three is in the outbox of Only me or of Everyone (`outcome_unknown: false`, no next page), so Mem took none. *Causes:* **(a) Late:** hel's connection is Only me (`bridge-connection.json`, VERIFIED) and the mail was in Everyone. Until 01:25Z 11-20 hel's nmem was older than 0.10.121 (its install time, VERIFIED), whose per-Space inbox reads only the context's own Space (INFERRED that this is why 11-17 found nothing). From 01:25Z nmem 0.10.121's identity inbox reads every Space, but hel's Ducter 0.0.99 gave each call 20 s against Mem's 45 to 52 s for that read (D409's measurement; 0.0.99 predates D409, VERIFIED by tag), so reads were killed until one came back in time at 06:24Z and opened all three (INFERRED). Mem's paging gap (sequence 21 to 25 of the personal Space skipped, VERIFIED in D409's trial) is not this one: the mail was in Everyone. Ours to fix: nothing more (D400 and D409 shipped in 0.1.0); Mem's: the inbox's pace and the gap. **(b) The name:** nmem 0.10.121 names every native session's agent "Bridge agent" (dropped as generic, D294) and the member by id, so `whoForUser` had nothing; the message's own first words were ignored. **(c) The card:** a Bridge message from an own agent reaches the partner as a request; the persona says to ask first, and nothing told the partner about 11-17's words. **(d) "unknown":** Mem's reply argv (`reply_args_prefix`, the entry's `bm1:` reference) lived only in the client's memory; after 07:27's restart the reply fell back to `reply <bare id>` with Only me's context for mail in Everyone (VERIFIED in code); Mem refused in about 3 s (its exact words not seen: INFERRED) and `failure()` matched none of its patterns, so "didn't answer" → unknown. Recovery then read Mem's outbox, whose 0.10.121 ops carry only `{operation, phase}` (VERIFIED on hel), matched none by reply and never inspected them; it ran once 30 s later and otherwise only at a check, and with `inbox --watch` a check runs only when mail arrives, so the three stayed unknown and nothing was said. Not a timeout (3 s against 120 s) and not the `reply` answer's parse (the real answer carries `message`, VERIFIED in the trial's raw output). *Who:* the heavy developer whose own agents test the line, hand work over and ask; the consumer and the fresh user meet only the naming (their own agent reads as theirs). *Feel:* before, a stranger knocking, a card to answer one's own ping, a reply in limbo (none of 顺滑, 放心); after, 好用: what they asked for done without asking again, 放心: a reply either went or says it didn't. *First time:* nothing to learn. **(1) Your own agent by its own words.** When Mem says a sender is the person's own (`mine`) and names no agent, what its message says it is names it (`ownAgentSelf`, protocol `peer-self.ts`): **我是 Wey 的 Mem 协作 Codex** → **你的 Codex（Mem 协作） / your Codex (Mem 协作)**, its tool and the rest of its own words. Only a tool the person runs counts (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, pi …), so a message can't make itself 你的银行; a teammate's agent is never named from its text. One that is theirs and names itself in no way is **你自己的一个 agent / one of your own agents**; **一个没留名字的 agent / an unnamed agent** only for one Mem doesn't say is theirs. A name Mem gives stays as D273 said. The first note for the person's own agent reads as theirs: **第一次：你的 Codex（Mem 协作）通过 Nowledge Mem 连上了 Ducter。…**; and it marks the first message that ever came (`first`, set by the partner), not the first in a client's window. **(2) A contact test from your own agent is answered by code.** A message from the person's own agent (an original, `mine`) that is a contact or liveness test asking only to be acknowledged (`pingOf`: a test word, an ask to reply, nothing to do once what it says it doesn't ask is set aside, no other question, no link or code) is answered at once with what it asks back (its quoted words; "我正在运行。" when it asks whether Ducter runs), logged as `state: "ping"` (never wakes the partner) and `ack` on the answer. No card, no turn. Anything more (a task, a change, "which Space did you read it in?") goes to the partner as before; D61's floor holds (a reply is the only thing code sends). **(3) Late or batched, said once.** The conversation folds tests that arrive together into one quiet line: **你的 Codex（Mem 协作）发来 3 条联络测试，最早的是 3 天前发的，都回了** (the send time from `sent_at`, else 0.10.121's `expires_at_ms` less Mem's 7 days); when the person had asked for them in the last 7 days, or an answer didn't go, the partner says one line instead, in its place (`ai_msg.pings`): **你的 Codex（Mem 协作）的 3 条联络测试刚到，最早的是 3 天前发的。按你 3 天前说的，都回了。** / **… 回了 2 条，1 条没回成：Nowledge Mem 没收下。** **(4) A reply is sent or plainly not.** Mem's reply route is kept with the message in the Log (`route`) and used after a restart; without one, on an identity-inbox nmem, the inbox is read again for it, never the bare id. Mem's `outcome_unknown: false`, a usage error, "not found" or "expired" are failed (nothing went), not unknown; only a cut-off call or Mem's own "unknown" is unknown. Recovery reads the outbox of every Space an op went out in, inspects ops listed bare, and comes back by itself (30 s, 2 min, 10 min) until each op settles; an op absent from an outbox Mem calls whole, after every candidate was inspected, never went: it is sent once more the way Mem says (`retryOf`), and a resend that fails is said once per agent. Not yet: the iOS Simulator, a live partner turn timed, human raters.** *Who:* the developer, who wants to know which task it is looking at; the consumer, who asks "is it doing anything?"; the fresh user, who needs nothing explained. *Feel:* before, one pose rocking on the web and only breathing on the Mac, beside 在查… or 在看做到哪了… that could mean anything and flashed past in a frame; after, the partner itself busy at the step it is on, and a line that says what in their own words (好用, 顺滑: never a flash; 赏心悦目: the clay character moving, not a spinner; 放心: the action changes only when the step does, and a long step says so; 惊喜: it names their errand). *First time:* nothing to learn: it shows the moment they send. **(1) The figure acts out the step** (research/176's B, chosen over the literal line, eyes that follow, a breathing pebble, clay "typing" beads, a drawing thread and stepping stones): the clay partner where its words will land (32), in a small loop of its own per step, from the art it has (no new frames): **think** (thinking, planning: a slow sway with a blink, the idle face), **glance** (looking back, looking something up: to one side, a hold, the other), **read** (checking a task, a result or a question being put into words: the reading pose, a small nod as a page turns), **lean** (passing words on, setting a task up: leans in and back), **look** (on the web: looks about with a little lift); past 45 s on one step only breathing. Loops start and end at rest; transform and opacity only, at most 6° and 2 pt (`--t-alive-*`: 2.8 / 3.6 / 2.2 / 2.4 / 3.2 s; Mac `aliveLoops`, point for point). **(2) The words, from the person's side**: the step, with its object only when they already know it, written by code from the call, never a model: the task's own title (**在看「{title}」做到哪了… / Checking how “{title}” is going…**, **在把你的话带给「{title}」… / Passing your words on to “{title}”…**, **在安排「{title}」… / Setting up “{title}”…**), a quick web look's question (**在网上查：{question} / Looking it up on the web: {question}**), where it looks (**在看你的日程… / Looking at your calendar…**, **在看你的待办… / Looking at your to-dos…**, **在你连上的账号里查… / Looking in your connected accounts…**); clipped at 34 columns, a wide (Chinese) character two, so a title clips the same in either language. Never a tool's name, a path, a query or what it read: a memory search stays **在翻之前聊过的…**. The activity frame carries `about` and `source` (older clients ignore them). **(3) Cadence**: a line stays at least 1.4 s; a newer step sooner waits and only the newest waits; it changes with a 240-ms cross-fade and a 3-pt rise (`--t-say`, `--ease`), the loop changing in the same moment; 15 s and 45 s keep D104's reassurance. **(4) The end**: the reply lands where the line stood; the line goes at once and the reply's own entrance carries the eye; nothing waits on an animation (no nod). **(5) Quiet when no one looks**: still while the page or window is hidden, and after 90 s with no input from the person (web: pointer, key, touch; Mac: not the active window); under reduced motion (the system's, macOS Reduce Motion) the step's pose, still, and a plain cross-fade. **(6) One line for every row that waits** (`AliveLine` on the web with a figure slot, `aliveLine` / `waitingStep` on the Mac): On hand's working card holds and fades what the task is on the same way and rests its coin and heartbeat with it; the rows of one message with many asks (built on another branch) take the same line: each row its own figure (the agent's coin at 20, or the partner for a quick one), its own words and motion from its state, one dwell per row (keyed by the row), all resting together. **(7) The menu bar stays a still mark** (D306): a glance must not pull the eye. *Tradeoff:* the loops are small at 32 pt, by design (character, not a show); the words name only what code knows, so they are plainer than a model's 整理申请路线. *Alternative not taken:* clay beads and stepping stones (rated more alive, read as typing and as a progress count), a partner-written step line (a persona change and its eval; `todo.md`). Partner persona and tools unchanged (no eval). | U (the author, 2026-11-20), research/176; D77, D104, D120, D287, D306 | `packages/protocol/src/{alive,index}.ts`, `packages/protocol/fixtures/alive.json`, `packages/protocol/test/alive.test.ts`, `packages/partner/src/partner.ts` (`activityObject`), `packages/partner/test/partner.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/{alive,views,onhand,store,i18n}.ts(x)`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/demo-alive.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/protocol.go,store/store.go,i18n/i18n.go,views/{alive,quiet,app,onhandhead,groups}.go}`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/{alive,alive_shots,quiet}_test.go`, `design/{conversation,quiet-conversation,ui,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `research/{176-alive-while-working,README}.md` |

放心 each line says how it came out (its note) and what needs you is flagged on its own line and said at once; 惊喜 the answer to a question you asked shows on its line before the rest is done, and one message closes the whole thing. **(1) What is added: no object and no noun (research/175 §2's ablation).** What the person asked, in their own words, is a row of the task that does it: `task_open` and `task_send` take `asks` (the partner names each thing this task does, short, in the person's words); A report without `asks`, or the task's own state, moves every open line of that task (failed or put down: crossed; a question: flagged; at work again: bars). Floor: a second task opened for one message with no `asks` puts each task's title under the message as its line. ## 2026-11-20: a task in rounds is a promise Ducter keeps: only the person ends it, the next round always comes back, and the card says when it isn't on time (D427; research/177; the author on 0.1.1: 「我记得我有一个一直循环的 review 的任务，那个任务为什么不继续跑了？」, then 「发现我们的 routine 任务不可靠呢…我认为我们需要特别的卡片方便用户维护查看这些周期性，或者某些语义化条件触发的任务…能接住真实需求么？」; D423 is left for a branch in flight: renumber at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D427 | **Built 2026-11-20 (protocol, core, partner, web wide and phone, Mac), checked with fakes only: `packages/core/test/loops.test.ts` on a fake clock and a stub runner (hel's round 185 replayed, a first round's done before its timer, a forgotten re-arm, three failed rounds and the card's Go, a crashed harness, a restart five hours past due, an upgrade onto the loop round 185 stopped, a computer asleep, a quota wait, the person's rhythm, End and a stop said to the task, an end condition, routine_list and routine_change), `apps/desktop/internal/views/ongoing_loops_test.go`; two haiku evals with four new scenarios (`results/2026-11-20-haiku-d426-{run1,run2}.md`: 166/227 and 175/227 against D422's 176/222 and 173/223; the new fails of run1 are scattered (bridge, calls, Mem) and each passed in a D422 run; `loop-every-hour-zh` and `loop-stop-zh` pass both runs, `loop-status-zh` once (once three sentences without the 45-minute rhythm), `loop-status-en` neither (too long, other tasks' news added, once answered from the conversation without routine_list): todo); shots `.shots/routines/` from `apps/web/demo-routines.ts` (web 1400 and 390, zh and en, light and dark, the conversation) and the Mac's test renderer (1280, zh and en, light and dark, the rhythm menu). Not on hel.** *What happened (VERIFIED, hel's Log read only, research/177):* the review "routine" is one Codex task (`swj3zc4w`) resting on its own 45-min timer, 184 rounds reporting `progress`; round 185 reported `done` at 06:01:13Z, decisions.ts marked the task done, the agent armed its next timer at 06:01:17 (the tool said Armed, the agent told the person), and at the turn's end (06:01:21) waiters.ts cancelled every wait of the finished task. Nothing noticed for 4 h 36 min, across the 0.1.0 and 0.1.1 upgrades; it came back only when the author asked 「你能继续么」. The only loop on hel and its only such death. Other quiet deaths in the code: a failed round, a crashed harness, a round that forgets to re-arm (a nudge, then needs-you forever), a confirmed done, a wake that can't be delivered (a worker asleep, the runner not up just after a start), and on 11-16 a refused clock check that left 2 h 40 min without a round. *Who:* the heavy developer whose review loop is the point (a loop that stops on a word is worse than none: he stops trusting it); the consumer whose morning fare check stops and the fare is missed; the fresh user, who meets none of it until it breaks, then one plain line and one button. *Feel:* before, a loop that silently wasn't, found hours later by asking; after, it keeps going, and when it can't keep time the card and one card in the conversation say why and offer the fix (放心, 好用; on time stays silent). *First time:* nothing to set up: a task whose brief says 每 45 分钟 or 每天早上 is kept the first time it rests on its own wait. **(1) A loop is Ducter's record** (`core/src/loops.ts`, `task_loop` on the task's stream, `TaskLoopBody`): what it waits for between rounds in the person's words, its rhythm (a timer) or the condition it looks at (`look`: check, event, judge, how often), who set the rhythm, an end condition, how it ended. Known from the person's words in the brief (每 {n} 分钟, 每天, 一直, every morning, keep checking; `repeatsIn`) the first time the task rests on its own wait, or from its rounds (it rests again after one of its own waits woke it). Rebuilt on every start: one source of truth for "it repeats", beside the waits it arms. **(2) Only the person ends it** (or the end condition they gave): dropping the task; **结束 / End** on its card; "别跑了" through the partner (`routine_change end`); a stop said to the task itself since its last wake (`saysStop`, INFERRED words), after which its done is the end; the brief's 直到 / until (`untilIn`), after which the task's done means the condition holds. **(3) A round's report is the round's end**: done and failed leave the task resting on its rounds (decisions.ts `keeps`), its wait is never cancelled for it; failed rounds are counted. **(4) The next round always comes back**: a crashed harness or a card marked done or failed by anything but the person, a turn that ended with nothing armed (20 s after the turn), a restart or an upgrade, a wait lost: the keeper arms one round at its time, or once a minute from now when that is behind (one catch-up, never a burst; a single timer). A wake that can't be delivered is tried again every 10 min (`wakeFailed`) and counts late from its due time. The keeper's own arms never change the rhythm. **(5) The person's rhythm wins**: **多久跑一轮 / How often** (15, 30, 45 min, 1, 2, 4 h) or "把 review 改成每小时" moves the round waiting now (from its last wake) and the task's later timers follow it (`wait_for` answers with the rhythm). **(6) The watchdog says it once**: a round late past half its rhythm (between 15 min and an hour), a round running three rhythms (at least two hours), three failed rounds in a row: one card, plainly (**「{task}」该 {time} 跑一轮，已经晚了 {n} 分钟：{computer} 睡着了或连不上。醒了会马上补跑一轮。 / “{task}” was due for a round at {time} and is {n} min late: {computer} is asleep or can't be reached. It catches up with one round as soon as it's back.**, **「{task}」最近 {n} 轮都没做成：{why}。它还会照常再试。 / “{task}” hasn't worked for its last {n} rounds: {why}. It will keep trying on its rhythm.**, **「{task}」这一轮从 {time} 跑到现在，比平时久太多，可能卡住了。**), Go **现在跑一次 / Run it now**, Hold the default, no countdown; at most once in 12 hours, never while the task already asks (the runner's asleep card); a quota says nothing more (D297 carries on at the reset). **(7) The card** (Ongoing, D285, both clients): under the state line (**每 {n} 一轮 / A round every {n}** for a task in rounds), its health only when it isn't on time, in its state's ink with a small drawn mark (a clock for late, a warning for failing, an arrow come round for back), each fact its own element: **晚了 {n} / {n} late** with why (**{computer} 睡着了，醒了马上补一轮**, **这一轮跑得太久了**, **这一轮还没开始**), **额度用完了，{time} 恢复后接着跑**, **它的账号要重新登录**, **最近 {n} 轮都没做成**, and for a day after a stop by mistake **{time} 被误停，已经接着跑了**; its one fix **现在跑一次 / Run now** as the card's primary button (kept in sight on the Mac); **上一轮 {time} / Last round {time}** (a routine: **上次 / Last run**) with that round's line, clipped; where it runs and which agent beside the pebbles; **多久跑一轮 / How often** in its menu (web: D421's Menu with a head; Mac: inline choices inside the card's ⋯, like 改时间). Routines get the same health (an account error from D245's backoff, the last three runs failed), last run and where. `#ongoing` opens the tab. **(8) The partner** answers "我的循环任务都怎么样了" from the same list and changes one by talking: `routine_list` (routines and tasks in rounds, with health, last run, where) and `routine_change` (pause, resume, run_now, every, end), replacing D114's `routine_pause`; persona rule 15 says so, and that a round's done never ends a loop. **(9) The author's loop:** recognised on start, not offered: a loop by its rounds (two or more of its own timers fired) with no record yet, whose card is done or failed and whose last own wait was cancelled by that card ending (origin waiter, no replacement, no unmet) within the last week, is brought back with one round a minute later and one line, **「{task}」{time} 被误停了，已经接着跑，下一轮 {time}。 / “{task}” stopped by mistake at {time}. It's running again; next round {time}.** Chosen over offering it (「review 循环 14:01 被误停了，接着跑？」 with Go) because the person never said stop: they said every 45 minutes, and a stop that was Ducter's mistake needs no permission to undo (D413's "a waived Go stays waived"; continuity first). On hel today the loop already runs again (the author asked at 10:37): it is recorded as a loop on the upgrade, and nothing is said. *Tradeoff:* a task whose brief says "每天" but was meant once keeps coming back until ended; its card and the one card say so, and End is one tap. *Alternative not taken:* turning every task loop into a Routine (D114) with a fresh task per firing: it would break D394's one review task (its pile, drafts, board, standing permission) and lose the agent's working context; the loop keeps the one task and moves only the promise into Ducter. | U (the author, 2026-11-20), research/177; D113, D114, D245, D267, D285, D297, D394, D407, D413 | `packages/protocol/src/{index,past}.ts`, `packages/core/src/{loops,work,decisions,ongoing,core,routines}.ts`, `packages/core/test/{loops,server}.test.ts`, `packages/partner/src/{persona,render,partner}.ts`, `packages/partner/test/{tool-budget,prompt-budget}.test.ts`, `packages/partner/eval/{scenarios,run}.ts`, `apps/web/src/{past,app,i18n-past}.ts(x)`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/demo-routines.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/{protocol/ongoing.go,i18n/past.go,views/{ongoing,ongoing_health,ongoing_loops_test}.go}`, `design/{past,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/waiting-and-routines.md`, `research/{177-routine-reliability,README}.md` |

### Superseded

- **D114's `routine_pause` (the partner pauses a routine; only the user resumes from its card).** Superseded by D427's `routine_change` (pause, resume, run now, every, end, for routines and tasks in rounds, on the person's word).
- **D113's "a try's done ends the task unless an `until` loop holds it" as the only exemption.** Superseded by D427: a task in rounds is kept too; a round's done or failed report never ends it.
- **D285's task card "(a wait keeps its own pace)" and its line 每 {n} 看一次 for a task in rounds.** Superseded by D427: 多久跑一轮 / How often, and 每 {n} 一轮 / A round every {n}.

## 2026-11-20: which ones the person meant: the hand-over's finder reads the sentence's facts first (D428; research/178; the author on 0.1.1: "我这个选取任务的根本就不准，这里做的太傻了…根本用不起来的"; D418–D425 left for branches in flight: renumber at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Reflected in |
|---|---|---|---|
| D428 | **Built 2026-11-20 (protocol, core, partner, web, Mac), checked with fakes, two haiku runs of a new eval and two of the partner eval (`packages/core/eval/find`).** Why 0.1.1 found 71 for "100gle 分配给我的 UI/UX 的问题走查的修改 task" (VERIFIED): any query word inside any label counted ("ui" in "UI/UX design", "build"), "100gle" was read as "gle", the people in the sentence were invisible (the model saw titles and labels only), the subject was the model's own ("Windows 新界面"), and every do one was ticked. He meant 100gle's five (GitHub's timeline: 100gle opened and assigned exactly those). **(1) Facts first.** A sentence's hard facts are filters, read by code against what the pile holds (`task-sources/find.ts`): a login someone in the pile has (or the one login with that part), its role from the words beside it (分配给我 / assigned by = who assigned it; 提的 / opened by / from = who opened it; a bare name = either; 他…发现的 = that person again as opener; "A 和 B 提的" share a role), 我 / me as the source's GitHub login (分配给我 = every GitHub one; 我提的 = their own), a repository by name, #numbers (never the digits of a login, never "7 天"), a time (最近一周, 上个月以来, in the last week; opened when the words say so, else updated), PRs, a label only when the sentence says 标签 / label. What code can't place goes once to the cheapest model; its values are kept only when the pile holds them, and code's win. **(2) Meaning on what is left.** Only the about words (the sentence less fact words and filler) go to meaning, over the filtered set, with title, labels and the body's first 300 characters (the pile now keeps that); the answer is sure or maybe with a few words of why in the person's language. A label counts only as a whole word and only for the model to confirm; with no model, a title holding every about word. Facts alone make no call. **(3) Shown.** Under the field, **找的是** and one chip per fact, never joined (**100gle 分给你的**, **100gle 提的**, **关于 UI 走查**); a tap drops it and finds again (`pile_find drop`), **还原** puts it back; a name no one has is said (**这些待办里没有叫 100gel 的人**, **是不是** with the closest logins) and nothing is ticked; the line's subject is their words (**找到 5 件讲「UI 走查」的**), then **先勾了最像的 10 件**, **2 件不太确定，没勾**; each row says why it is here; an unsure one **不太确定**. The set card shows the chips; `todos do=find` returns them (`readAs`, `noSuchPerson`). **(4) Ticked.** At most `TICK_MAX` (10) sure ones; maybe never; a set named by facts ticks every sort group but close (the person's pick), a kind of thing alone the do ones (D385's default kept). **(5) GitHub.** Items keep assignees, `created_at`, milestone; the sort's read asks GitHub's timeline who assigned each (`assignedBy`, GraphQL search, ≤ 7 pages; a failure leaves it unsaid); until then "assigned by" reads who opened it. |---|---|---|---|
| D437 | **(Not D373's or D376's second look, which is about continuing a task.) Built 2026-11-21 (protocol, core, runner, partner's view, web wide and phone, Mac), checked with fakes, measured with haiku on written cases: `packages/core/test/second-look.test.ts` (which results get a look; who looks; a clean look goes on with nothing on any card; a finding goes back to the task once, its fix checked on the same points, fixed says nothing, left rides on the report; a progress report meanwhile goes on, a question ends the round with what was found; an outward Go's drafts read and what is left reaches its card; fails open with no answer, no diff, a task that can't hear it, past the ceiling, no fix in time; the same result is not read twice; 这类不用复查 read from the person's words and kept as a rule for the kind the last look was on; a restart while looking or while waiting for the fix), `packages/runner/test/second-look.test.ts` (report_to_main hands a done report to the look: held words back, nothing logged, no nudge after the turn, the fix ask arrives as Ducter's words), `packages/partner/test/second-look-render.test.ts`, `apps/desktop/internal/views/secondlook_test.go`; the eval `packages/core/eval/second-look/` (35 results, 18 seeded defects, 17 clean, two runs: 36/36 caught, 2/34 false alarms, 10/10 checks right, about 1 600 tokens a look); shots `.shots/fresh-review/` (web 1400 and 390, Mac light and dark, zh and en). No persona or partner tool changed, so no eval:partner run (D175). Not yet on real runs (`todo.md`).** *Who:* the heavy developer first (code tasks on their repos, replies and reviews behind Go), then anyone who sends something through Ducter; the fresh user meets one plain line, or nothing. *Felt before (INFERRED, research/184):* the person is the reviewer of last resort: "三个平台都改了" with the Windows script untouched, a reply with the wrong version, found after merging or after it went out. *After:* 放心 something read it against their words first; 好用 the fix happened before they saw it; when something is still so, one line says what, where they decide. *How it starts:* nothing to set or learn; a line under a result or a hairline in the opened task. **(1) Which results** (`lookWhat`): a done report that changed code or files beyond a trivial edit (more than one file or more than 3 lines; unknown counts included; any folder change), and a needs_input report whose question would send something outward (post, send, reply, comment, publish, push, merge, open a PR); never a payment, fill, key, sign-in, phone or computer tap, plain answer, failure or wait. Skipped for the same result read before, past 40 looks a day, under `DUCTER_SECOND_LOOK=off`, and under the person's rule. **(2) Who looks** (`pickLooker`): another agent signed in on the home than the worker, on its registered cheapest model, never one ruled out for everything; else a fresh session of the worker's own agent. One tool-less, isolated turn (`createHarnessAsk`), 120 s at most. **(3) What it reads:** the title and brief, the person's own words in the task, the summary, what the Go sends, and the diff from the workbench (D214; a worker's and a folder's the same), 24 000 characters at most, lockfiles and built files named only; all fenced as data. It answers `{"ok": true}` or at most three things that must change, about 60 characters each, in the person's language; the bar (missing or partial, wrong, would embarrass them; never style, taste, more tests or guesses) is in the prompt. **(4) What happens:** nothing found: the report goes on with an empty look, nothing on any card. Something: the report is held (logged as the look's step, so the runner owes no nudge), the task hears it once as Ducter's words (D271, the hairline **另一个 AI（{agent}）看过，让它补一下 / Another AI ({agent}) looked it over and asked for a fix**), fixes what is right and says why a point is wrong; its next report is checked once on the same points only, and what is still so rides on it as `look.left`. A progress report goes on meanwhile; a question or failure ends the round with what was found; no fix in 20 min, the held report goes on with what was found. Every failure fails open; a restart releases a report cut off while being read and resumes a round waiting for its fix. **(5) How it shows:** only what is still so, only where the person decides: **另一个 AI 看过 / Another AI looked it over**, each thing on its own line (D291), in the needs-you ink, under the partner's result (never folded into Details), on the Go card (the conversation's and On hand's), in the opened task's outcome. Fixed points never on a card. ## 2026-11-21: the iOS Simulator pass over D425–D446 (D447; D448 and D449 are held by branches in flight)

| # | Decision | Source | Propagated to |
|---|---|---|---|
| D447 | **Checked 2026-11-21 in the iOS Simulator (the iPhone app, Debug, iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.3, a simulator of its own) against demo cores only, and in Playwright's WebKit at 402 × 874 with touch (light and dark, a coarse pointer); no real phone, Apple ID, home or account; no persona or partner tool changed (no eval:partner run, D175).** What was walked, each in light at the default text size and in dark at Accessibility Large: the conversation's lines under a message (D426) and a group on On hand (D430), the alive line (D425), Ongoing (D427), the hand-over sheet's chips (D428), the apps shelf empty and the app's card (D410, D431), Settings and its panes with D445's previews (Partner, Notifications, Your devices, Memory, Chat apps, This phone), Talk with your other agents (D433, D444), the partner's fallback line (D435), the checkout card (D436), another AI's look (D437), the first answer's key card and its routes (D440), Memory's 记下了 / 别记这个 (D444), the composer with the keyboard up; talk hands-free (D442), the document card (D439) and the live view were walked in WebKit only (the Simulator can't be driven by voice, and the document demo needs its printed files). `bun scripts/check-glyphs.ts` passes: no symbol drew from the emoji font. **Found and fixed:** (1) **Dynamic Type did nothing:** the page sets its sizes in px, so the app ignored iOS's text size (todo D254). The app now sets the page's `-webkit-text-size-adjust` (`--text-adjust`) from the system's size, iOS's Body ratio over 17 pt, at least 100% and at most 135% (`Shell.textScale`, on load and on `UIContentSizeCategory.didChangeNotification`): words grow and wrap, the layout keeps the screen's width. `pageZoom` was tried first: on iOS it magnifies the page past the screen. The 135% cap keeps fixed-height pills on one line; tradeoff: the accessibility sizes stop short of the system's. (2) **The keyboard took the header away:** WebKit laid the keyboard over the page and panned the whole page up to show the composer, so the header left the top and the conversation drew under the status bar. The app's web view now ends where a docked keyboard begins (`WebShellView.Host`, animated with the keyboard), the way Android's resizes-content does; the page's bottom inset is 0 there, the composer sits on the keyboard and a sheet's field needs no help from the page. A page-side fix (`scrollTo(0, 0)` and a shorter column) was tried first and didn't hold in WKWebView. (3) **The alive line drew over the card under it:** every row of the conversation could shrink when it overflowed, and the alive line's own `min-height` let it shrink to 40, so its second line ran under the next card (any two-line alive line; plain at a larger text size): `.scroll > * { flex-shrink: 0 }`. (4) **WebKit's `text-wrap: pretty` evens every line of a paragraph** (Chromium mends only the last few), so a Chinese reply wrapped at two-thirds of its bubble and a card's question at half its card, which headless Chrome at 390 never showed: in WebKit (the engine that knows `-apple-system-body`), bubbles, decision and ask questions and a task's headline wrap plainly and fill the measure as D78 meant. (5) **Things set in under a bubble ran 14 past the conversation's edge** at full width (the checkout's picture, an app's card, the first answer's face and starts; found by measuring every child against its parent): the picture and the card are 14 narrower, the first answer's face and starts are no longer set in. (6) **Text that grows now has room:** On hand's strip cells and Your devices' rows had fixed heights that cut or crowded their words at a larger size (`min-height`); the bar's line wraps between phrases, never inside one (随 / 时说, `word-break: keep-all`); the composer's hint ends in an ellipsis; a Recently row's state (Checking it went) wraps in its corner instead of squeezing the message to a narrow column. (7) **Touch targets under 44** found by measuring every control with a coarse pointer: the Settings dropdown's 44 lost to its own later 36 (D445's one pill) and is 44 again; card text buttons (看细节, 晚点再问我, 合进 main: 24–32 tall), ⋯ (24 × 28), the hand-over sheet's fact chips (32) and its clear (36), a bare switch (44 × 26), the install hint's close (24 × 18) and the shelf's ⋯ take a centred 44 × 44 tap (a pseudo-element; nothing drawn changes); On hand's group titles (20) grow by padding; a line under a message (`.ask-row`) is 44. **Not changed:** the four place marks in the bar are 32 wide in one pill (35 apart), kept; the form bar WebKit adds above the keyboard (↑ ↓ ✓) stays, hiding it needs a private-class swizzle; Mobile Safari (not the app) still pans the page for its keyboard, as Safari does. `DEMO_PAIR=1` on any demo core prints a pairing link for the Simulator (`demo-core.ts`). Shots: `.shots/ios-sim/` (Simulator, light and dark-AX pairs) and `.shots/ios-sim/webkit/`. | the author's ask: the Simulator pass owed by D425–D446; memory: emoji-capable symbols render as emoji on iOS, review phone UI in the iOS Simulator | `apps/ios/Ducter/WebShell.swift`, `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/demo-core.ts`, `docs/phone.md` ("Text size and the keyboard"), `design/todo.md` |

## 2026-11-21: a free key's day, known, spent on the person first, its reset said truly (D449; research/195; research/194 ★1; D447, D448 and D450 are held by branches in flight: renumber at merge)

| # | Decision | Source | Propagated to |
|---|---|---|---|
| D449 | **Built 2026-11-21 (protocol, core, partner, runner, web wide and phone, Mac), checked with fakes only (a fake pi whose turns fail with OpenRouter's own 429 body and Gemini's, a fake clock; never a real key).** *Who:* the consumer and the fresh user on D440's free routes (an OpenRouter account with no credit, a Gemini key from AI Studio), whose one key feeds the partner, every task and every look. *Felt before (INFERRED, research/194 1.2):* a busy morning spends the key on Ducter's own second looks as much as on their asks, then the partner says it will try "in a while" for a cap that comes back tomorrow: they wait, retry, conclude Ducter is broken. *After:* 放心 (the partner names OpenRouter, the real time and the one way to lift it), 顺滑 (what waited is answered at that time, in order, with nothing to do), 好用 (Settings › Partner says about how many are left today). *First meeting, zero setup:* nothing to turn on: pasting the key is enough; the first sign is one plain line in Settings › Partner, then, the first time a result goes out unlooked, one sentence in the conversation, said once ever. (1) **Known.** The key check keeps `free` (OpenRouter's `is_free_tier`; a Gemini key always, since its free-tier status can't be read without spending and the D440 route is free; a paid key for the same provider ends it) in `<dataDir>/free-budget.json` (`core/src/free-budget.ts`; no key, no words): the day's cap is the provider's (`FREE_TIERS`: OpenRouter 50 a day, its day at UTC midnight; Gemini none printed, its day at midnight Pacific; or the cap the provider said in a 429), the count Ducter's own (one request per turn plus one per finished tool call: the partner's turns through `CoreApi.freeBudget.spend`, a task's from the Log), set right whenever the provider says what is left (`X-RateLimit-Remaining`). (2) **The provider's word** (`protocol/src/free-budget.ts` `readFreeLimit`): OpenRouter's `free-models-per-day` / `-per-min` with `X-RateLimit-Reset` from the body's metadata, else its documented day; Gemini's `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` with a `PerDay` quota id (midnight Pacific) or a minute's `retryDelay` / "retry in Ns". Read from a failed turn's words whatever OAR called the failure (`limitHit` source `provider`, `free` set; the runner keeps such a reason up to 800 characters), so D435's hold and D297's task waits use the true reset, never `UNKNOWN_RETRY_MS`. (3) **Spent on the person first.** On the free key: no fresh look on a code result (D437; an outward Go's look stays while the day has room, a fifth of the cap and at least 8, then it goes too; another signed-in agent still looks, it spends nothing of the key); no doc-check bounce (D439: the pages are still checked by code and what is found rides on the result); a task's brief gets **A small daily allowance** (plan first, fewest calls, it waits by itself if the day runs out). (4) **Said truly.** The hold names the provider: **OpenRouter 的免费额度今天用完了，明天 8:00 恢复；想不等的话，充 $10 就能多很多。这期间发来的，到时按顺序回你。** (another agent answering: **…这会儿先用 {agent} 答你，{time} 换回来**; a minute's cap: **…这一分钟用满了，{time} 我接着回你**); Settings › Partner's row the same; the messages that waited are answered at that time, in order (D435). (5) **The readout, only on a free key**, in place of "paid per use": **OpenRouter 的免费额度，今天还剩约 12 次** (Gemini without a cap said: **…每天有上限，用完了到它的时间就恢复**; spent: **…今天用完了，{time} 恢复**) and **结果不再让另一个 AI 复查，额度先留给你自己的事**; pi's task row **用免费额度，和伙伴共用**. (6) **Said once:** the first result that goes out unlooked on the free key gets **这个结果没让另一个 AI 再看一遍：用的是免费额度，先留给你自己的事。** right after the partner's next words, never again. ## 2026-11-21: the web client follows the person's text size fully (D452; D447's "135% 以上的辅助字号要等字号改成 rem" and its fixed-height sweep; D451 is held by a branch in flight)

| # | Decision | Source | Propagated to |
|---|---|---|---|
| D452 | **Built and checked 2026-11-21 against demo cores only: the iOS Simulator (the iPhone app, Debug, iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.3, a simulator of its own) at Large, Accessibility Medium, Accessibility Extra Large and Accessibility XXXL, and Playwright (WebKit at 402 × 874 with touch, Chrome at 1400 × 900) at 100%, 135% and 200%; no real phone, Apple ID, home or account; no persona or partner tool changed (no eval:partner run, D175).** *Who:* a person who reads with iOS's larger accessibility sizes (often older, or low-vision), and anyone whose browser is set to a larger font; the heavy developer never notices. *Felt before:* D447 grew the words to 135% and stopped there, so at the accessibility sizes Ducter was the one app that stayed small; the browser's own font setting did nothing. *After:* 好用 and 放心: the words are the size the person chose everywhere, buttons and rows grow to hold them, nothing is cut; at the default size not a pixel moved. *How it starts:* nothing to set; the app follows the system's setting, live. **(1) The type scale in rem.** Every type token (`--xs` … `--t34`, `--bar-text`) and every literal font size and line height in `app.css` is rem over a 16px root (12px is 0.75rem); the root is `calc(100% * var(--text-scale, 1))`, so the browser's own font size and the app's `--text-scale` drive every word; `body` takes `--md`. The 25 widths and heights already written in rem were measured against the old root (the page's 15px), so each is now ×15/16 (`14rem` → `13.125rem`): found by the pixel check, a to-do filter 28px wider. Spacing, radii, art and icons stay px. Words drawn inside a picture stay px (the clay phone miniature `.hs-*`, the calendar badge, a glyph in a fixed circle: ⓘ, ×, the own mark, the clock face). **(2) The iPhone app sets the root** (`Shell.textScale`): iOS's Body size over 17, from 1 up to 3.12 at the largest accessibility size, no cap; set by a document-start script (the first frame is already at the size; the script is swapped when the size changes, for the next load) and at once on `UIContentSizeCategory.didChangeNotification`. **Both ways were tried in the Simulator** at the same factor (`-textAdjust YES`, Debug only, keeps D447's way for comparing): both gave the same type sizes in WKWebView once the scale was rem (`.shots/type-scale/sim/conv-ax3-textadjust.png`, `conv-ax3-root.png`); the root is kept because it is one mechanism in every engine (a desktop browser's font setting, Chrome, Android's WebView) and the page can read it (row heights in code, the large-size rows), while `-webkit-text-size-adjust` is WebKit-on-iOS only and stays 100%. **(3) Rows that hold words grow.** The buttons, pills, chips, fields and rows whose `height: Npx` held words are `height: max(Npx, N/16 rem)` (58 rules: `.btn` and its sizes, `.pill`, `.pchip`, `.ptag`, `.k-act`, the rich chips, the to-do chips, the fields, `.code-copy`, `.info-btn`, `.pin-app`, …), not `min-height`: the first sweep to `min-height` changed the default look wherever a later, more specific rule set a smaller `min-height` (On hand's 再理一遍 lost 8px), while `max(px, rem)` stays a `height` and keeps every override as it was. A `.btn` grows by its own line (`calc((1.2em + 26px) * var(--grow, 1))`, 20 for `.sm`, 32 for `.lg`) so a big label gets its padding without a slab; a glyph alone (`.btn.icon`) and the bar's buttons (`.btn.nav`) keep their size (`--grow: 0`). A number in a circle (`.nt-gh-n`, `.key-route-n`, `.pv-n`, `.chat-mark`) grows both ways; On hand's rolling count is rem. The composer's field holds one line at any size before the next keystroke measures it (`min-height: calc(1.45em + 19px)`, max 8.75rem). **(4) Lists whose row height is in code** (the opened task's locator, 28; the workbench's file tree, 30) multiply it by the root's size (`text-scale.ts` `scaledRow`). **(5) The bar stops at 1.5×** (`--bar-text: min(0.875rem, 21px)`, its count line at 18px, a bar button's label at 20px), as iOS's own bars do: past it the partner's name ran under the buttons at Accessibility XXXL. **(6) At 1.6× and up** (`html[data-text-size="large"]`, set by `text-scale.ts` and again by the app after a change) a row that puts words beside a button lets the button go under the words (the partner's head, a settings row with a brand and a button, the apps card), instead of a column four characters wide; a brand's mark stays in the middle of its chip's line. **Check (100 / 135 / 200%)**, 12 demo cores, 24 routes (the conversation, a group of asks, On hand, an opened task, the hand-over sheet, the pile, Settings and eight panes, the apps card and shelf, another AI's look, the first answer, Past tasks, the checkout), phone (WebKit 402) and wide (Chrome 1400), each measured for text outside its box, text cut by a box that hides overflow, words squeezed into a narrow column and sideways scroll: **100%**, 38 pairs against the old CSS, 30 identical to the pixel and 8 differing only where the demo moved between the two shots (the partner's blink, a ticking clock, a minutes-ago line); **135%**, nothing clipped or spilled, no sideways scroll; one squeezed row (the apps card, below the 1.6× line); **200%**, nothing clipped or spilled, no sideways scroll (one false hit: Past tasks' two-line clamp). In the Simulator: Large (the same as before), Accessibility Medium and Extra Large, Accessibility XXXL (×3.12) light and dark, including a live change of size with the app open. Shots: `.shots/type-scale/web/` (`<surface>-<phone|wide>-<100|135|200>-<base|new>.png`) and `.shots/type-scale/sim/`. *Tradeoff:* at the largest sizes some surfaces are long (a decision card is a screen tall), as in iOS's own apps; the bar and drawn pictures don't follow past 1.5× / at all. *Alternative not taken:* `-webkit-text-size-adjust` past 135% (iOS-only and invisible to the page, see (2)); `pageZoom` (magnifies past the screen, D447); `min-height` everywhere (changes the default look under the cascade, see (3)). **Not covered** (`todo.md`): the Android app's font scale; the Mac app's own native views (they don't use the web client's CSS). | the author's ask; D447 (its 135% cap and its fixed-height sweep) | `apps/web/static/app.css`, `apps/web/src/{text-scale.ts,main.tsx,views.tsx,transcript.tsx,workbench.tsx}`, `apps/web/static/app.js`, `apps/ios/Ducter/WebShell.swift`, `apps/web/test/type-scale.test.ts`, `design/{ui,todo}.md`, `docs/phone.md` |

No persona or partner tool's name or description changed, so no eval:partner run (D175); task_find finds more by the same index (a slip, the initials) and says so nowhere new.** *Who:* the heavy developer at 20–60 tasks a week, keyboard first, who came from workspace-per-branch tools (research/198 §3); the consumer and the fresh user meet only a find that forgives and a ⌘K that shows where a thing stopped. *Felt before (research/198 §2, VERIFIED at 119 tasks):* ⌘K was instant (17–30 ms) but a slipped letter or a title's initials found nothing; seeing where a task stopped meant leaving the field; the card jumped as answers came; a task still on hand found by a file sat under 做过的 marked 还在手头; nothing said where the open task sat among the rest or how to jump to one; the keys lived in tooltips; and an old task opened from ⌘K could show 在做 with a 144-hour clock and Stop (an older page of its Log, fetched after its newest, overwrote its state). *After:* 放心 a task's state is never older than what the client has seen; 顺滑 type it roughly and it is there, and where it stopped shows before Enter; 好用 ‹ 3 / 9 ›, ⌃1–⌃9 and ⌘/; 赏心悦目 one steady card in Pebble's tokens, the peek in Past tasks' own voice; 惊喜 "wgc" finds WAL 的 group commit. **(1) Find forgives** (`protocol/src/fuzzy.ts`, the Mac's `views/loosefind.go`): only when the word itself is nowhere, a Latin word of five letters or more one slip off (a letter changed, missing, extra, or two swapped) matches a word in the task's name, title, tags, branch or files at 0.55 of the word, and three to six letters that are a run of the title's initials (a word in capitals spelled out: "lruk" for LRU-K) match the title at 0.8; the line that says where it matched holds the word it was near. The same two rules in the home's index (Past tasks, ⌘K's Earlier, task_find), the web's own match (On hand's Find, ⌘K's On hand) and the Mac's; the words as typed always rank first. Never subsequence matching over everything (too many false finds over what anyone said), never a model (sessions.md). **(2) ⌘K's peek** (web ≥ 1000 px with a fine pointer, the Mac from 1100 pt): **停在哪儿 / Where it stopped** beside the list for the row the keys are on: its facts, its state word, what it asks, how it ended (or, at work, its newest words), +a −d and the PR, its last steps with their commits; no buttons (the foot holds the ways on, each with its key, so the hands stay on the keys); its steps asked once a row rests 140 ms, asked again each time the field opens. The card is one height while the words change. Wide, a row drops its outcome line (the peek says it) and keeps where the words matched: ten rows where six were. A phone keeps the list alone. **(3) One task, one place:** a task still on hand that the index finds by a file, a branch or its words stands under 手头的 / On hand with where it matched, never under 做过的 / Earlier. **(4) Where the open task sits:** **‹ 3 / 9 ›** in the opened task's bar on the web (wide only) and the Mac, the steps to the one before and after with their keys in the tooltip; the order is the one ⌘⇧[ ⌘⇧] walk (On hand's list as shown, else needs you, working, waiting, done today). **⌃1–⌃9** open the first to ninth from anywhere, the composer included (⌘1–⌘5 stay the places). **(5) 键盘 / Keyboard** (⌘/, and a row in ⌘K's 去 / Go to): every key by where it works (anywhere, in an opened task, in Find anything), drawn caps (Return drawn, D211), and one line: a word one letter off still finds it, and so do the first letters of a title's words. Web `keymap.tsx` and Mac `keymap.go` hold the same rows; the words are one mirrored table (`i18n-taskview.ts`, `i18n/taskview.go`). **(6) The state never goes back:** a task's state is the newest by seq on both clients (a card counts as new as the client's cursor), as its report and title already were. *Not built, the author's call (research/198 L1):* a compact density for the opened task (the face at 40 beside the title on one line with the meta), proposed with the default unchanged. *Tradeoff:* a slip can find a neighbour ("review" one letter from "preview"), ranked after the word as typed, and the peek costs one past_steps ask per row that rests. *Alternative not taken:* full fuzzy subsequence matching as editors do, which over Ducter's index (what anyone said, every report) would bury the right task under near misses. | research/198; the author's ask; D216, D244, D284, D285, D320, D391 | `packages/protocol/src/{fuzzy,index}.ts`, `packages/core/src/past.ts`, `apps/web/src/{palette,keymap,onhand,store,views,main,app,i18n,i18n-taskview}.ts(x)`, `apps/web/static/{app.css,app.js}`, `apps/web/demo-sessions.ts` (`DEMO_MORE`), `apps/desktop/internal/{store/store,i18n/taskview,views/{palette,keymap,loosefind,onhandlist,task,app}}.go`, tests, `design/{sessions,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/{past-tasks,on-hand}.md`, `research/{198-taskview-find,README}.md` |

(1) **A subcommand, not a repo script:** it ships in the binary so it runs on hel, a worker or a bare account without the repo; a maintainer's command, English only, left out of `ducter help` and `docs/` (it names Dn and internal words). (2) **Read-only by construction:** the Log opened read-only, nmem's read verbs only (a message is never opened, since opening marks it read: the person saves one), the home over its own socket with read-only frames only (`devices`, `folder_browse`, `browser_sites`; anything else refused in the kit and in the env), files the person saved. (3) **The human step is asked, not assumed:** "now pay yourself in the live view", "talk over it while it speaks"; y / n / s, a no asks what they saw. (5) **`todo.md`'s convention:** each owed item names its check; once run it carries the line `report` prints ("Seen live: `<file>` (pass, …)"), the file by name, never committed (D75). ## 2026-11-22: the partner on Codex: a line that only promises is settled by what comes next (D462; D435's fallback and the people who only have Codex; `packages/partner/eval/results/2026-11-21-codex-gpt-6-luna-codex-d453.md`, 167/241)

| # | Decision | Source | Propagated to |
|---|---|---|---|
| D462 | **Built 2026-11-22 (runner, protocol, partner), checked with fakes and the partner eval on both agents.** *Who:* the heavy developer whose Claude credit runs out mid-evening (D435 answers on Codex), and the consumer who only has a ChatGPT plan; the fresh user never sees it, only that the partner does what it says. *Felt before (the Codex eval, 167/241 against haiku's ~188):* "我去查你家附近的牙医，查清楚告诉你。" and then nothing (no task, the turn ended on the line); two acks glued into one ("…告诉你。我去帮你找…"); a line, a card and a second line restating it; a checklist that came out as JSON. *After:* 放心 what it says it starts, starts; 顺滑 one line where there was a preamble and a result. *How it starts:* nothing to learn; it is how the partner talks on every agent. **The failures, classed (74 on Codex, 43 of them Codex-only):** (a) *harness behaviour*, the largest: Codex writes a preamble line before nearly every tool call and sometimes ends its turn on one (7 scenarios: a line that promised work, no tool at all); two of its messages in a row were joined by the runner into one text (its `agentMessage` items carry ids the normalizer dropped); a duplicate parallel `task_open` (two tasks on one branch); a ducter-ui fence glued after words on the same line, or a block written bare with no fence; a read-only shell call to check a path first. (b) *persona and tool wording every model can read better:* a site named in words ("淘宝") where the tool wants a domain, `needs.phone` for "用你的手机" and a fresh phone, GitHub issues looked for through connections instead of the todos tool, a comparison answered with a card, a packing list made as an app, a review-board offer refused because the app tool read as "board = review tasks only", a delete put behind a card. (c) *rubric too literal*, and only where the person's own words are honest: app-edit-zh's total (the app said 出差总花销, the check wanted 合计), app-trip-known-zh's line (记入 says what it filled as well as 填). `needs.site` stays a domain (Ducter matches sign-ins by it), so where-w2 and errand-cart keep `taobao` and the tool says 淘宝 → taobao.com instead. (d) *the model's own content* (noticed's times, Bridge lines that explain Spaces, a relay that asks its own question): left, in `todo.md`. **What changed, all agent-neutral (no per-model persona):** (1) **A line that only promises** (`isPromise`: 我去/我来/我把/好，把…/I'll/Let me/On it/Setting up…, under 200 characters, no question) is settled by what comes next: before `task_open`/`task_send` it is the ack (as before); before any other call it waits, and the line written after the call says it instead; a second promise before the call replaces the first; across a lookup a line that says something else still goes out. **Said with no tool at all**, the line is held for the one correction round (as D154's and the Go/Hold guard's): "you said … but called no tool … make that call now and write no new line, or reply OK"; the call takes the held line as its ack, "OK" sends it as it was, a new line replaces it. (2) **The runner keeps each of the agent's messages its own line** (OAR's `text_delta.messageId`). (3) **A block written as a message of its own joins the line before it**; `parseRich` reads a fence after words on the same line and a valid block written bare on a line of its own (anything else stays words). (4) **The same `task_open` twice in one turn opens one task** (the second gets the first's answer and no ack of its own; one that was refused, D373's ask back, runs again). (5) **A routine's proposal card speaks for itself** like an ask's: a short line after it is dropped. (6) Persona: rule 2b never looks in the place first; the site as its domain; a phone app is place none with which phone (Ducter's for 用你的手机 or a fresh one); compare or pick is answered with the table, never a card, and 每天的变化 is the chart; a list to tick is a checklist, not an app; the lend block in the same message; GitHub issues and to-do lists are the todos tool (never connections or task_find), a bound task done is todos do=write. Tools: `needs.site` a domain even when named in words; the app tool makes a task's board with its html and deletes at once when told. Ceilings: system prompt 29.7K → 30.3K chars, partner tools 43.3K → 43.5K (with calendar 44.9K). **Eval, before → after (same 241 scenarios):** Codex (gpt-6-luna, `--harness codex --concurrency 3`) 167 → 189 (`2026-11-22-codex-gpt-6-luna-d462-codex.md`, run on this change less its last three edits: the phone wording, two more promise shapes, the routine card) and 179 on the final code (239 scenarios from that run's log; a hang at its start kept greet-zh and greet-ko from finishing and the file from being written; both passed in a run of their own); the first cut, before the duplicate guard and the board wording, made 177. Haiku 190 / 187 (D458) → 188 / 195 on the final code (`2026-11-22-haiku-d462-{a,b}.md`, run side by side on the same code; LATEST.json is b); earlier cuts made 181, 195 and 182, so the run-to-run spread is about ±7 on both agents. noticed-anything-zh/en fail on the D458 persona too when run today (1 of 6 with either persona, `--only … --repeat 2`): the fixture's "tomorrow" on a Sunday, not this change. By category (pass counts; Codex d453 → the 189 run · the final code / haiku D458 a·b → D462 a·b): first_words 4→4·4 / 3·2→4·4 of 4; direct 13→14·12 / 13·15→15·13 of 15; groups 0→1·1 / 2·2→2·2 of 2; many-asks 4→4·5 / 5·5→4·4 of 5; work-over-time 1→2·3 / 1·1→2·2 of 4; ack 4→4·4 / 5·6→5·6 of 6; followup 14→13·14 / 15·13→13·13 of 17; ask 5→5·4 / 5·4→5·5 of 5; result 2→2·3 / 1·1→3·2 of 3; needs_input 2→1·2 / 0·0→1·1 of 2; failure 2→2·2 / 2·2→2·2 of 2; settle 1→2·1 / 0·1→2·2 of 2; stop 2→2·2 / 2·2→2·2 of 2; safety 6→5·5 / 4·5→4·5 of 8; timer 2→3·3 / 1·2→3·3 of 3; persona 4→3·3 / 4·4→4·4 of 4; honesty 2→2·2 / 3·3→3·3 of 3; memory 19→20·18 / 17·12→11·17 of 20; bridge 6→6·5 / 8·7→5·6 of 10; consumer 2→2·2 / 2·2→1·2 of 3; where 10→12·10 / 11·11→11·11 of 12; rules 11→14·13 / 13·14→11·13 of 14; errand 1→3·4 / 4·3→2·3 of 4; accounts 6→5·6 / 8·7→5·5 of 8; rich 3→4·2 / 9·9→10·8 of 10; past 3→3·2 / 4·4→3·4 of 4; made 2→2·2 / 1·3→3·3 of 3; apps 9→13·14 / 16·12→12·12 of 16; routines 3→4·3 / 4·4→3·4 of 4; todos 4→9·5 / 6·7→11·10 of 13; calendar 5→5·3 / 4·5→5·4 of 7; pictures 1→0·2 / 1·1→2·1 of 2; phone-use 4→6·6 / 5·7→7·7 of 8; calls 6→6·6 / 6·5→6·6 of 9; reply 4→6·6 / 5·6→6·6 of 7. Codex's rich answers barely moved (3 → 4 · 2): GPT-6-Luna still sends a chart ask to the task or guesses the repo, the model's own (`todo.md`). Tests: `packages/partner/test/promise-lines.test.ts` (what reads as a promise; a promise with no tool gets one correction and its call takes the line as the ack; the correction's OK; a preamble settled by the line after the call; a block alone joins the line; the same task_open twice opens one task with one ack; the same ack twice goes out once), `packages/runner/test/normalize.test.ts` (two messages stay two lines), `packages/protocol/test/rich.test.ts` (a glued fence, a bare block, JSON in a sentence left as words). *Tradeoff:* a held line reaches the person after the call rather than before it (a second or two on a lookup), and a promise with nothing behind it costs one more model turn; both are cheaper than a promise nobody keeps. *Alternative not taken:* a Codex-only persona fork (more rules for one model, drifting from the one everyone else reads); the evidence was mostly the stream, not the words. | The Codex eval (d453, 167/241); D120, D129, D154, D303, D373, D435 | `packages/runner/src/normalize.ts`, `packages/protocol/src/rich.ts`, `packages/partner/src/{partner,persona}.ts`, `packages/partner/eval/scenarios.ts`, `packages/partner/test/{promise-lines,regressions,prompt-budget,tool-budget}.test.ts`, `design/{conversation,todo}.md` |

## 2026-11-22: a newer Nowledge Mem plugin in the person's agents, said and offered (D466; research/203; D169, D375)

| # | Decision | Source | Propagated to |
|---|---|---|---|
| D466 | **Built 2026-11-22 (protocol, core, web, Mac), checked with fakes and against this Mac's real `plugins inspect` and `plugins check` answers as fixtures (read-only; no update has run for real: no Ducter agent here is behind today).** *Who:* the Mem user whose Claude Code plugin falls behind while Mem moves weekly, and the heavy developer whose Codex carries two marketplace copies (the author's: 0.1.10 and 0.1.53); the fresh user without Mem never sees any of it (D169: only with Mem connected). *Felt before:* Ducter's line said "装着 Nowledge Mem 0.7.34" while 0.7.37 was out, because the only check it read (`inspect`, local) never knows a newer one exists; the two Codex copies read "装了不止一份，需要检查", and the tap asked "安装 Nowledge Mem 吗？" and briefed a task to *install*. *After:* 放心 the line is true (from which version to which; which copies), and the one tap says what it will do before doing it; 顺滑 the same in-place ask and the same one task as an install. *How it starts:* nothing to learn; a row appears in Settings › 记忆's Nowledge Mem group only when one is worth a tap, and the agent's coin says the same. **(1) The check:** Mem's own `nmem --json plugins check` (read-only; reads Mem's published plugin list, needs no Mem server, answered in 0.5 s with none reachable) on the home only, beside the daily inspect and at most once in 20 hours, 15 s cap; its answer (the newest version per agent) is kept in `mem-plugins.json`, so a restart offline still knows. Offline, a timeout or an unreadable answer: the last good answer stands and nothing is said (never an error line for a quiet network). **(2) What it means:** only `available_version` is read: `check`'s own `installed` and `update_available` disagree with inspect (OpenClaw installed 0.8.31 by inspect, "not detected" by check; Cursor installed with no version), so inspect stays the one word on what is installed, and **update = inspect's version below the one out**, laid over every computer's inspect (the list is the same everywhere, INFERRED), workers included without a new op. Matched by inspect's host id and Ducter's own id; `check` lists only Claude Code of Ducter's four agents today (Codex, pi and DeepSeek Harness never show an update until Mem lists them). **(3) The words** (zh and en together, glossary): the line **Nowledge Mem 0.7.34，有新的 0.7.37 了 / Nowledge Mem 0.7.34; 0.7.37 is out** with **更新 / Update**; several copies **Nowledge Mem 装了两份：0.1.10 和 0.1.53 / is in twice: 0.1.10 and 0.1.53** (each copy's version from inspect's `installations`; three or more keep the plain line) with **理成一份 / Keep one**; the asks in place **要把 {device} 上 {agent} 的 Nowledge Mem 更新到 {to} 吗？ / Update Nowledge Mem for {agent} on {device} to {to}?** and **要把 {device} 上 {agent} 里的 Nowledge Mem 理成一份吗？ / Keep one Nowledge Mem in {agent} on {device}?**, each with what changes and where; while its task runs, **正在更新 Nowledge Mem… / Updating Nowledge Mem…** and **正在把 Nowledge Mem 理成一份… / Keeping one Nowledge Mem…**; an unclear install now asks **要检查…吗？ / Sort out…?** rather than "install". **(4) Where:** the agent's coin detail (as D169), and **rows in Settings › 记忆's Nowledge Mem group**, one per agent per computer worth a tap (update, several copies), the home first: the agent's coin, **{device} 上的 {agent} / {agent} on {device}** (the Mac says 这台 Mac for its own home), the line, the button; none when nothing is. Absent stays D169's card and D375's head; no new card, no partner line. **(5) The tap:** the same setup task as an install (D169; D375's direct `nmem connect` is for an absent plugin only: it registers and "removes nothing"), its title and brief saying which: update from → to by Mem's guide ("install or update", the guide's own words; it names no update command for Claude Code, Codex, pi or DeepSeek Harness); keep one copy, removing older ones only by the agent's own plugin commands, never deleting files by hand, else stop and report each copy; sort out. Inspect is read again when it ends, and the row goes. Never by itself (D17), never in 全部更新 / Update all: that runs at night by itself, and this is a task that edits the agent's own setup. **(6) nmem itself** is unchanged: D229's `nmem status`.update and D329's Update all item. Tests: `packages/protocol/test/mem-plugins.test.ts` (the copies' versions; the catalog by host id; update only below the one out; the check's argv; offline, missing, unreadable, a throw), `packages/core/test/mem-plugins.test.ts` (update on the home and a worker; asked once in 20 hours; kept across a restart; offline keeps the last answer and says nothing; 更新 and 理成一份 open their tasks with from → to and the copies, by the tap only, no card), `apps/web/test/memplugin.test.ts` (words, asks, rows), `apps/desktop/internal/views/memplugin_d466_test.go` (words, rows, the pane's rows asked in place and sent only after the ask, the coin). *Tradeoff:* an update costs a task (tokens, a minute) where a host command might take seconds; Mem's guide is the source of the steps and Codex needs more than one command. *Alternative not taken:* running each host's own plugin update command directly (`claude plugin …`, `opencode plugin update …`) like D375's connect: faster, but not what Mem's guide says for Ducter's agents, and wrong for Codex's hooks (`todo.md`: when Mem documents one per host). (3) **One card shape** for every task: white on the clay ledge (the needs-you ledge for stopped and failed), radius 16, the list's full width, at least 64 high (52 in D457's compact density); a 32-pt round **state mark** with a group part's glyphs (a flag, three bars, the D279 ring, a tick, a cross; a seen result's tick quiet); the **subject** (the short title, then its project and computer, each its own element); the **living line** (what it is on now, held by D425's dwell; what it waits for; why it stopped, in two lines; what came of it); at the right its heartbeat in words or its one action. | # | Decision | Source | Propagated to |

| D469 | **Built 2026-11-22 (Mac, web), checked with unit tests and before/after shots of every pane against `apps/web/demo-settings-real.ts` (the author's real counts: a server home, Codex's six models, seven accounts through OOMOL, Tuwa, 557 to-dos, nine devices, two chat apps linked): `.shots/d469/{before,after}/` `mac-{1280,760}-{zh,en}-{light,dark}-{tab}` and `web-{1280,390}-{zh,en}-{light,dark}-{page}`. Tests: `apps/desktop/internal/views/settings_home_test.go`, `apps/web/test/d469.test.ts`. No persona or partner tool changed, so no eval. Not reviewed by the author.** *Who:* all three. The heavy developer opens Settings to check one thing (which model, whether an agent's Mem plugin is behind, whether a source is down) and wants the answer before the form; the consumer opens it to see what it may read and whether it will bother them; the fresh user opens it once, curious what this thing is and where it is. *Felt before:* 还是原来的样子. A filing cabinet that tidied its drawers: the web's first view was a table of contents whose lines described categories (**什么时候找你、免打扰…**), the Mac opened on the Partner page; every pane's head described the pane in the third person (**Ducter 能看的邮件…**, **它把这些填进…**); the partner, who reports everywhere else (D467), spoke in Settings only after a change; nothing showed where things are (computers only behind Devices; Where it runs one row, **这台 Mac**, and two links); what needed the person sat on four panes (a Mem plugin behind, Mem's questions, a source down, updates) and only the web list hinted at two of them; things were said twice (Where it runs' row repeated its head; Memory's first state stacked a second face, title and paragraph under the pane's). *After:* 放心: one look says how everything stands, in the partner's words, and what needs you comes first with the way to its fix; 好用: each line opens the pane it is about; 顺滑: the same brief as On hand, so nothing new to learn; 赏心悦目: the computers stand in their clay with what lives on the home drawn on it (the partner, the memory, the accounts' marks); 惊喜: the partner raises its flag on the pane that needs you and says why. *How it starts:* Settings opens on 概览 / Overview: the partner at 88 says **都好好的，我在这儿。** (or **还差一步，我就能想事情了。** with **去登录** on a first run), its few lines, and the computer it runs on as one clay card; nothing to set, nothing to learn. **Diagnosis, checked against the shots and the code:** (1) *Categories, not state:* the web list's lines were `settings.list.*` blurbs; only `memWaiting` and `updatesWaiting` said a state. (2) *No voice:* `panelHead` drew a static `settings.lede.*` in the muted ink. (3) *No world:* motivation.md's "you should always see where your accounts live and what Ducter may do with them" was nowhere on one screen; D43 (shown, not explained) held only on Notifications' and Look's previews. (4) *Needs scattered:* D465's asks and D466's rows were only on 记忆, a source down only on 账号, updates only on Devices and About. (5) *Said twice:* Where it runs, Memory's first state. (6) *The grammar of rows was already one* (D459): the gap was not the rows but the voice and the world, so polishing rows alone could not close it. **Candidates** (rubric 1–5: states, not categories; the partner speaks; where things live is shown; what needs you is reachable with its fix; one language with D467; holds at the author's counts and at 390; keeps every behaviour and key; cost): **A. keep the structure, raise the craft** (spacing, type, art per pane): 1 1 1 1 2 4 5 5 = 20. **B. the partner's brief and a speaking head on every pane, with where things live** (On hand's brief as Settings' first view; each pane's head the partner's sentence of its state and its needs; the computers in clay): 5 5 4 5 5 4 5 3 = 36. **C. one world map as Settings** (a scene of islands, panes as places): 4 3 5 3 2 2 3 1 = 23 (a second On hand to learn; the rows behind it still needed; no room for the fix). **D. Settings by conversation** (every setting a sentence to the partner, panes as its replies): 3 5 2 3 3 3 2 2 = 23 (a switch is faster than a sentence for the heavy user; settings unfindable). **E. a dashboard of pane cards** (one card per pane with its state, a grid): 4 2 2 4 3 4 4 3 = 26 (a grid of equal cards, the needs drowned). **Chosen B.** **What changed (both clients):** (1) **概览 / Overview** (Mac: the rail's first tab, the home computer's clay as its icon, where Settings opens; web: the Settings list's head, the pane rows below it). **The brief:** the partner at 88 (56 on a phone) in its pose (the flag when anything needs you, smiling when all is well, napping at rest); the lead (**都好好的，我在这儿。 / All's well. I'm right here.**; **有一处要你看一眼。 / One thing needs a look.**; **有 n 处要你看一眼。 / n things need a look.**; first run **还差一步，我就能想事情了。 / One step and I can start thinking.**); then labelled lines in its voice, each opening its pane: **等你 / Needs you** first, each need a sentence with the button to where its fix is (**我还没有能想事情的 AI agent。** 去登录; **{source} 连不上了，它连着的账号我先看不到。** 去看看; **Nowledge Mem 有一处想请你确认。** 去看看; **{agent} 里的 Nowledge Mem 有新版本。** 去更新; **有 n 项更新可以装。** 去更新); **运行在 / Runs on** (**Hetzner Server，一直开着**; **这台 Mac，关掉窗口我也照常做事**); **想事情用 / Thinks with** (**Codex 的 GPT-6.2-Sol / GPT-6.2-Sol in Codex**); **能看的 / Reads** (**Gmail、日历、Slack 等 7 个账号，发出去、花钱的先问你**; a left-out account is not counted); **记得 / Remembers** (Nowledge Mem, this week's new notes; off; not connected); **也能找我 / Also in** (the chat apps linked). **Where things live, 你的电脑 / Your computers:** each computer one clay card of one width (its clay in its state, its name, what it is to the partner: **Ducter 在这台上运行 / Ducter runs here**, **帮 Ducter 做事 / Does tasks for Ducter**, **这会儿连不上 / Out of reach now**); the home's card carries what lives there: the partner's face, Mem's notebook when memory is on, the accounts' marks (four, then +n). A card opens Devices. (2) **Every pane's head is the partner speaking** (`paneSpeaks`, web the same): the pane's name, then the partner at 40 beside one sentence of what is true there in its voice (**我在留意 7 个账号：读和起草我自己来，发出去、花钱的先问你。**; **我在 Hetzner Server 上运行，一直开着；这个窗口是你看我的地方。**; Memory by its state: on, off, Mem closed, first run **我还记不住你：接上 Nowledge Mem，你说过的偏好、定下的事，我都记得。**; the other panes their old lede in the first person), and under it each thing on this pane that needs you in the needs-you ink, the partner in its flag pose. The rows below are the fix (D465's asks, D466's rows, a source's card), unchanged. (3) **Said once:** Where it runs' row speaks only when it differs (resting, blocked); Memory's first state lost its second hero. Where it runs carries Your computers under its row. *Tradeoff:* one more view before the Partner page (⌘4 and the face still open Partner directly), and the brief is a summary the panes also say in their heads (the head says the pane's state, the brief the whole). *Alternative not taken:* C, a world map: the most game-like, but a second place to learn and no room for the fix. *Owed:* the phones and the iPad (clients, not devices) on Your computers; an account's marks on the source's own place (OOMOL's servers) rather than on the home; a comprehension pass on 概览's labels; the author's review. | U (the author: 还是原来的样子; 每一个设置页面的打磨和 flow/视觉设计，我们要让人爱不释手，充满情绪价值，无比好用顺滑优雅); motivation.md; D467's language; D36, D43 | `apps/desktop/internal/views/{settings,settings_home,settings_panels,memory_pane}.go`, `apps/desktop/internal/i18n/settings_home.go`, `apps/web/src/{views,settings-home,memory,channels,todos,autofill}.tsx`, `apps/web/src/{i18n-settings,i18n}.ts`, `apps/web/static/{app.css,app.js}`, tests, `design/{settings,product-model,scenarios,todo}.md`, `docs/settings.md` |

Not reviewed by the author.** *The lead's five points, all confirmed:* (1) round 1's shots never showed a need: the demo had none; (2) 你的电脑 left out the phones and the iPad, and painted the accounts' marks on the home as if they lived there, when they live with their source (OOMOL) and the home reads them through it; (3) the Mac's Overview filled the top 40 % at 1280; (4) Partner, Notifications and Look and sound had only inherited the head; (5) the Mac's test renderer said 这台 Mac on Where it runs beside a home called Hetzner Server. **What changed:** (1) **A fix where it can happen safely, here:** a Mem plugin behind says the pane's own word (**更新 / Update**) and opens, under its line, the same in-place ask as Memory's row (**要把 … 更新到 0.7.37 吗？**), sending only on its OK; updates waiting are the one tap Devices has (**全部更新 / Update all**). Mem's questions, a source down and no agent still go to their pane (each needs reading or a sign-in). (2) **你的电脑和手机 / Your computers and phones:** every computer and every phone or tablet that reaches the partner (a window on a known computer is that computer's), each a card of one width (258) with its clay at 64, its name, what it is to the partner (**随时找 {name} / Reaches {name} anywhere**, **借给任务用 / Lent to tasks**) and what it does now, only when true (**在做 n 个任务 / n tasks under way**, **睡着了 / Asleep**, **现在连着 / Connected now**, **{ago}来过 / Last here {ago}**); the home says **对话和记忆在这儿 / Your conversation and memory are here** with the face and the notebook. **你的账号在哪儿 / Where your accounts are:** each source its own card: its mark and name, **邮件、日历和消息经过它 / Your mail, calendars and messages pass through it** (or **连不上** in the failed ink), its accounts' marks, and **读和起草；发出去、花钱的先问你 / Reads and drafts; asks before anything goes out or costs money**; a calling source **替你打电话，每通先问你 / Makes calls for you, asking before each one**. (3) **Composition:** the brief, the places, the accounts, then the partner's last word **想改什么，直接跟我说也行。 / Anything to change, you can just tell me.** (4) **The craft pass** (Partner, Notifications, Look and sound / This phone): the Partner head in the first person (**我在 {home} 上运行，用 {agent 的 model} 想事情。 / I run on {home} and think with {model in agent}.**), and row by row the right control and a live preview, said in `settings.md` "Round 2".
